hymns.searchText: murinzi we, vuz'impanda 1 murinzi, jy'uvuz'impanda, uhan'umuntu wese; ng'uzumv'izo nkuru nziza, yihan'akiz'ibyaha. murinzi we vuz'impanda! yivuze cyane hose (hose), menyesha bos'ubutumwa, imbohe zibohorwe. yivugirize mu mpinga, mw'ishyamba mu gisiza; ndetse no mu nyanja hose, bameny'ako gakiza. murinzi we vuz'impanda! yivuze cyane hose (hose), menyesha bos'ubutumwa, imbohe zibohorwe. yivugirize mu nzira, mu rwiherero hose. dat'arabategereje, ntacy'ataringanije. murinzi we vuz'impanda! yivuze cyane hose (hose), menyesha bos'ubutumwa, imbohe zibohorwe. uyivugiriz'indembe, nazo zikizw'ibyaha. yes'arabatumir'ati: nimuze mbaboneze. murinzi we vuz'impanda! yivuze cyane hose (hose), menyesha bos'ubutumwa, imbohe zibohorwe.
hymns.title: Murinzi We, Vuz'Impanda

hymns.searchText: umwam'ageze kw'irembo 2 umwam'ageze kw'irembo, wabambwe ku musaraba; yaje gukorany'abera, babane mw'ijuru. kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo, ub'ari kw'irembo; nukw'araje (araje), nukw'araje (araje), kand'ageze kw'irembo. ibyerekana kuza kwe, birihuta kuboneka; kandi tugiye guhabwa, kubaho kw'iteka. kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo, ub'ari kw'irembo; nukw'araje (araje), nukw'araje (araje), kand'ageze kw'irembo. ntabw'intambar'izashira, ntabw'amahor'azahora, kerek'ibyaha n'urupfu, byatsembwe na yesu. kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo, ub'ari kw'irembo; nukw'araje (araje), nukw'araje (araje), kand'ageze kw'irembo. maze mw'isi yagizwe nshya, niho tuzabahw'iteka; kudapfa kwakuye gupfa, dushiz'agahinda. kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo (kw'irembo), kw'irembo, ub'ari kw'irembo; nukw'araje (araje), nukw'araje (araje), kand'ageze kw'irembo.

hymns.searchText: nzabona yesu 3 nzabona yesu mu maso, umuns'azatujyana; niho nzamwitegereza, kw'ari we wampfiriye. nzamurora mu maso ye, turi kumwe mw'ijuru; meny'uk'ubwiza bwe busa, nzamusingiz'iteka. ubu ndamutekereza, ariko simurora; umuns'uhiriw'uzaza, nzamubonan'ubwiza. nzamurora mu maso ye, turi kumwe mw'ijuru; meny'uk'ubwiza bwe busa, nzamusingiz'iteka. tuzishimir'imbere ye, ubw'ishavu rishize; ibigande biganduwe, n'ahijimye hakeye. nzamurora mu maso ye, turi kumwe mw'ijuru; meny'uk'ubwiza bwe busa, nzamusingiz'iteka. nzanezererw'imbere ye, nzamurora mumenye; nzabana na yes'unkunda, niwe mukiza wanjye. nzamurora mu maso ye, turi kumwe mw'ijuru; meny'uk'ubwiza bwe busa, nzamusingiz'iteka.

hymns.searchText: har'amakuru meza 4 har'amakuru mez'amenywa n'abagenzi, bazerera kure y'iwabo, kuk'umukiz'agiye kuza mu bwiza bwe, kand'agiye kwim'ingoma ye. azaza, ndabizi kw'azagaruka, nukw'azaza rwos'azaza. abagenzi bose barembye, bazakir'umukiza n'aza kwima. ibituro by'abera bos'uko bangana, byose bizakingurwa rwose; kand'inteko z'abasinzira mu kuzimu, bazongera gutura kw'isi. azaza, ndabizi kw'azagaruka, nukw'azaza rwos'azaza. abagenzi bose barembye, bazakir'umukiza n'aza kwima. nta kizadutanya mur'iyo si nshya nziza, tuzaririmb'uko twakize. abacunguwe bazaba bavuye hose, baramy'umwami wo mw'ijuru. azaza, ndabizi kw'azagaruka, nukw'azaza rwos'azaza. abagenzi bose barembye, bazakir'umukiza n'aza kwima. haleluy'amina, haleluya iteka; nitwitonda tuzahatura. ba maso nezerwa, kand'ujye wiringira, maz'uzambar'ikamba ryiza. azaza, ndabizi kw'azagaruka, nukw'azaza rwos'azaza. abagenzi bose barembye, bazakir'umukiza n'aza kwima.

hymns.title: Har'Amakuru Meza

hymns.searchText: murinzi we menyesh'igihe 5 murinzi we! menyesh'igihe! mbes'iwacu n'imuhero? at'ijoro ryijimye cyane, ariko buracya. ntukarire, gumy'ugende, nturorere kwiringira, kugez'igih'uzasohora, mu muns'uhoraho. murwanyi we! tyo mbwira nawe! ansubiza yitonz'ati: intambar'igiye gushira. guma ku rugamba. wibabara, ihangane, wirek'imirimo yawe, kuko tuzabon'ibihembo, tumaze gutsinda. ndacyabaz'ibyaremwe byose, binsubiza bitya biti: iy'is'igiye guhanguka. haz'ind'idashira. ntukarir'ibimenyetso, byerekan'aho tugeze, kand'ibintu byose byaremwe, biriteg'impanda. imuhir'ubu ni bugufi, tunezerwe mu mitima. duhumure ko tuzakira, dushir'agahinda. ntukarire tuzabana, amakub'azab'ashize. ntabwo tuzabur'amahoro mu rugo rwa data.
hymns.title: Murinzi We Menyesh'Igihe

hymns.searchText: mwebw'abera mube maso 6 mwebw'abera mube maso, ibyaremwe birahinda. mukomez'imuri zanyu, mwiteg'umwam'ari hafi. araje yes'araje! azanye n'icyubahiro. yes'aje kwim'ingoma ye, araje, yes'araje. wibuk'umuvunyi wawe, agakiza n'imbabazi, ikamba, icyubahiro. jya wogez'ako gakiza. araje yes'araje! azanye n'icyubahiro. yes'aje kwim'ingoma ye, araje, yes'araje. nta bwami budahanguka; wumv'amagare y'asuma. bwira bos'iby'imbabazi, ubu n'igihe cy'impuhwe. araje yes'araje! azanye n'icyubahiro. yes'aje kwim'ingoma ye, araje, yes'araje. amoko yos'azashira; krist'atebuts'ubwami bwe; is'igiye guhanguka; nimwishim'abahiriwe. araje yes'araje! azanye n'icyubahiro. yes'aje kwim'ingoma ye, araje, yes'araje. banyabyaha mwe nimuze! abitwarire kuri se. mwese nimugire bwangu! imbabazi zikiriho. araje yes'araje! azanye n'icyubahiro. yes'aje kwim'ingoma ye, araje, yes'araje.
hymns.title: Mwebw'Abera Mube Maso

hymns.searchText: ubwo yes'azagaruka 7 ubwo yes'azagaruka, kujyan'abe bose, bemeye kumuyoboka, n'abatoni be. bazaka nk'inyenyeri, zitatse kw'ikamba rye; bazatangaza cyane, bakize rwose. ubw'azaza gukorany'abo yatoye bose, bera baboneye rwose, b'abatoni be. bazaka nk'inyenyeri, zitatse kw'ikamba rye; bazatangaza cyane, bakize rwose. yemwe bana! yemwe bana! bakund'umukiza; abakunda, abakunda, nk'abatoni be. bazaka nk'inyenyeri, zitatse kw'ikamba rye; bazatangaza cyane, bakize rwose.
hymns.title: Ubwo Yes'Azagaruka

hymns.searchText: abarokots'ibyago byo hasi 8 abarokots'ibyago yo hasi bazakoranywa, ab'azatumir'azajyana nabo. umwami n'agaruk'ikondera rye rizavuga, amatek'azab'agiye gucibwa. azaba yabararitse, ubw'azabahamagara (hamagara). azaba yabararitse, abazatumir'azajyana nabo. uwo muns'abapfuye muri kristo bazazurwa, bazava mu bituro nka we rwose. abo yitoreye bazimana nawe mw ijuru, ubw'azagenda, azajyana nabo. azaba yabararitse, ubw'azabahamagara (hamagara). azaba yabararitse, abazatumir'azajyana nabo. niho tuzajya dukorer'umwami tudahwema; tuzajya dusingiz'urukundo rwe. maz'ubwo tuzarangiz'imirimo yacu mw'isi, tuzateranywa tujyanwe mw'ijuru. azaba yabararitse, ubw'azabahamagara (hamagara). azaba yabararitse, abazatumir'azajyana nabo.

lines: Bazava mu bituro nka we rwose.

hymns.searchText: vuz'impanda yumvikane hose 9 vuz'impanda yumvikane hose, yesu agiye kuza! muririmbe bagenzi mwishima, yesu agiye kuza. ari hafi, ari hafi, umwam'agiye kuza. mujye muhererekanya hose, yesu agiye kuza! azazan'icyubahiro cyinshi, yesu agiye kuza. ari hafi, ari hafi, umwam'agiye kuza. yivugirize mu nyanja hose, yesu agiye kuza! yivugirize no mu bikombe, yesu agiye kuza. ari hafi, ari hafi, umwam'agiye kuza. mu misoz'uyihavugirize, yesu agiye kuza! imiyag'ijyan'ayo makuru, yesu agiye kuza. ari hafi, ari hafi, umwam'agiye kuza. amok'ubw'azasubiranamo, yesu agiye kuza! ubwenge bwungukwa bwerekana, ko yes'agiye kuza. ari hafi, ari hafi, umwam'agiye kuza.

hymns.searchText: duhurire ku mugezi 10 duhurire ku mugezi, dusang'abamarayika; amazi yaw'atunganye, atemb'av'imbere y'imana. nuko tujye ku mugezi! duhurire n'abera ku mugezi! ku mugez'utunganye w'imana, utemb'uv'imbere y'intebe. ku nkombe y'uwo mugezi, niho tuzatambagira, turamy'umwami w'iteka, mu gihe cyiza kidashira. nuko tujye ku mugezi! duhurire n'abera ku mugezi! ku mugez'utunganye w'imana, utemb'uv'imbere y'intebe. tuzagera ku mugezi, dutur'imitwaro yacu; tuzakirishw'imbabazi, duhabw'umwambaro n'ikamba. nuko tujye ku mugezi! duhurire n'abera ku mugezi! ku mugez'utunganye w'imana, utemb'uv'imbere y'intebe. ubw'umugez'uri hafi, urugendo ruzashira; tuzishima mu mitima, n'indirimbo z'umunezero. nuko tujye ku mugezi! duhurire n'abera ku mugezi! ku mugez'utunganye w'imana, utemb'uv'imbere y'intebe.
hymns.title: Duhurire Ku Mugezi

hymns.searchText: mukiza ngukurikire 11 mukiza ngukurikire, ah'unshakira hose; ah'ujya ngukurikire, mwami ngukurikire. mukiza ngukurikire, wamviriy'amaraso; nib'utagir'ukwitaho, njye nkwikurikirire. nahw'inzira yazitirwa, naho yakukumuka, ko wayinyuzemo mbere, nyicamo mfit'ishimwe. mukiza ngukurikire, wamviriy'amaraso; nib'utagir'ukwitaho, njye nkwikurikirire. naho naterwa n'ibyago, nkageragezwa cyane, warageragejwe nawe, mwami ngukurikize. mukiza ngukurikire, wamviriy'amaraso; nib'utagir'ukwitaho, njye nkwikurikirire. nib'unyobora mw'ishavu, niba nkena nkanenwa, wigeze kuba ruvumwa, nanjye ngukurikize. mukiza ngukurikire, wamviriy'amaraso; nib'utagir'ukwitaho, njye nkwikurikirire.
hymns.title: Mukiza Ngukurikire

hymns.searchText: har'isoko 12 har'isokw'ivamw'amaraso, yo mu mitsi y'imanuweri. niy'atungany'abanyabyaha, bagashirahw'inenge, bagatsembwahw'ibicumuro, byose bikabacikaho. niy'atungany'abanyabyaha, bagashirahw'inenge. igisambo ku musaraba, kiyarabutswe cyarihannye; nanjye mbwiriza nkwizigire, noye kujya ncumura; ibyaha mbicikeho rwose, noye kujya nkugomera; nanjye mbwiriza nkwizigire, noye kujya ncumura. amaraso yaw'atunganye, ahoran'imbaraga nyinshi; niyo wacunguj'itorero, aritsembamw'ibyaha; ryaganjij'imbaraga yabyo. ryarabirokotse rwose. niyo wacunguj'itorero, yaritsembyemw'ibyaha. mperey'igihe meny'isoko, iva mu bikomere byawe. nogez'urwo rukundo rwawe, nzahora ngusingiza; nzahora ngusingiz'iteka, nzajya ngusingiz'iteka. nogez'urwo rukundo rwawe, nzahora ngusingiza. mwami mpora ngucumuraho, mpa kwizer'imbabazi zawe! n'amaraso yaw'atunganye, mpa kuramishwa nawe! mpa kuramishwa nawe yesu! mpa no kuramishwa nawe! n'amaraso yaw'atunganye, mpa kuramishwa nawe! har'indirimbo zera ntazi, nzaziririmbira mw'ijuru. naho nagobw'ururim'ubu, uzarugobotora; uzarugobotora yesu, ni wow'uzankiza rwose. naho nagobw'ururim'ubu, uzarugobotora.
hymns.title: Har'Isoko

hymns.searchText: mwami yesu ndifuza k'umboneza 13 mwami yesu ndifuza k'umboneza; ndashaka k'umba mu mutim'iteka. noye kujya nita ku bigirwamana. umboneze rwose nere ndush'ingwa. ngo nere de ndush'urubura! mpa kwer'ubu ngutunganire rwose! mwami jy'undebera ku ntebe yawe! mpa gutamb'igitambo kiboneye! ndeke gushidikanya nitange rwose. umboneze rwose nere ndush'ingwa. ngo nere de ndush'urubura! mpa kwer'ubu ngutunganire rwose! yesu ndagutakambira nkomeje! ngo mbon'uko nkwitega mwami mwiza! ntunganish'umuvu w'amaraso yawe! umboneze rwose nere ndush'ingwa. ngo nere de ndush'urubura! mpa kwer'ubu ngutunganire rwose! mwami ngutegereje nihanganye, yesu ngwin'ump'umutim'utunganye! nti wari wirengagiz'abagushaka. umboneze rwose nere ndush'ingwa. ngo nere de ndush'urubura! mpa kwer'ubu ngutunganire rwose!
hymns.title: Mwami Yesu Ndifuza K'Umboneza

hymns.searchText: wumv'amatur'agwa 14 wumv'amatur'agwa, ukw'ajegera. yose n'aya yesu, niwe dutura. agwa, agwa, agwa, agwa, amatur'agwa, yose n'aya yesu, niwe dutura. ava mu tuganza, wumv'agumy'agwa! n'ituro rya yesu, ryo mu twana twe. agwa, agwa, agwa, agwa, amatur'agwa, yose n'aya yesu, niwe dutura. ubu turi bato, niyo dufite; ubwo tuzakura, tuzasumbyaho. agwa, agwa, agwa, agwa, amatur'agwa, yose n'aya yesu, niwe dutura. nitugira bike, tukwihe mwami. byos'uzabyakira, utwikirize. agwa, agwa, agwa, agwa, amatur'agwa, yose n'aya yesu, niwe dutura.

lines: N'ituro rya Yesu, Ryo mu twana twe.

hymns.title: Wumv'Amatur'Agwa

hymns.searchText: urukundo rwa yesu 15 urukundo rwa yesu, rwageze kuri twebwe; rudukuraho rwose, urubanza rwo gupfa. aradukunda, aradukunda, aradukunda, yesu mutabazi. abatari bahabwa, ubugingo bw'iteka, twihute tubabwire, urukundo rwa yesu. aradukunda, aradukunda, aradukunda, yesu mutabazi. kuko yaradukunze, yadupfiriye twese, natwe dukunde dutyo, abakiri mu byaha. aradukunda, aradukunda, aradukunda, yesu mutabazi. aho yes'azazira, aje kwim'ingoma ye, nibwo tuzumv'ijwi rye, ati: mwakoze neza. aradukunda, aradukunda, aradukunda, yesu mutabazi. akir'uyu mutima, weze maz'ub'uwawe, wambambiwe ku giti, nzagukunda mb'uwawe. aradukunda, aradukunda, aradukunda, yesu mutabazi.
hymns.title: Urukundo Rwa Yesu

hymns.searchText: mbonez'intoke zanjye 16 mbonez'intoke zanjye, zibonere rwose; ko nazihaye yesu, ngo zimukorere. nitondesh'intambwe, aho njya hose. ne kuyobok'undi, keretse yesu nteg'amatwi ngo numve, nez'umunsi wose. nkor'ibikwiye numva, ntagir'icyo mpuga. nitondesh'intambwe, aho njya hose. ne kuyobok'undi, keretse yesu mpang'amabokw'amaso, ngo ndeb'iby'akora; nyabuze kwenderanya, akorere yesu. nitondesh'intambwe, aho njya hose. ne kuyobok'undi, keretse yesu
hymns.title: Mbonez'Intoke Zanjye

hymns.searchText: njye nsingiz'urukundo 17 njye nsingiz'urukundo, nirwo rumbwiriza, kugirir'abandi neza, bakamenya yesu. data we ko nd'umwana wawe! data we ngukurikize! njye nsingiz'urukundo, nirwo rumbwiriza, kugirir'abandi neza, bakamenya yesu. iyi s'ibamw'ishavu, n'ibyaha n'urupfu; ntibimbuza kuyobora bamw'ibwami bwawe. data we ko nd'umwana wawe! data we ngukurikize! njye nsingiz'urukundo, nirwo rumbwiriza, kugirir'abandi neza, bakamenya yesu. maz'ibyo nibishira, tuzabe mw'ijuru, tuzajye tuguhimbaza, mwami w'urukundo. data we ko nd'umwana wawe! data we ngukurikize! njye nsingiz'urukundo, nirwo rumbwiriza, kugirir'abandi neza, bakamenya yesu.
hymns.title: Njye Nsingiz'Urukundo

hymns.searchText: yemwe ngabo z'umwami 18 yemwe ngabo z'umwami! nimutabare! tujyane na yesu! niw'utabaza. twitwaz'umusaraba! utujy'imbere! mwese nimuze tugabe! tunesh'umwanzi. yemwe ngabo z'umwami mwese! dutabare twese! tujyane na yesu, dutsind'umwanzi. ababisha bahunga, babony'intwari. nimuze tuneshe, ngabo z'umwami! intangiriro z'isi zinyeganyezwa, n'ibyishimo by'ab'umwami, bamusingiza. yemwe ngabo z'umwami mwese! dutabare twese! tujyane na yesu, dutsind'umwanzi. itorero ry'imana, rirafatanya; rirahaguruka, kunesh'umwanzi. nta kizaduteranya, turakundana, duhora duhuj'inama, twizera kimwe. yemwe ngabo z'umwami mwese! dutabare twese! tujyane na yesu, dutsind'umwanzi. nta ngoma zidashira, zirahanguka. arikw'itorero, rizahoraho. ukuzimu n'urupfu, ntibiririnda. twarazwe na yesu kristo, ntabw'ahemuka. yemwe ngabo z'umwami mwese! dutabare twese! tujyane na yesu, dutsind'umwanzi. nuko mugabe mwese! tugerereze. tubumbire hamwe, amajwi yacu, turirimbe dushima, umwami yesu, kukw'afit'icyubahiro, giheranije. yemwe ngabo z'umwami mwese! dutabare twese! tujyane na yesu, dutsind'umwanzi.
hymns.title: Yemwe Ngabo Z'Umwami

hymns.searchText: ba mas'udacumura 19 ba mas'udacumura! ibyaha bigota, bihora bikwegera cyane, ng'utajya mw'ijuru. ba maso rwana senga! nturek'urugamba! ururasany'iminsi yose, utabaz'imana. komeza nturanesha! wirekur'intwaro! dor'intambara ntirashira, udahaw'ikamba.
hymns.title: Ba Mas'Udacumura

hymns.searchText: huguka mutima wanjye! 20 huguka mutima wanjye! shishikarir'ibyiza! ukomez'urwan'ishyaka! uzambikw'ikamba. n'iman'iguhamagara, gira bwangu witabe! niy'iziher'ibihembo, abatsinze bose. inteko zikurebera, ziragutegereje, ntutekerez'ah'uvuye, reb'imbere yawe. mukiza wacu dukunda, twanesheje ku bwawe, ubu twaje kugushima, turagusingiza.
hymns.title: Huguka Mutima Wanjye!

hymns.searchText: ndeger'umusaraba 21 ndeger'umusaraba, naniwe nkennye mpumye, singir'icyo nitaho, rwose nshaka gukizwa. mwami ndakwizigira, mukiza wanjye mwiza! ndicuz'imbere yawe, mwami yes'unkiz'ubu! nakwifujije kera, njya mbabazwa n'ibyaha. yes'ambwira nez'ati: ngukiz'ibicumuro. mwami ndakwizigira, mukiza wanjye mwiza! ndicuz'imbere yawe, mwami yes'unkiz'ubu! ubu ndakwihereje, simbuzwa n'iby'iyi si. mb'uwawe rwose mwami, nguhay'ibyanjye byose. mwami ndakwizigira, mukiza wanjye mwiza! ndicuz'imbere yawe, mwami yes'unkiz'ubu! ndiringir'iby'uvuga, wamviriy'amaraso. ubu ndicuza cyane, mbambanywe n'umukiza. mwami ndakwizigira, mukiza wanjye mwiza! ndicuz'imbere yawe, mwami yes'unkiz'ubu! nezezwa n'uko nkize, yesu niw'unkomeza. nta nenge nsigaranye, mp'itam'icyubahiro. mwami ndakwizigira, mukiza wanjye mwiza! ndicuz'imbere yawe, mwami yes'unkiz'ubu!
hymns.title: Ndeger'Umusaraba

hymns.searchText: mwami mp'umugisha wawe 22 mwami mp'umugisha wawe, uhera bos'ubusa. ndakwinginga ntumpiteho! arik'umpire none. umpire! umpire! ngo ntatahan'ubusa. ntunsige mubyeyi mwiza, ibyaha byandembeje; nkwiriye gucibwa rwose, arik'umbabarire. umpire! umpire! ngo ntatahan'ubusa. niba natinze mu byaha, njya nkubabaza cyane; niba ngoswe n'iby'iyi si, ubinkuremo rwose. umpire! umpire! ngo ntatahan'ubusa. ntumpiteho mwuka wera! niw'uhumur'impumyi. unyemez'uhamya yesu! mbwir'ibimpumuriza. umpire! umpire! ngo ntatahan'ubusa.
hymns.title: Mwami Mp'Umugisha Wawe

hymns.searchText: umpe bibiliya 45 umpe bibiliya kukw'ari y'inezeza, uyinyoboresh'iteka mwami. nta kibasha kuzimy'umucyo wayo, ko yesu yaje kuyitwumvisha. umpe bibiliya kukw'ariy'inezeza, nyoborwe nayo mu nzira ntoya. amategeko yawe niyo meza, agaragaz'inzira y'ukuri. umpe bibiliya mu kababaro kanjye, igihe mpigwa n'ibyaha byanjye. umpe n'amagambo yesu yavuze, kukw'ariyo mez'ampumuriza. umpe bibiliya kukw'ariy'inezeza, nyoborwe nayo mu nzira ntoya. amategeko yawe niyo meza, agaragaz'inzira y'ukuri. umpe bibiliya ngw'imurikir'iteka; kand'indind'imitego yo hasi; niyo rumuri rwaka mu mwijima, runyerek'inzira y'amahoro. umpe bibiliya kukw'ariy'inezeza, nyoborwe nayo mu nzira ntoya. amategeko yawe niyo meza, agaragaz'inzira y'ukuri. umpe bibiliya ngw'imbwir'iby'ubugingo, kand'udukomerez'uwo mucyo. ngo tumeny'inzir'igana mw'ijuru, unyerek'ubwiza bwawe data. umpe bibiliya kukw'ariy'inezeza, nyoborwe nayo mu nzira ntoya. amategeko yawe niyo meza, agaragaz'inzira y'ukuri.
hymns.title: Umpe Bibiliya

hymns.searchText: jy'uhor'undinganirije 46 jy'uhor'undinganirije, amagamb'atunganye. umpugure meny'ukuri, kw'amagambo yawe. nkund'amagambo yawe, kw'ampa kukwizigira. amagambo meza cyane, anter'ibyishimo byinshi; niyo meza, ndayakunda; ntabw'atanezeza. krist'ahet'abantu bose, amagamb'atunganye. nimwitabe banyabyaha! mwumv'iby'ubugingo! abayoboz'ituza, n'amagamb'atunganye. amagambo meza cyane, anter'ibyishimo byinshi; niyo meza, ndayakunda; ntabw'atanezeza. menyesha bos'ubutumwa! n'amagamb'atunganye! nimuze mubabarirwe! mwumv'iby'ubugingo! yesu niwe mukiza, utwonger'ubugingo. amagambo meza cyane, anter'ibyishimo byinshi; niyo meza, ndayakunda; ntabw'atanezeza.
hymns.title: Jy'Uhor'Undinganirije

hymns.searchText: mpagaze ku nkengero ya yorodani 47 mpagaze ku nkengero ya yorodani nubur'amaso, ndor'igihugu cyiza cy'i kanani, nihw'ibyanjye biri. n'igihugu cyiza cy'amahoro, hakurya ku nkengero haratoshye; tuzahavugir'indirimbo ya mose, tubane na yes'iteka. hakurya mur'ibyo bibaya, hahor'umucy'iteka. yesu kristo niw'uzahaber' umucy'ahakur'ijoro. n'igihugu cyiza cy'amahoro, hakurya ku nkengero haratoshye; tuzahavugir'indirimbo ya mose, tubane na yes'iteka. aho heza nzahagera ryari ngo mpabe mpiriwe? nzareba data mu maso ryari nduhukiy'ibwami bwe? n'igihugu cyiza cy'amahoro, hakurya ku nkengero haratoshye; tuzahavugir'indirimbo ya mose, tubane na yes'iteka. mfit'ibyishimo mu mutima, sinshaka kugum'aha. yorodan'isumira hos'ariko ntinyuka kuyambuka. n'igihugu cyiza cy'amahoro, hakurya ku nkengero haratoshye; tuzahavugir'indirimbo ya mose, tubane na yes'iteka.
hymns.title: Mpagaze Ku Nkengero Ya Yorodani

hymns.searchText: tuzishim'imirim'ishize 48 tuzishim'imirim'ishize, abasarurir'imana, bashohoj'umusaruro, i yerusalemu nshya. ishimwe hazabahw'ishimwe, ntabw'ishimwe rizahashira, umunsi w'ishimw'uri hafi, duteranir'iwacu. tuzishima no kuririmba, tuzajya dushima kristo. tuzamuhimbariza rwos' i yerusalemu nshya. ishimwe hazabahw'ishimwe, ntabw'ishimwe rizahashira, umunsi w'ishimw'uri hafi, duteranir'iwacu. tuzahishimira by'ukuri, tuzaba mu mazu yera; yesu yaduteguriye, i yerusalemu nshya. ishimwe hazabahw'ishimwe, ntabw'ishimwe rizahashira, umunsi w'ishimw'uri hafi, duteranir'iwacu.
hymns.title: Tuzishim'Imirim'Ishize

hymns.searchText: ntabwo ndatekereza 49 ntabwo ndatekereza, kw'iwac'ari bugufi. uko bukeye negereza, gusohora mw ijuru. hafi y'iwacu, hafi yaho; ubu ngeze hafi y'iwacu, ngiye gusohorayo. ku rurembo rwa data, hariy'amazu menshi; yateguriy'abera bose, ngo babane na yesu. hafi y'iwacu, hafi yaho; ubu ngeze hafi y'iwacu, ngiye gusohorayo. ninjya kuger'iwacu, nzururuts'umutwaro; nzoroherwa n'umubabaro, nambar'ikamba ryiza. hafi y'iwacu, hafi yaho; ubu ngeze hafi y'iwacu, ngiye gusohorayo. ningera ku nkengero, nzaba ngeze bugufi; nzaba negerey'i muhira, ngiye kuger'iwacu. hafi y'iwacu, hafi yaho; ubu ngeze hafi y'iwacu, ngiye gusohorayo.
hymns.title: Ntabwo Ndatekereza

hymns.searchText: har'igihugu cyiza cyane 50 har'igihugu cyiza cyane, twasezeraniwe n'imana; tugitegereze twizera, ko dat'akitubonereza. aheza (aheza) mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), tuzahurirayo bagenzi. aheza (aheza) mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), tuzahurirayo bagenzi. tuzaririmbira mw'ijuru, indirimbo z'abanyahirwe. ntituzongera kubabara, tuzaba dushiz'agahinda. aheza (aheza) mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), tuzahurirayo bagenzi. aheza (aheza) mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), tuzahurirayo bagenzi. tuzasingiza data cyane, ku mbabazi yatugiriye, no ku buntu bw'urukundo rwe, n'umugisha yatwungukiye. aheza (aheza) mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), tuzahurirayo bagenzi. aheza (aheza) mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), tuzahurirayo bagenzi.
hymns.title: Har'Igihugu Cyiza Cyane

hymns.searchText: tubatirish'umwuka wera 51 tubatirishe umwuka wera, mukiza twegere, duh'urukundo. ubu mwami yesu turakwinginga, tubatirish'umwuka, duh'urukundo. turatakamba, twazize byinshi, udukiz'utweze, twishwe n'ibyaha. ubu mwami yesu turakwinginga, tubatirish'umwuka, duh'urukundo. mwuka wera we, tumanukire! duhire rwos'ubu, duh'imbabazi. ubu mwami yesu turakwinginga, tubatirish'umwuka, duh'urukundo. ngir'ijwi ryiza, ryavuze riti: ur'umwana wanjye, ni wowe nkunda. ubu mwami yesu turakwinginga, tubatirish'umwuka, duh'urukundo.
hymns.title: Tubatirish'Umwuka Wera

hymns.searchText: ngwino soko y 'umugisha 52 ngwino soko y'umugisha, mp'umutim'ugushima. migez'idakama myiza, tugusingize cyane. unyigishe kukuramy'iteka, kandi meny'ubwiza bwawe. kwiringir'ubwami bwawe, kunyuzuz'urukundo. nshyirahw'icyibutso cyanjye, niho ngeze kubwawe. ndizeye yuk'uzanjyana, nger'iwaw'amahoro. yesu yantaruye nazimiye, nari ndi kure y'imana; ashaka kunkiz'urupfu, yatanz'ubugingo bwe. ndimw'ubwishyu bwawe mwami, bw'imbabaz'ungiriye. nyigiza bugufi bwawe, meny'urukundo rwawe. ngoswe n'ibingerageza byinshi, ngo ndek'iyo mana nkunda. akir'umutima wanjye undinde nkire rwose.
hymns.title: Ngwino Soko Y 'Umugisha

hymns.searchText: mwuka wera muyobozi 53 mwuka wera muyobozi, ube hafi y'abakristo! mfat'ukuboko nyobora, nd'umugenzi ku gahinga. abananiwe bishima, ubwo bumv'ijwi ryiza, ribabwira: bagenzi mwe, nimuze mbagez'iwanyu! ntuduhemukir'iteka, ntabwo wanga kudufasha. dukomeze tukwizere, dukabakabe hijimye. amakuba n'aboneka, imitima nikuka, ijwi riti: bagenzi mwe, nimuze mbagez'iwanyu! tumaz'imirimo yacu, dutegereze gukizwa, dusigarany'iby'ijuru, twibaze ko twanditsweyo. twikingir'ibidutera, no kwiringira yesu. ijwi riti: bagenzi mwe, nimuze mbagez'iwanyu!
hymns.title: Mwuka Wera Muyobozi

hymns.searchText: harihw'icyo nkwaka mwami 54 harihw'icyo nkwaka mwami, nubwo mpora ngucumuraho, unyejeshe, unyejeshe! amazi cyangw'umuriro. mpanagurwe hose mwami! n'umuriro nib'ushaka. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. n'untunganiriz'ubwenge, nzanezerwa nzagusingiza; arik'umutima wera, urutaho, urutaho. mpanagurwe hose mwami! n'umuriro nib'ushaka. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. ninezw'umutima wanjye, niho nzunguk'ubwenge bwose, mbubwirijwe nawe mwami, bwo mw'ijuru, bwo mw'ijuru. mpanagurwe hose mwami! n'umuriro nib'ushaka. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. njya nirind'ibicumuro, nkitonder'ibyo ntekereza. mwami n'ibyo nkora byose, ntabwo nera, ntabwo nera. mpanagurwe hose mwami! n'umuriro nib'ushaka. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe. nkir'ibyaha, birimburwe.
hymns.title: Harihw'Icyo Nkwaka Mwami

hymns.searchText: har'ubwo wasanze yesu? 55 har'ubwo wasanze yesu ng'ukire? se wuhagijw'amaraso ye? ubu wizeye rwos'imbabazi ze? se wuhagijw'amaraso ye? wogejwe (wogejwe) na yesu (na yesu)? watunganijwe n'amaraso (maraso)? har'ubwo yakwuhagij'amaraso? mbes'imyambaro yaw'irera? mbes'ugendana na yesu iteka? se wuhagijw'amaraso ye? mbes'ujy'ubana n'uwari wabambwe? se wuhagijw'amaraso ye? wogejwe (wogejwe) na yesu (na yesu)? watunganijwe n'amaraso (maraso)? har'ubwo yakwuhagij'amaraso? mbes'imyambaro yaw'irera? umukwe n'az'uzab'umwiteguye? se wuhagijw'amaraso ye? mbes'uzakundirwa kujya mw'ijuru? no gukizwa n'amaraso ye? wogejwe (wogejwe) na yesu (na yesu)? watunganijwe n'amaraso (maraso)? har'ubwo yakwuhagij'amaraso? mbes'imyambaro yaw'irera? hung'ibyaha jy'ukor'ibitunganye! wejeshw'amaraso ya yesu! har'isokw'itemb'ikiz'imitima, wejeshw'amaraso ya yesu! wogejwe (wogejwe) na yesu (na yesu)? watunganijwe n'amaraso (maraso)? har'ubwo yakwuhagij'amaraso? mbes'imyambaro yaw'irera?
hymns.title: Har'Ubwo Wasanze Yesu?

hymns.searchText: nahabiye kure y'imana 56 nahabiye kure y'imana, ndahabuts'ubu. nari naratinze mu byaha, noneho ndaje. gusubiramo: reka nze, reka nze! ntabwo nzongera. nyemerer'umbabarire! mwami nyakira! narapfapfany'imyaka myinshi, ndahabuts'ubu. ndakwitwaraho cyane nkiza, noneho ndaje. ndembejwe n'ibyaha no kugwa, ndahabuts'ubu. niringiy'urukundo rwawe, noneho ndaje. yesu yamviriy'amaraso, ndahabuts'ubu. ubwe niwe wankiza gusa, noneho ndaje. wumv'amaganya yanjy'unkize, ndahabuts'ubu. nyeza mwami nse n'urubura, noneho ndaje.
hymns.title: Nahabiye Kure Y'Imana

hymns.searchText: bayoboke nimurangurure 57 bayoboke nimurangurure, mwamamaz'ubutumwa mw'isi yose! nimukwiz'ayo makuru mu bantu! abashaka nibaze. uwemey'aze! uwemey'aze! nimubimenyesh'abatuye hasi! umubyey'aratarur'abana be, abashaka nibaze. ushaka kuza yitindiganya, niyinjir'irembo riruguruye. umwami niwe nzira y'ubugingo, abashaka nibaze. uwemey'aze! uwemey'aze! nimubimenyesh'abatuye hasi! umubyey'aratarur'abana be, abashaka nibaze. ushaka wese n'agire bwangu! kand'agir'ubutwari yihangane. ushaka wes'azahabw'ubugingo, abashaka nibaze. uwemey'aze! uwemey'aze! nimubimenyesh'abatuye hasi! umubyey'aratarur'abana be, abashaka nibaze.
hymns.title: Bayoboke Nimurangurure

hymns.searchText: jy'uganza mwami w'iteka 58 jy'uganza mwami w'iteka, bose bakuramye! nimuzan'ikamba ry'ubwami bwe, ab'umwami wa bose! nimuzan'ikamba ry'ubwami bwe, kw'ariwe mwami wa bose. batowe mwe b'israeli, mwa nkehwe mwe nkeya, muramy'ubakirish'imbabazi, ab'umwami wa bose! muramy'ubakirish'imbabazi, kw'ariwe mwami wa bose. amoko yose yo hasi, n'imiryango yose, bose bajye bamwubaha cyane! ab'umwami wa bose. bose bajye bamwubaha cyane! kw'ariwe mwami wa bose. muze tumuririmbire, tumupfukamire, tumusingize no kumushima, ab'umwami wa bose. tumusingize no kumushima, kw'ariwe mwami wa bose.
hymns.title: Jy'Uganza Mwami W'Iteka

hymns.searchText: yesu mukunzi wanjye 59 yesu mukunzi wanjye, mpa kuguhungiraho. ubw'umurab'usuma, n'umugar'ugwa cyane, umpishe mukiza we! kugez'ah'uhitira. unyobor'ahikinze, nuk'unkiz'unyakire! nta bundi buhungiro, mwam'unyirokorere! ntunzibukire rwose, komez'ujy'undengera! nkwizigire wenyine! ni wow'ump'imbaraga, uhashy'abanzi banjye, simpugane na hato. ngushime mwami yesu, k'utagir'icy'unyima, usindagiz'urushye, n'urway'uramukiza; urera bihebuje, ntabwo ngutunganiye, ndi mubi bikabije, wow'urakiranutse. ubabarira cyane, kand'imbabazi zawe, zirut'ibyaha byanjye. nyeza nkomeze nere, we soko y'ubugingo! nkundira nkuvomemo! unyuzur'umutima, nzagere ku bugingo.
hymns.title: Yesu Mukunzi Wanjye

hymns.searchText: yesu utunezeza twese 60 yes'utunezeza twese, soko y'ubuging'ur'umucyo w'abantu; ibyishimo byose byo hasi, tubicitseho tugukurikire. tuvune turakwisunze. ukuri kwawe ntikugir'impinduka; dutabare turakwizeye, tukwiyeguriye tumaramaje. mutsima w'ubugingo we! dushaka guhazwa naw'iteka ryose. soko nziz'idakam'iteka! tumar'inyota mu mitima yacu mu midugararo yacu, tukwifuz'iteka, mwami mwiza rwose. tunezerwa cyan'umwenyuye; n'amahirwe yac'ubwo duhorana. yesu bana natw'iteka! duh'amahoro twishim'iteka ryose! dukiz'ibibi bitugota! murika kw is'umucyo wawe wera!
hymns.title: Yesu Utunezeza Twese

hymns.searchText: nkunda kunguk'ibya yesu 61 nkunda kunguk'ibya yesu, kwerekan'imbabazi ze; kwunguk'ubwenge bw'ukuri, n'urukundo rw'umukiza. nunguk'ibya yesu, nunguk'ibya yesu. kwunguk'ubwenge bw'ukuri, n'urukundo rw'umukiza. nshishikarir'ibya yesu, mmeny'iby'ashaka binkwiye, mwuka wera mfuturira! mbwir'uko yesu yankunze! nunguk'ibya yesu, nunguk'ibya yesu. kwunguk'ubwenge bw'ukuri, n'urukundo rw'umukiza. nunguk'ijambo rya yesu, mbane n'umwam'antoneshe; numvir'iby'ambwira byose, mpuze nawe muyoboke. nunguk'ibya yesu, nunguk'ibya yesu. kwunguk'ubwenge bw'ukuri, n'urukundo rw'umukiza. meny'iby'ingoma ya yesu, menye n'ubwiza bwe bwose, menye n'ukw'agiye kwima, niwe mwami w'amahoro. nunguk'ibya yesu, nunguk'ibya yesu. kwunguk'ubwenge bw'ukuri, n'urukundo rw'umukiza.
hymns.title: Nkunda Kunguk'Ibya Yesu

hymns.searchText: yesu ndagukunze rwose 62 yesu ndagukunze rwose, ndakwihaye. ingeso mbi zose, nzanz'uko zingana. ni wowe mukiza wanjye mwiza, nkuyoboke. ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, nk'ubu ngubu. ndagukunze kuko wabanje, kunkunda, waranyiguriy' unkiriz'i kalvari. ngukundiy'ikamba ry'amahwa, wahambikiwe, ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, nk'ubu ngubu. mperey'ubu ngukunda, nzageza gupfa. nzajya ngusingiz'iteka ngihumeka; nah'urupfu ruzanyegurira, nzavuga nti: ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, nk'ubu ngubu. ubwo nzager'aho, waduteguriye, nzajya mpaguhamiriz'itek'iteka. nzaguhimbaza nambay'ikamba, ritunganye; ntabwo nigeze kugukunda, nk'ubu ngubu.
hymns.title: Yesu Ndagukunze Rwose

hymns.searchText: n'iki cyankiz'ibyaha? 63 n'iki cyankiz'ibyaha? n'amaraso yawe yesu. n'iki cyanyeza rwose? n'amaraso yawe yesu. maras'atunganye, niy'amboneza rwose. nta cyampa gukira, nk'amaraso y'umukiza. nta kindi cyantunganya, n'amaraso yawe yesu. nta kindi cyiru mfite, n'amaraso yawe yesu. maras'atunganye, niy'amboneza rwose. nta cyampa gukira, nk'amaraso y'umukiza. nta cyantsembahw ibyaha, n'amaraso yawe yesu. nta byanjye byamboneza, n'amaraso yawe yesu. maras'atunganye, niy'amboneza rwose. nta cyampa gukira, nk'amaraso y'umukiza. ni wowe niringira, n'amaraso yawe yesu. ni wow'ump'amahoro, n'amaraso yawe yesu. maras'atunganye, niy'amboneza rwose. nta cyampa gukira, nk'amaraso y'umukiza. njye ngusingiza cyane, ku maraso yawe yesu. mukiz'urakarama, ku maraso wamviriye. maras'atunganye, niy'amboneza rwose. nta cyampa gukira, nk'amaraso y'umukiza.
hymns.title: N'Iki Cyankiz'Ibyaha?

hymns.searchText: s'uhagarik'ik'umutima? 64 s'uhagarikiy'ik'umutima? bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! ubabajwe no kubur'ituza? ihererane yesu! bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! niwe nshuti y'ukuri; ntugir'indi nshut'ihwanye nawe, jy'ubana nawe cyane. mbes'ub'urabogoz'amarira? bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! utotezwa n'ibyaha wahishe? ihererane yesu! bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! niwe nshuti y'ukuri; ntugir'indi nshut'ihwanye nawe, jy'ubana nawe cyane. ujy'utinya guterwa n'ibyago? bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! mbes'ub'uraganyishwa n'iby'ejo? ihererane yesu! bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! niwe nshuti y'ukuri; ntugir'indi nshut'ihwanye nawe, jy'ubana nawe cyane. mbes'ujy'ugir'ubwoba bwo gupfa? bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! mbes'urashak'ingoma ya kristo? ihererane yesu! bibwire yesu! bibwire yesu! niwe nshuti y'ukuri; ntugir'indi nshut'ihwanye nawe, jy'ubana nawe cyane.
hymns.title: S'Uhagarik'Ik'Umutima?

hymns.searchText: nkunda kwiringira yesu 65 nkunda kwiringira yesu, nkajya mwumvira rwose, no kwizer'umurage we, n'amateka y'imana. nkoyoboke mwami rwose; najyaga nshidikanya, yesu yesu mwiza nkunda, mfasha nkwumvire rwose! nkunda kwiringira yesu; nkizwa n'amaraso ye. ansendahw ibicumuro, niy'antunganya rwose. nkoyoboke mwami rwose; najyaga nshidikanya, yesu yesu mwiza nkunda, mfasha nkwumvire rwose! nimenya kumwiringira, sinzaba ngicumura. niho nzagir'ubuhoro, n'ubugingo bw'iteka. nkoyoboke mwami rwose; najyaga nshidikanya, yesu yesu mwiza nkunda, mfasha nkwumvire rwose! mpimbawe no kukumenya, yesu mukiza nkunda. nizeye k'umpora hafi, nuko nguman'iteka. nkoyoboke mwami rwose; najyaga nshidikanya, yesu yesu mwiza nkunda, mfasha nkwumvire rwose!
hymns.title: Nkunda Kwiringira Yesu

hymns.searchText: nshim'umunsi nakwemeye 66 nshim'umunsi nakwemeye, mwami yesu mukiza we! nshima cyane n'umutima, ndabwiriz'ibinezeza. mpimbaze, mpimbaze; yesu wankijij'ibyaha. anyigisha kumuramya, ngo nezerw'iminsi yose; mpimbaze, mpimbaze yesu wankijij'ibyaha. biramaze, napfiriwe, nd'uwa yesu wandokoye; yangiz'uwe, nkurikire, nshima yuko ntowe nawe. mpimbaze, mpimbaze; yesu wankijij'ibyaha. anyigisha kumuramya, ngo nezerw'iminsi yose; mpimbaze, mpimbaze yesu wankijij'ibyaha. mutima wanjye ruhuka; reba mw ijur'ahejejwe, ntugasig'umwami wawe, bana nawe mwumvikane. mpimbaze, mpimbaze; yesu wankijij'ibyaha. anyigisha kumuramya, ngo nezerw'iminsi yose; mpimbaze, mpimbaze yesu wankijij'ibyaha. iteka nzagukorera, iby'isi ndabizinutswe. nkugarutseho noneho, sinzarorera kwishima. mpimbaze, mpimbaze; yesu wankijij'ibyaha. anyigisha kumuramya, ngo nezerw'iminsi yose; mpimbaze, mpimbaze yesu wankijij'ibyaha. ubw'umucyo wo mw'ijuru uzamurikir'iyi si. nsanganir'umwami wanjye, tuzibanire mw'ijuru. mpimbaze, mpimbaze; yesu wankijij'ibyaha. anyigisha kumuramya, ngo nezerw'iminsi yose; mpimbaze, mpimbaze yesu wankijij'ibyaha.

hymns.searchText: sinita ku butunzi 71 sinita ku butunzi, feza na zahabu. ndashak'ibyo mw'ijuru; nzajyane n'abera. yesu mukiza mbwira: igitabo cyawe, cyera cy'ubwami bwawe, mbese nanditswemo? mbese nanditswemo, ku mpapuro zera? mu gitabo cy'ubwami, mbese nanditswemo? ibyaha byanjye mwami, birut'umusenyi. ngwino mwam'ubinkirish'amaraso yawe! wadusezeraniye, yukw ibyaha byacu, nibisa n'umuhemba, ng'uzabyeza rwose. mbese nanditswemo, ku mpapuro zera? mu gitabo cy'ubwami, mbese nanditswemo? mu mudugudu mwiza, n'amazu yera de, n'abera bawurimo, barimban'ibyera, nta bibi biwegera, byakwanduz'ibyiza, niho hab'amahoro, mbese nanditswemo? mbese nanditswemo, ku mpapuro zera? mu gitabo cy'ubwami, mbese nanditswemo?

hymns.searchText: umwami yaradutumiye 73 umwami niw'udutumira, ngw'aduteranye n'ubwoko bwe. azasanga tumeze dute, ahw'azazira? mwana wa data we tyo se: ubw'umwam'azaza, twebwe tuzamera dute? umwami n'aza? tuzatamirizw'amakamba, uwaducunguye yimitswe, tuzahorana naw'iteka, ahw'azazira. mwana wa data we tyo se: ubw'umwam'azaza, twebwe tuzamera dute? umwami n'aza? nkuk'umuraby'ugaragara, nikw'azagaragaza byose; azerekan'ibyo twakoze, ahw azazira. mwana wa data we tyo se: ubw'umwam'azaza, twebwe tuzamera dute? umwami n'aza? azishim'ubw'azabon'abe, bambay'imyambaro yera de. nituganza tuzanezerwa, ahw'azazira. mwana wa data we tyo se: ubw'umwam'azaza, twebwe tuzamera dute? umwami n'aza? ntabwo tuzongera gutana, abanga kumwumvira bose, bazataka no kuboroga, yes'agarutse. mwana wa data we tyo se: ubw'umwam'azaza, twebwe tuzamera dute? umwami n'aza? mwami ni wowe twiringiye; twigishe kugutegereza, tutazatinya kukubona, ah'uzazira. mwana wa data we tyo se: ubw'umwam'azaza, twebwe tuzamera dute? umwami n'aza?

hymns.searchText: imins'itandat'ishize 90 imins'itandat'ishize, indi sabat'itangiye. nezezwa no kuruhuka, mur'uyu muns'uhiriwe. nimuze mushim'umwami, wabahaye kuruhuka. umugisha w'uyu munsi, urut'uw'iyindi yose. tunezerwe mu mitima, twishimir'ibyo mw'ijuru. mu buruhukiro bwacu, ku mwami nyir'isabato. ituza riva mw'ijuru, ritwuzure twebwe twese, hos'itorero ry'imana, rikir'imitima myinshi.

hymns.searchText: naratuwe mu gipimo 109 umucamanza n'agera, akarondor'ibyacu, tuzamera nk'izahabu, cyangwa s'inkamb'itabwa? naratuwe mu gipimo, nsangwa ntashyitse; naratuwe n'ijambo rye, nsangwa ntashyitse. mbese tuzumv'ishimwe ngo: nuko, wakoze neza; cyangw'iteka ryo gupfa ngo: mwasanzwe mudashyitse? naratuwe mu gipimo, nsangwa ntashyitse; naratuwe n'ijambo rye, nsangwa ntashyitse. nimutyo twite kw'ijwi rye, igihe kikiriho. tureke gutindiganya, tumaramaze rwose. naratuwe mu gipimo, nsangwa ntashyitse; naratuwe n'ijambo rye, nsangwa ntashyitse.
hymns.title: Naratuwe Mu Gipimo

hymns.searchText: wumv'amagambo y'umukiza 110 wumv'amagambo y'umukiza; niy'aguhesh'ubugingo. wa munyabyaha we, menya ko hahirw'abakomez'amategeko. hahirw'abayakomeza yose, nibo bahirwa, barahirwa; hahirw'abayakomeza yose, barahirwa, barahirwa. kuyumva gusa nta kamaro, n'ukutugwabiza rwose; kuyumva dutinya, ntibyadukiza, hahirw'abayumvira yose. hahirw'abayakomeza yose, nibo bahirwa, barahirwa; hahirw'abayakomeza yose, barahirwa, barahirwa. bazinjiran'umunezero mu mudugudu w'imana, ahatab'ishavu n'umubabaro, beger'igiti cy'ubugingo. hahirw'abayakomeza yose, nibo bahirwa, barahirwa; hahirw'abayakomeza yose, barahirwa, barahirwa.
hymns.title: Wumv'Amagambo Y'Umukiza

hymns.searchText: nta nshuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu 111 nta nshuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu; nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! nta wundi wabasha kudukiza; nta wundi! nta wundi! yes'az'ibiturushya byose; azabana natw'iteka. nta ncuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu, nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! nta nshut'ibahw'ikomeye nka we; nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! nyamara nta wiyoroshya nka we; nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe! yes'az'ibiturushya byose; azabana natw'iteka. nta ncuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu, nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! nta kanya na gato tutabana; ye nta ko! ye nta ko! nta joro ryira tutari kumwe; ye nta ryo! ye nta ryo! yes'az'ibiturushya byose; azabana natw'iteka. nta ncuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu, nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! mbese har'uwo yigez'ahana? nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe! mbese har'umunyabyah'aheza? nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe! yes'az'ibiturushya byose; azabana natw'iteka. nta ncuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu, nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! harihw'impano yahwana nawe? nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe! mbese har'uwo yavuts'ijuru? nta n'umwe! nta n'umwe! yes'az'ibiturushya byose; azabana natw'iteka. nta ncuti nziz'ihwanye na yesu, nta n'imwe! nta n'imwe!

lines: Ye nta ko! ye nta ko!
Ye nta ryo! ye nta ryo!

hymns.title: Nta Nshuti Nziz'Ihwanye Na Yesu

hymns.searchText: kurabukw'umusaraba wawe 112 kurabukw'umusaraba wawe, mwami nibyo byambeshaho; sinita ku manjwe y'iby'isi, ntez'agakiza ku musaraba. kurabukw'i golgota, nibyo bizambeshaho. mbeg'amahirwe yanjye, yo kurabukwa yesu! kurabu … go… golgota, nibyo bi … mbe … mbeshaho. mbeg'amahirwe yanjye…rwe yanjye, yo kurabukwa yesu! …rabukwa yesu. ubwo nari nkibon'umukiza, yanyakirany'ibyishimo; na n'ubu ningir'ibindwanya, kumurabukwa nibyo byankiza. kurabukw'i golgota, nibyo bizambeshaho. mbeg'amahirwe yanjye, yo kurabukwa yesu! kurabu … go… golgota, nibyo bi … mbe … mbeshaho. mbeg'amahirwe yanjye…rwe yanjye, yo kurabukwa yesu! …rabukwa yesu. nzajya mpang'amas'umusaraba, kandi mwiringire rwose. nta wutumbir'umusaraba, wari wiger'aneshwa n'umwanzi. kurabukw'i golgota, nibyo bizambeshaho. mbeg'amahirwe yanjye, yo kurabukwa yesu! kurabu … go… golgota, nibyo bi … mbe … mbeshaho. mbeg'amahirwe yanjye…rwe yanjye, yo kurabukwa yesu! …rabukwa yesu.
hymns.title: Kurabukw'Umusaraba Wawe

hymns.searchText: yesu araguhamagaran'ituza 113 yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, ub'arahamagara; ategereje k'umwiyegurira, we kuzuyaza; ngwino. ngwino (ngwino); ngwino (ngwino); abarushye mwese nimuze. yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, ati: mukundwa, ngwino. twatinzwa n'iki, kand'ategereje kuturokora twese? twahinyuzwa n'ik'imbabazi zose adufitiye twese? ngwino (ngwino); ngwino (ngwino); abarushye mwese nimuze. yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, ati: mukundwa, ngwino. twakererew'ibihe birahita, aradutegereje; turarindagirira mu mwijima; nimutyo tumusange. ngwino (ngwino); ngwino (ngwino); abarushye mwese nimuze. yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, ati: mukundwa, ngwino. zirikan'urukundo ruhebuje, yadusezeranije; n'ubwo twagomye, tuzababarirwa; aradutegereje. ngwino (ngwino); ngwino (ngwino); abarushye mwese nimuze. yes'araguhamagaran'ituza, ati: mukundwa, ngwino.
hymns.title: Yesu Araguhamagaran'Ituza

hymns.searchText: har'irembo ryuguruyeh 114 har'irembo ryuguruwe, ryatumye mpishurirwa. umusaraba wa kure, yesu yatangiyeho. mbeg'ineza n'imbabazi byatumye nugururirwa! nugururiwe, iman'ihimbazwe! irembo ryugururiwe abashak'agakiza; ngw'abakire n'abakene bose barinyuremo. mbeg'ineza n'imbabazi byatumye nugururirwa! nugururiwe, iman'ihimbazwe! nshuti komez'utwaran'irembo ricyuguruwe. ikorer'umusaraba; nibw'uzahabw'ikamba. mbeg'ineza n'imbabazi byatumye nugururirwa! nugururiwe, iman'ihimbazwe! tumaze kwambuk'uruzi, dute wa musaraba; twambikw'amakamba meza, twitahire mw'ijuru. mbeg'ineza n'imbabazi byatumye nugururirwa! nugururiwe, iman'ihimbazwe!
hymns.title: Har'Irembo RyuguruyeH

hymns.searchText: umukiz'ageze hafih 115 umukiz'ageze hafi, yes'umukunzi wanjye. yazanywe no guhembura; mwese nimumwumvire. nta wuhwany'izina nawe, rirut'amazina yose. nta wusingizwa nkawe; yesu mwiza rwose. icyubahiro kib'icye; mutyo twizere yesu. nkund'izina ry'umukiza; nkund'izina rya yesu. nta wuhwany'izina nawe, rirut'amazina yose. nta wusingizwa nkawe; yesu mwiza rwose. izina rye rirankiza, rikamar'agahinda. nta kinezeza nko kumva, iryo zina rya yesu. nta wuhwany'izina nawe, rirut'amazina yose. nta wusingizwa nkawe; yesu mwiza rwose. n'az'azatugororera, ikamba ry'ubugingo. ubwo nibwo tuzicara, tuvug'iby'agakiza. nta wuhwany'izina nawe, rirut'amazina yose. nta wusingizwa nkawe; yesu mwiza rwose.
hymns.title: Umukiz'Ageze HafiH

hymns.searchText: ntacyo wasigiye yesu 116 dor'umutima wawe, wuzuyemw'amaganya. nta mwanya wasigiye yesu ngo yinjiremo? ub'ahagaze ku rugi, arakomanga yinginga. nta mwanya wasigiye yesu ngo yinjiremo? upfush'igih'ubusa, kand'ar'ingenzi rwose. mbese nta mwany'ufite wo gukorera yesu? nturarushy'ugerageza gutarur'abazimiye; mbese nta mwany'ufite wo gukorera yesu? mbese k'umaranira kwishakir'ubutunzi, nta gih'ufite washishikarir'ibya yesu? dor'uharanira kwikubir'ibinezeza by'isi; nta gih'ufite washishikarir'ibya yesu? wabay'ingumba nk'igiti cy'ibibabi gusa. mbese ntabwo wazerer'umwami yes'imbuto? ntacy'ufite cyo kuzamumurikira n'agaruka; mbese ntabwo wazerer'umwami yes'imbuto?

lines: Nta mwanya wasigiye Yesu ngo yinjiremo?

hymns.searchText: mwami ndumv'ijwi ryawe 117 mwami ndumv'ijwi ryawe, rindarika ngo nze, nuhagizwe ya maraso, wamviriye kera. mukiza ndaje, ubu nj'ah'uri! nyejesha ya maraso, wamviriye kera. n'ubwo nje nahindanye, ntunyirengagize; ahubw'umboneze rwose, mb'umweru waka de. mukiza ndaje, ubu nj'ah'uri! nyejesha ya maraso, wamviriye kera. yesu niw'unkomeza, niw'umpa gutsinda; ng'urukundo n'amahoro, binsabemo rwose. mukiza ndaje, ubu nj'ah'uri! nyejesha ya maraso, wamviriye kera. mwese nimwishimire! ya maras'akiza, yatwujuje na rurema, ngo tub'abana be. mukiza ndaje, ubu nj'ah'uri! nyejesha ya maraso, wamviriye kera.
hymns.title: Mwami Ndumv'Ijwi Ryawe

hymns.searchText: ndumv'umukiz'ambwira 118 ndumv'umukiz'ambwira, ko mbuz'imbaraga; ngo: njye museng'iteka, ntacyo nzamuburana. yanndihiriye imyenda yose; yambabariy'ibyaha, bihinduk'umweru. niw'ufit'imbaraga, zihagije rwose; zo gukiz'ababembe, zikoroshy'umutima. yanndihiriye imyenda yose; yambabariy'ibyaha, bihinduk'umweru. ubwo nta cyiza nkora, nibesherejweho; n'ubuntu bwawe gusa, ni wowe nkesha byose. yanndihiriye imyenda yose; yambabariy'ibyaha, bihinduk'umweru. imbere ya ya ntebe, nzahahagarara; nzaba njyany'iminyago, nyishyikirize yesu. yanndihiriye imyenda yose; yambabariy'ibyaha, bihinduk'umweru.
hymns.title: Ndumv'Umukiz'Ambwira

hymns.searchText: harihw'isokw'itukura 119 harihw'isokw'itukura, ivamw'amaraso; niy'umwami yamviriye, ngw'ayandokoreshe. nduz'umuvu w'amaraso; ndayogamo nere rwose! haleluya! aranyeza, aranyeza, aranyeza! mpinduts'icyaremwe gishya, mbyaw'ubwa kabiri. ntsinze kamere ya kera, nzahora ndi mushya. nduz'umuvu w'amaraso; ndayogamo nere rwose! haleluya! aranyeza, aranyeza, aranyeza! nsigaye mvirwa n'umucyo, sinkirindagira; nshitse ku ngoyi z'umwanzi, mbatuwe na yesu. nduz'umuvu w'amaraso; ndayogamo nere rwose! haleluya! aranyeza, aranyeza, aranyeza! mbeg'ubuntu butangaje! kwejeshw'amaraso! byanyujuje n'umukiza, yesu wambambiwe. nduz'umuvu w'amaraso; ndayogamo nere rwose! haleluya! aranyeza, aranyeza, aranyeza!
hymns.title: Harihw'Isokw'Itukura

hymns.searchText: data ndambuy'amaboko 120 data, ndambuy'amaboko; nta wundi wamfasha; iy'unyivumburiy'ukamvaho, mbes'ahandi najya ni he? nizey'umwana waw'ubu, undem'umutima; ujy'unkenur'umar'ubukene, nkomeze nemerwe nawe. nyir'ukwizera ni wowe, nuburiy'amaso; icyamp'ukangwiriza kwizera, kuko ntagufite napfa. ntuzantererane ngo mpfe, ahubw'umbesheho; nibwo nzacika ku kinyoma, mbishobojwe n'umwuka wawe. nakwishima cyane rwose, nibaniye nawe; maze nkakumv'umpumuriz'umbwira ko nagiriw'ubuntu. nizeye rwos'ubu yuko, yesu yampfiriye; kandi kubw'amaraso ye yeza, nzabaturwa mve mu byaha.
hymns.title: Data Ndambuy'Amaboko

hymns.searchText: nzasingiz'urukundo rwa yesu 121 nzasingiz'urukundo rwa yesu, wambambiwe; yemeye kumanuka, azanywe no kumpfira. nzasingiz'urukundo rwe; mpimbaze, yaramfiriye, ashaka kumbeshaho; nzahora muhimbaza. yesu yambabarijwe, ntararushya mbabara; yahoze ansabira, ntarameny'iyo bijya. nzasingiz'urukundo rwe; mpimbaze, yaramfiriye, ashaka kumbeshaho; nzahora muhimbaza. urukundo rw'imana, mbega ngo rurankiza! ibyaha byanjye byose, bikantamururwaho! nzasingiz'urukundo rwe; mpimbaze, yaramfiriye, ashaka kumbeshaho; nzahora muhimbaza. nta cyiza nakoreye, umwami wankunz'atyo; none maze kwemezwa, mwami nguhaye byose. nzasingiz'urukundo rwe; mpimbaze, yaramfiriye, ashaka kumbeshaho; nzahora muhimbaza.
hymns.title: Nzasingiz'Urukundo Rwa Yesu

hymns.searchText: nyigiza hafi 122 nyigiza hafi, mbane nawe; nta cyandutira kubana nawe. ngumisha mu gituza cyawe; mpisha nibere mu buhungiro; mpisha nibere mu buhungiro. nyigiza hafi, ntacyo mfite; ntacyo nzanyehw'ituro ry'umwami, kerets'umutim'ushavuye; mpa kuhagizw'amaraso yawe; mpa kuhagizw'amaraso yawe. nyigiza hafi, mwami wanjye; nishimiye gucika ku byaha. ndeke kwikuza n'ubwibone; umpe yes'umwami wambambiwe; umpe yes'umwami wambambiwe. nyigiza hafi, ngihumeka; kugez'ubwo nzager'i budapfa; maze mu bihe bidashira, nzibere hafi y'umwami wanjye; nzibere hafi y'umwami wanjye.
hymns.title: Nyigiza Hafi

hymns.searchText: har'izina rihebuje 123 har'izina rihebuje, rirut'ayandi yose nzi; ni ry'imana yaturemye yis'umwana way'ikunda. ni ryo zina ryera (izina); ni ryo zina ryera (ryera de)! ryakomotse ku mana, riza mw'isi, maze riririmbwa (izina) n'abamarayika (ryera de). iryo zina n'irya yesu. niryo rimpesh'umugisha; nkunda kuryogez'iteka. simpwema kuriririmba, mvug'ukuntu rihebuje. ni ryo zina ryera (izina); ni ryo zina ryera (ryera de)! ryakomotse ku mana, riza mw'isi, maze riririmbwa (izina) n'abamarayika (ryera de). iryo zina n'irya yesu. icyampa nkaririmbana n'abamarayika bera, nkajya nsingiza rya zina rihebuj'ayandi yose! ni ryo zina ryera (izina); ni ryo zina ryera (ryera de)! ryakomotse ku mana, riza mw'isi, maze riririmbwa (izina) n'abamarayika (ryera de). iryo zina n'irya yesu.
hymns.title: Har'Izina Rihebuje

hymns.searchText: yesu gusa 124 yesu gusa, niw'ukwiriy'ikuzo; naho jyewe, ntacyo ndi cyo rwose; sinkwiriye kub'ari jyew'uratwa; yesu gusa, niw'uzajy'uvugwa. yesu gusa, niw'umar'agahinda; naho jyewe nd'uwo gushavura. sinshobora kwikorer'ibindushya; naho yesu nta kimushengura. yesu gusa, ab'ari we wogezwa; sinkwiriye kwiratan'ibyanjye. yesu gusa, niw'uzambonekamo; kugez'ubwo nzahinduka nka we. yesu gusa niw'umar'ubukene; niwe gusa nkesh'ibyanjye byose. yesu gusa, niw'undutira byose; yesu mwami twibanir'iteka.

lines: Naho jyewe, ntacyo ndi cyo rwose;

hymns.title: Yesu Gusa

hymns.searchText: nk'ukw'izuba rituvira 125 nkukw'izuba rituvira, rikarabagirana, nik'umucyo wo mw'ijuru wansabye mu mutima, wawukuyemw'iby'amanjwe, utangaz'ibihishwe; kuko mu mutima wanjye, nahatuj'umukiza. mbeg'umucyo w'agatangaza, wansabye mu mutima! ineza y'umwami yesu, yambereye nk'umucyo. natay'agahinda kose; ntabwo nkikitayeho; kuk'unyambik'amahoro, ameze nk'umwitero, nkwerekejeh'umutima, ndakwishimiye cyane. nzagezw'i wawe mw'ijuru, na rwa rukundo rwawe. mbeg'umucyo w'agatangaza, wansabye mu mutima! ineza y'umwami yesu, yambereye nk'umucyo. mukiza warancunguye; nd'uwaw'uko ndi kose. nyemerera nguhimbaze, nkuber'umucyo waka. nkwerekejeh'umutima, ndakwishimiye cyane. nzagezw'i wawe mw'ijuru, na rwa rukundo rwawe. mbeg'umucyo w'agatangaza, wansabye mu mutima! ineza y'umwami yesu, yambereye nk'umucyo.
hymns.title: Nk'Ukw'Izuba Rituvira

hymns.searchText: njya nkunda kuririmb'indirimbo 126 njya nkunda kuririmb'indirimbo, ngo yarancunguye. niwe waciy'ingoyi z'umwanzi, maz'arambatura. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, kuk'ubwe yancunguye; nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. mfit'umukiz'unogeye rwose, niwe wancunguye. mpimbazwa no gukor'iby'ashaka, kuko yancunguye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, kuk'ubwe yancunguye; nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. nzahora mpamya ntacyo nikenga, yuko yancunguye. sinzashidikanya ngo ncogore, kuko yancunguye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, kuk'ubwe yancunguye; nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. mfit'aho yanteguriye heza, kuko yancunguye. niho nzibanira naw'iteka, kuko yancunguye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzaririmbir'uwandokoye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye; kuk'ubwe yancunguye, nzahimbaz'izina rye. kuk'ubwe yancunguye, kuk'ubwe yancunguye; nzaririmbir'uwandokoye.
hymns.title: Njya Nkunda Kuririmb'Indirimbo

hymns.searchText: iman'ikund'utunyoni 127 iman'ikund'utunyoni, tuba mur'iyi si; ubwo yita ku tunyoni, nzi ko nanjy'inkunda. irankunda, irankunda; nzi ko nanjy'inkunda; kukw'ikund'utuntu duto, nzi ko nanjy'inkunda. niy'irimbish'uburabyo, buhumura neza; ubw'ikund'uburaby'ityo, nzi ko nanjy'inkunda. irankunda, irankunda; nzi ko nanjy'inkunda; kukw'ikund'utuntu duto, nzi ko nanjy'inkunda. imana yaremye byose, ntigir'icy'isobwa. nzi kw'ikund'abana bose, nzi ko nanjy'inkunda. irankunda, irankunda; nzi ko nanjy'inkunda; kukw'ikund'utuntu duto, nzi ko nanjy'inkunda.
hymns.title: Iman'Ikund'Utunyoni

hymns.searchText: n'igihe cyo gusengat 128 n'igihe cyo gusenga, umwam'ari hafi, kand'adufitiy'ibambe rya kibyeyi. tumuganyir'ibyacu, dushir'agahinda; mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kumvikana nawe! n'igihe cyiza cyo kuramy'umwami, mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira na we! n'igihe cyo gusenga, no gushyikirana, n'imana yac'ihor'ituzirikana, iturem'agatima, tub'indahangarwa; mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kumvikana nawe! n'igihe cyiza cyo kuramy'umwami, mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira na we! n'igihe cyo gusenga, twiringiye yesu. twizeye kw'azaduh'ibyo, tumusaba, kukw'atangan'ubuntu, ataziganije. mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo gutabarwa nawe! n'igihe cyiza cyo kuramy'umwami, mbeg'ihumure ryiza, ryo kwibanira na we!
hymns.title: N'Igihe Cyo Gusengat

hymns.searchText: mbes'abasaruzi bari he? 150 mbes'abasaruzi bari hehe, bo gusarur'abakiranutsi? babangir'ukurink'imihoro, kandi ntibab'ar'abanyabute. abasaruzi se bari he? ngo bafatanye natwe gusarura, maze twishime, turi kumwe, isarura nirirangira. mushakire mu mihana yose; nubw'urwiri rwarenga ku ngano; muzishake kuko zirurimo, zose muzisarurir'imana. abasaruzi se bari he? ngo bafatanye natwe gusarura, maze twishime, turi kumwe, isarura nirirangira. dor'imirima yereye rimwe, kandi bose bitez'isarura; arikw'abasaruzi ni bake, umurimo wab'urabasaze. abasaruzi se bari he? ngo bafatanye natwe gusarura, maze twishime, turi kumwe, isarura nirirangira. mwa bantu mwe, mwahur'imihoro! musarur'igihe kirageze! mushishikare umwam'araje; dor'abazaniy'ingororano! abasaruzi se bari he? ngo bafatanye natwe gusarura, maze twishime, turi kumwe, isarura nirirangira.

hymns.searchText: ngamij'iby'igihugu cy'igikundiro 151 ngamij'iby'igihugu cy'igikundiro; nzageray'izuba rirenze. ariko s'ikamba yes'azamperayo, azaritakahw'inyenyeri? mbes'ikamba ryanjye yes'azamperayo, azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? ningir'amahirwe, nkabana na yesu, azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? reka nkore, nsenge, mbiheshejwe nawe, mugarurir'abazimiye. n'agaruka kuri wa munsi w'ubwiza, nzatakwehw'inyenyeri nyinshi. mbes'ikamba ryanjye yes'azamperayo, azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? ningir'amahirwe, nkabana na yesu, azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? mbeg'umunezer'uhebuje nzagira, nimwerek'abo nakijije, mfite n'ibyishimo bitavugwa, mbonye inyenyeri kw'ikamba ryanjye. mbes'ikamba ryanjye yes'azamperayo, azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)? ningir'amahirwe, nkabana na yesu, azaritakahw'inyenyeri (inyenyeri)?
hymns.title: Ngamij'Iby'Igihugu Cy'Igikundiro

hymns.searchText: ngwino yesu 152 ngwino yes'uvugane, n'umutima wanjye: maz'umpumuriz'uti: ntabwo nagusize. nyugurur'umutima, nihutire kumva, ijwi ryawe ry'impuhwe, nyuzuz'ibyishimo. mbwiz'ijwi ryongorera, mbwiran'urukundo; ut'uzanesh'iteka, ub'umudendezo. vugana nanjy'iteka, mbwir'ubudahwema, reka numv'uk'umbwira ngo: sinaguhanye. yobora abana bawe, uvugane nabo; ubuzuz'ibyishimo, bige kugusenga. mwami, bitange rwose, bakwiyegurire; tebuts'ubwami bwawe, twibanire nawe. mbwiz'ijwi ryongorera, mbwiran'urukundo; ut'uzanesh'iteka, ub'umudendezo. vugana nanjy'iteka, mbwir'ubudahwema, reka numv'uk'umbwira ngo: sinaguhanye. ngwin'uvugane natwe, uduhishurire, iby'imigambi yawe, n'inshingano yacu, duhe kuguhimbaza, tukubahirize, tujye tunezererwa gukor'iby'ushaka. mbwiz'ijwi ryongorera, mbwiran'urukundo; ut'uzanesh'iteka, ub'umudendezo. vugana nanjy'iteka, mbwir'ubudahwema, reka numv'uk'umbwira ngo: sinaguhanye.
hymns.title: Ngwino Yesu

hymns.searchText: mwami, sinsabir'iby'ejo 153 mwami, sinsabir'iby'ejo, mfasha none, ndind'urukongi rw'ibyaha, uyu munsi. ne gucumuz'ururimi, mputiyeho; mwami, rind'iminwa yanjye, uyu munsi. njye nshunguz'ubury'umwete, no gusenga; ngwe neza mu buryo bwose, uyu munsi. nkomeze nkor'iby'ushaka, ngire bwangu; mwami, nemere kwitanga, uyu munsi. urupfu niruntungura, mbe ntunganye; amasezerano yawe, ndayiteze; mwami, sinsabir'iby'ejo, mfasha none; ndind'unkomez'undagire, uyu munsi; amen.

lines: Ngwe neza mu buryo bwose, Uyu munsi.

hymns.title: Mwami, Sinsabir'Iby'Ejo

hymns.searchText: murinzi we, ngaho mbwira 154 murinzi we, ngaho mbwira, mbese bugiye gucya? nta bimenyets'urabona, k'umwami yegereje? mugenzi we haguruka! umusek'uratambitse; tyo kenyera, maz'ukeshe, haguruka; bwakeye! murinzi we, dor'umucyo, ukomeje gukwira! reba naw'ibimenyetso, bitangaza kuza kwe. ubw'impanda zizavuga, abapfuye bazazuka. ubutazongera gupfa, bibanire n'umwami. murinzi we, vuz'impundu, igihe kirageze! mwese nimurangurure, mubyamamaze hose. mugenzi we, nawe reba; ubwami bugeze hafi; ngiriya yerusalemu, irarabagirana. murinzi, mur'uwo murwa, w'igikundiro rwose, nih'umwami w'i sioni, adutegerereje. ubwami bwe buragutse, buhetuy'iyi si yose; n'ubwami budahanguka; hahirw'ababujyamo. murinzi dor'igihugu, cy'uburumbuke cyane, gihora kimeze neza, nka edeni ya kera. gira bwangu ntuzarire, hasigay'igihe gito, abacungujw'amaraso bakagerayo vuba.
hymns.title: Murinzi We, Ngaho Mbwira

hymns.searchText: aho nzahamagarwa hose 155 aho nzahamagarwa hose, ari no mu misozi, cyangwa ku rugamba rukaze, mubyeyi, n'unkenera, ukambwiz'ijwi ryawe ritoya, ukannyuz'inzira ntazi, nzakwishyira mu maboko, mvuge nti: nzajy'ah'unshakira hose. nzajy'ah'unshakira hose, mwami; mu misozi no mu bibaya. nzavug'iby'ushaka ko mvuga mwami, kandi nzaba nk'uk'ushaka. ahari yes'ashaka yuko muvugir'uyu munsi; ahari habonek'impabe, nkwiriye guhabura; murokozi wanjye, n'unyobora, n'ahar'ibihanamanga; sinzareka kogez'inkuru yawe; nzajy'ah'unshakira hose. nzajy'ah'unshakira hose, mwami; mu misozi no mu bibaya. nzavug'iby'ushaka ko mvuga mwami, kandi nzaba nk'uk'ushaka. ntabwo nshidikanya, har'aho mwam'ushaka ko nkora, mu kubaho kwanjye kugufi, nkorer'uwambambiwe. mwami, nkubikij'ibyanjye byose, nzi k'unkunda bitangaje. nzakor'iby'ushaka, mbikunze cyane; nzajy'ah'unshakira hose. nzajy'ah'unshakira hose, mwami; mu misozi no mu bibaya. nzavug'iby'ushaka ko mvuga mwami, kandi nzaba nk'uk'ushaka.
hymns.title: Aho Nzahamagarwa Hose

hymns.searchText: amagambo y'umujinya 156 amagambo y'umujinya, ntakabave mu kanwa! ahubw'umutim'uyacuby'atararushy'asohoka. mukundane rwose; yes'aravug'ati: ngir'itegeko ryanjye mbahaye: mukundane rwose, yes'aravug'ati: bana banjye, mukundane. mukundane, mukundane; ngir'itegeko ryanjye: mukundane, mukundane; n'itegeko rye. urukundo n'imbonera, n'ubucuti, birera; byab'ishyano kubyicisha, ubupfu bw'akanya gato. mukundane rwose; yes'aravug'ati: ngir'itegeko ryanjye mbahaye: mukundane rwose, yes'aravug'ati: bana banjye, mukundane. mukundane, mukundane; ngir'itegeko ryanjye: mukundane, mukundane; n'itegeko rye. amagambo y'intonganya, ntaregama mu kanwa, ijambo rimwe ry'intonganya, ritandukany'inshuti. mukundane rwose; yes'aravug'ati: ngir'itegeko ryanjye mbahaye: mukundane rwose, yes'aravug'ati: bana banjye, mukundane. mukundane, mukundane; ngir'itegeko ryanjye: mukundane, mukundane; n'itegeko rye.
hymns.title: Amagambo Y'Umujinya

hymns.searchText: n'igihe cy'isarura 157 nib'umunt'agend'arira, asohoy'imbuto nziza, ntacogora ngw'agw'isari, ahirwa n'uwiteka. yemwe ga ngo zirakura! reba uko zingana! imirima yos'ireze, n'igihe cy'isarura. ikime kiva mw'ijuru, n'umucy'urabagirana. bizatum'imbuto zera, kubw'ubuntu bw'imana. yemwe ga ngo zirakura! reba uko zingana! imirima yos'ireze, n'igihe cy'isarura. bib'imbuto wicogora, woye gukuk'umutima, n'ubw'iby'ubon'ar'umwaku, uzasarur'ishimwe. yemwe ga ngo zirakura! reba uko zingana! imirima yos'ireze, n'igihe cy'isarura.
hymns.title: N'Igihe Cy'Isarura

hymns.searchText: isarura ry'isi riregereje 158 isarura ry'isi riregereje, yes'arahamagar'abasaruzi. dor'imirim'irez'ahantu hose, nimuzan'imihoro musarure! mugire bwangu, muhunik'imiba; mugire bwangu, nimuze. mugire bwangu mwese; nimuze muhunik'imiba ye. nimuze mugire bwangu mwese; nimuze mwese nimuze. uwo muns'utazabamw'amarira, uhora wegerej'uko bukeye. imyaka yararitswe n'umuyaga, mugire bwangw'imvur'itarahanguka. mugire bwangu, muhunik'imiba; mugire bwangu, nimuze. mugire bwangu mwese; nimuze muhunik'imiba ye. nimuze mugire bwangu mwese; nimuze mwese nimuze. urukundo ni nk'isokw'idakama, ituruka mw'ijuru ku muremyi; nirwo ruturarikira gukora, rukadukomeza ntitugw'isari. mugire bwangu, muhunik'imiba; mugire bwangu, nimuze. mugire bwangu mwese; nimuze muhunik'imiba ye. nimuze mugire bwangu mwese; nimuze mwese nimuze.
hymns.title: Isarura Ry'Isi Riregereje

hymns.searchText: nyabun'uburyo ngukennye! 159 nyabun'uburyo ngukennye! nd'umukene n'impumyi; mfat'ukubok'unyobore, ni wow'ump'imbaraga. ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwami ndagushak'iteka; ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwam'unyikomereze. nyambik'urukundo rwawe, nahindanye nd'intebyi. ubu mfit'intege nkeya, nyongeramw'imbaraga. ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwami ndagushak'iteka; ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwam'unyikomereze. nzab'amahor'unyoboye, sinakwiyiringira. yes'ujy'ungend'i ruhande, kuk'undutira byose. ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwami ndagushak'iteka; ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwam'unyikomereze. nubw'ibind'imbere byose, byankoma mu nkokora, nzakomeza komatana nawe, mwana w'imana. ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwami ndagushak'iteka; ku manywa na n'ijoro; mwam'unyikomereze.
hymns.title: Nyabun'Uburyo Ngukennye!

hymns.searchText: icyampa nkab'uwawe 160 icyampa nkab'uwawe, yesu mwami wanjye; ne kononwa n'iby'isi, nkwikurikirire. icyampa nkab'uwawe, nitanze maramaje. jye ntacyo maze, ntacyo, ntacyo; niwe mpay'ikuzo. icyampa nkab'uwawe, yesu mwami wanjye. nkoresh'uk'ushaka, njye nkubahiriza. icyampa nkab'uwawe, nitanze maramaje. jye ntacyo maze, ntacyo, ntacyo; niwe mpay'ikuzo. icyampa nkab'uwawe, yesu mwami wanjye; ntandukanya n'iby'isi, umboneze rwose. icyampa nkab'uwawe, nitanze maramaje. jye ntacyo maze, ntacyo, ntacyo; niwe mpay'ikuzo. icyampa nkab'uwawe, yesu mwami wanjye; mb'uwaw'uko ndi kose, nta kintu kinziga. icyampa nkab'uwawe, nitanze maramaje. jye ntacyo maze, ntacyo, ntacyo; niwe mpay'ikuzo.

lines: Mb'uwaw'uko ndi kose, Nta kintu kinziga.

hymns.title: Icyampa Nkab'Uwawe

hymns.searchText: mfit'inshuti y'ukuri 161 mfit'inshuti y'ukuri y'inkoramutima, irankunda bihebuje, nzi kw'itazampana. ntabwo nayiv'iruhande, nkunda ko tubana, iyo nshuti ni yesu, umukiza. iyo nguy'agacuho, ameny'uko meze; ntanyirengagiza rwose: aransindagiza, akanyobora mu nzira, yo gukiranuka; n'inshuti nkunda cyane, yes'umwami. mutur'umubabaro, mubwir'ibyishimo; mubwir'ibinnyura nabyo, n'ibindushya byose. angaragariz'uburyo, nkwiriye kwifata; nkunda kwiganirira, naw'iteka. az'imigambi yanjye, yo gukiz'abandi; niko kunshing'umurimo, wo kumuvugira, no kwamamaz'urukundo, rwatumy'adupfira: yewe, mukunda rwose, bihebuje.
hymns.title: Mfit'Inshuti Y'Ukuri

hymns.searchText: umukiz'aranyobora 162 umukiz'aranyobora, birampagije rwose. sinshidikany'impuhwe ze, kuko njya nzibonaho. amahoro yo mw'ijuru, yanyuzuy'umutima; sinzatinya na hatoya, kuko yes'anyobora; sinzatinya na hatoya, kuko yes'anyobora. umukiz'aranyobora, akanampumuriza; iyo ngeze mu makuba, ntamvirira na hato; bona n'ubwo nateguza, yandamir'akamfasha; ahor'anyitahw'iteka, nta cyo nzamuburana; ahor'anyitahw 'iteka, nta cyo nzamuburana. umukiz'aranyobora, niryo humure ryanjye! niw'uzampaz'uburame, njye mpora musingiza. nta cyatuma ntiny'urupfu, mfit'iryo sezerano; nzajya ndirimb'iteka, nti: yesu niw'unyobora; nzajya ndirimb'iteka, nti: yesu niw'unyobora.

lines: Iyo ngeze mu makuba, Ntamvirira na hato;

hymns.title: Umukiz'Aranyobora

hymns.searchText: yes'arahamagar'ati: 163 yes'arahamagar'ati: nind'unkorera none? isarura rirageze, nind'uribusarure? umv'ukw'aduhamagara; kand'azagororera. umusubiza wes'ati: ndi hano mwami ntuma. n'utabasha kujya kure, ngo wambuke n'inyanja; n'ino har'abapagani, wagarurira yesu. n'utabasha gushyanuka, ngo wigishe nka paulo, wakogez'iby'urukundo rw'umukiza wabambwe. wabura kub'umurinzi, ku nkike z'i siyoni, wafashish'amasengesho, no gutur'amaturo; ukayobora n'abandi, mu nzir'ijya mw'ijuru, nk'ukw'aroni yakomeje amaboko ya mose. abantu bari mu kaga; yes'aragutabaza. ntukagir'ubw'uvug'uti: ntacyo nakora rwose. ishimire gukoreshwa, hitam'umurimo we; maz'usubize bwang'uti: ndi hano, mwami ntuma.

lines: Umusubiza wes'ati: Ndi hano Mwami ntuma.
N'utabasha kujya kure, Ngo wambuke n'inyanja;
N'utabasha gushyanuka, Ngo wigishe nka Paulo,
Wabura kub'umurinzi, Ku nkike z'i Siyoni,
Maz'usubize bwang'uti: Ndi hano, Mwami ntuma.

hymns.title: Yes'Arahamagar'Ati:

hymns.searchText: nicay'imbere ya yesu 164 nicay'imbere ya yesu, mpaboner'ihumure; n'ahantu h'igikundiro; icyampa nkahibera. iyo nicay'imbere ye, nimenyah'ubugoryi; kumuhang'amaso nibyo, bimpa gukiranuka. kwicar'imbere ya yesu, nta mahirw'arut'ayo; niho nsig'ibimbabaza, nkumva nduhutse rwose. iyo nicay'imbere ye, nkunda kumuganyira; naw'ababarana nanjye, maz'akampumuriza. yesu mp'umugisha wawe; dore, ndategereje; ndeban'imbabazi zawe, menye k'unyitayeho. mp'umutima wawe, yesu;nyeza nkubonerere; bigaragarir'abandi, yuko mporana nawe.
hymns.title: Nicay'Imbere Ya Yesu

hymns.searchText: ndagukunda, mwami 165 ndagukunda, mwami; uzi ko ngukunda; ndagukunda yesu, bihebuje rwose. ndagukunda yesu, naw'urabizi; imirimo yanjy'izabyerekana. nishimye, nishimye; rwose bitavugwa. ibyishimo byanjye, nta wabirondora. ndareb'ubutunzi buri mw'ijuru, nzagabirwa nawe kubw'ubuntu bwawe. yesu mwami wanjye, niwe nkesha byose; ar'ugucungurwa, ari n'ubugingo. nzakogez'iteka, nkuririmbire, kuk'ubuntu bwawe bwandemy'umutima. naguhwanya nande, mucunguzi wanjye? uhoran'ineza, ntugir'impinduka. nzajya nguhimbaza, nkubahirize; umutima wanjye wuzuy'ibyishimo.

lines: Yesu Mwami wanjye, Niwe nkesha byose;

hymns.title: Ndagukunda, Mwami

hymns.searchText: ayi rutare rw'imana 166 ayi rutare rw'imana, reka nguhungiraho! kubw'imbabazi zawe, kera waramenewe, non'ubu nkwihishemo, umujinya w'imana. ibyo twakora byose, n'umwete wacu wose, n'agahinda gasaze, n'amarir'adashira, byose ntibyashobora, kudukurahw'ibyaha. yes'ibyo mfite byose, nta mumaro bigira. sinabasha kwikiza, ndagushakah'ubuntu, unyuhagir'imbyiro, mutabazi ne gupfa. nuko nkiri muzima, mwami, nguhungireho. no ku munsi w'imanza, ninger'imbere yawe, ayi rutare rw'imana, uzandeke nkwisunge!

lines: Ibyo twakora byose, N'umwete wacu wose,
Yes'ibyo mfite byose, Nta mumaro bigira.
No ku munsi w'imanza, Ninger'imbere yawe,

hymns.title: Ayi Rutare Rw'Imana

hymns.searchText: mwa bera b'umwami 167 mwa bera b'umwami, mwishimir'ijambo rye; niryo rufatiro rwo kwizera kwanyu. dore, yababwiye byose; ntacyo yabahishe. ntitwabasha kongera kur'iryo jambo ryiza, cyangwa kuritubya, kukw'ar'iry'imana. n'ugera mu kaga, yesu yasezeranye, kw'azakugoboka, akakurengera; amakuba yawe yos'akuber'umugisha; niy'azakweza rwose, maz'atum'ushikama; niy'azakweza rwose, agukomeze. ibigeragezo nibikugwa gitumo, ubuntu bwanjye buzaba buhagije. ibirimi by'umuriro, ntibigutinyishe; bizakongor'ibyaha, usigar'utunganye; bizakongor'ibyaha, bikuboneze. unamba ku mana, ntizamuhemukira; ntizamuharir'umubisha na hato. n'ubw'ingabo zose z'umwanzi zamusatira, ntizamuhemukira, ntizamuhemukira, ntizamuhemukira, haba na gato.
hymns.title: Mwa Bera B'Umwami

hymns.searchText: uwiteka niwe mwungeri wanjye 168 uwiteka niwe mwungeri wanjye, sinzakena; andyamisha mu cyanya cy'ubwatsi butoshye cyane; anyobor'iruhande rw'amaz'adasuma; uwitek'asubiz'intege mu bugingo bwanjye. nanyura no mu gikombe cy'igicucu cy'urupfu, sinatiny'ikibi cyose, kuko ndi kumwe nawe; inshyimbo yawe n'inkoni, bimp'ihumure; nta kaga kazantungura, ndi kumwe nawe, mwami. untunganiriz'ameza mu gihe cy'amakuba. unshagijehw imbabazi, zimeze nk'amavuta; wanyujurij'igikombe, cyuzur'ubuntu. mwami, ntacyo wisigiye, ng'ubon'uk'ukingomwa. mana y'ubuntu, n'ukuri; ineza wangiriye, n'imbabazi bizanyomahw'iminsi yanjye yose; nzakomeza nkuyoboke, sinzateshuka; kandi nzaba mu nzu y'uwiteka iteka ryose.

lines: Andyamisha mu cyanya cy'ubwatsi butoshye cyane;
Nanyura no mu gikombe cy'igicucu cy'urupfu,
Sinatiny'ikibi cyose, kuko ndi kumwe nawe;
Nta kaga kazantungura, ndi kumwe nawe, Mwami.
Kandi nzaba mu nzu y'Uwiteka iteka ryose.

hymns.title: Uwiteka Niwe Mwungeri Wanjye

hymns.searchText: wa muragwa we! 169 wa muragwa we, mbese k'uhunikira? k'ucogoy'ugiye kugerayo? kanguka bwangu, shak'intwaro zawe; wizarira, dore byatinze rwose! amahanga yose yasubiranyemo; bose baradagadwa bihebye. umv'ukw'amagar'ahindira hose; wa muragwa we, wigumya gutinda! ntugwabizwe n'iby'iyi si biguhenda; reb'ubwiza bwabyo burashira. c'ingoy'umwanzi yakubohesheje; wa muragwa we, zicikeho bwangu! nyamuneka, ntugir'imitim'ibiri; ba mas'umwam'atagutungura; dor'umucy'utangiye gutangaza; muragwa we, vuz'impundu, wishime!
hymns.title: Wa Muragwa We!

hymns.searchText: mwami mana yanjye 170 mwami mana yanjye, ni wow'umbeshaho; ubuntu bwawe n'isoko nkesh'ibyiza byose. ubuntu bwawe n'isoko nkesh'amahirwe yose. ni wowe wandemye, nta wakundutira; ineza yawe ni nyinshi, ntacyo nayinganya; ineza yawe ni nyinshi ntacyo nayigeraho. mwami, natur'iki, ko byos'ar'ibyawe? kerets'umutim'ushima, wo kuguhimbaza; kerets'umutim'ushima, wo kukuramya, mwami. umpe gushikama, kubw'ubuntu bwawe; nkweguriy'ibyanjye byose, mbay'uwawe rwose; nkweguriy'ibyanjye byose, mb'uwaw'akaramata.

lines: Ineza yawe ni nyinshi, Ntacyo nayinganya;
Ineza yawe ni nyinshi ntacyo nayigeraho.

hymns.title: Mwami Mana Yanjye

hymns.searchText: murinzi we w'i siyoni 171 murinzi we, w'i sioni, ijoro rigeze he? mbes'umusek'uri hafi? ntiburatandukana? ntacy'ushishoz'i burasira-zuba? ntacy'ushishoz'i burasira-zuba? nyamuneka tumenyeshe, k'urugendo rushize; mbese tugeze ku cyambu, tugiye kugerayo? mbese koko, ubwami buri hafi? mbese koko, ubwami buri hafi? burakey'umuns'uraje! tubyamamaze hose; dor'izuba rirarashe, mwese nimurirebe! mwa bera mwe, mugiye gucungurwa! mwa bera mwe, mugiye gucungurwa! tugeze ku rugabano, rw'igihugu tujyamo, nimukabuze twihute, icyambu kiri hafi. nimurangurure ya majwi yanyu! nimurangurure ya majwi yanyu!

lines: Murinzi we, w'i Sioni, Ijoro rigeze he?

hymns.searchText: mutima wanjye ucururuke 248 mutima wanjye ucururuke, nugir'ibiguter'impagarara, wiringire ishobora byose, n'imigambi yayo myiza. mutima wanjy'iby'ari byo byose, n'ubw'ibihe byagenda bihinduka, imbabazi, zayo ntizishira, zihorahw'ibihe byose. mutima wanjye uremerewe, n'ubwo wab'utew'ubwoba n'urupfu, ni wiheba wisung'uwiteka, agukingurir'ijuru. mutima wanjy'uhereye kera, ntiwigeze ubur'umudendezo, isung'imana izakwakira, wemere kugengwa na yo. ubugingo bwiza buboneye, bushishikarira gukor'ibyiza, mukiza mfasha ngo mbugereho, ump'umutim'utunganye.
hymns.title: Mutima Wanjye Ucururuke

hymns.searchText: ikuzo ni iryawe! 249 ikuzo n'iryawe data wa twese, nari nahabiye kure yawe, wangejeje mu mucyo w'itangaza, umvana mu bubata ndakira. mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje! nababariwe, n'inkuru nziza kuri twe. mbeg'urukundo rutarondoreka! rwatumye yesu azakunshaka. nar'umuhanya sinari nkwiriye, gukira ngukesha yesu gusa. mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje! nababariwe, n'inkuru nziza kuri twe. akir'uyu mutima wanjye mwami, nkweguriy'imibereho yanjye, wowe wanyitangiye ukankiza, wanyejeshej'amaraso yawe. mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje! nababariwe, n'inkuru nziza kuri twe. mana yanjye nkingira ndakwinginze, sinashobora kwirwanirira, kugira ngo nzanezererw'iteka, twishimye, dusingiza umwami. mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje! nababariwe, n'inkuru nziza kuri twe.
hymns.title: Ikuzo Ni Iryawe!

hymns.searchText: umukiza niw'unyobora 250 umukiza niw'unyobor'iyo ndi mu bishuko, n'iy'amakub'angose, amber'ubuhungiro, niw'unkingir'ibishuko, yesu nyiyoborere. uhosh'umuraba nk'umubyey'uhoz'umwana we, ndets'uranawutegek'ubwaw'ukakumvira, mwami wanjye yesu nkunda, ujy'unyiyoborera. iyo negerey'inkengero ngashy'ubwoba, nkakwihishamo, ndaruhuka, nkumv'umpumuriz'uti: witinya ntacy'uteze kuba, nzajya nkuyobora.

hymns.searchText: ujyuvug'ibya yesu 253 ujy'uvug'ibya yesu, inshuti y'ukuri, ngwin'uduhumurish'ibyo yagukoreye. vuga yesu gusa, bizakuyobor'iteka, jy'ubivug'uririmba, kandi unasenga. ujy'uvug'ibya yes'uzumv'ubabariwe, no kubw'ubuntu bwe tuzagera mw'ijuru. vuga yesu gusa, bizakuyobor'iteka, jy'ubivug'uririmba, kandi unasenga. sinabura kuvug'iby'umusaraba we, nkund'uwo mukiza, kuko yanyitangiye. vuga yesu gusa, bizakuyobor'iteka, jy'ubivug'uririmba, kandi unasenga. uvug'ibya yesu, ntupfush'igih'ubusa, kutita ku nshingano, bitesh'agaciro. vuga yesu gusa, bizakuyobor'iteka, jy'ubivug'uririmba, kandi unasenga. ujy'uvug'ibya yesu, n'ubwo wacogora, va mu ntege nke zawe, umwiyegurire. vuga yesu gusa, bizakuyobor'iteka, jy'ubivug'uririmba, kandi unasenga.

hymns.searchText: amahoro masa 296 umutima wanjy'urasingiz'imana, mu ndirimbo y'umunezero, nifitiy'amahoro ava mw'ijuru, yuzuye mu mutima wanjye. amahoro masa, aturuka ku mana gusa, nyamuneka tungany'ubugingo bwanjye, n'urukundo rutarondorwa. nifitiy'amahor'arut'ubutunzi, yuzuye mu mutima wanjye, kandi nta muntu wabasha kuyanyaga, ntawe n'aho yakwigir'ate! amahoro masa, aturuka ku mana gusa, nyamuneka tungany'ubugingo bwanjye, n'urukundo rutarondorwa. yambereye ubuhungiro nijoro, bituma mb'uwa yesu gusa, nta cyampangara ku manywa na nijoro, ntacyo rwose haba na gito. amahoro masa, aturuka ku mana gusa, nyamuneka tungany'ubugingo bwanjye, n'urukundo rutarondorwa. reka mvug'ibya wa mudugudu mwiza, uwo nzabona nkanezerwa, mu ndirimb'abera bazaharirimbir' imwe n'iyi ngiyi wumva ngo: amahoro masa, aturuka ku mana gusa, nyamuneka tungany'ubugingo bwanjye, n'urukundo rutarondorwa. n'ubwo nanyuraga makuba y'isi, nkabur'umunt'umpumuriza, umukiza wanjye n'inshuti y'ukuri, yangoteshej'amaboko ye. amahoro masa, aturuka ku mana gusa, nyamuneka tungany'ubugingo bwanjye, n'urukundo rutarondorwa.

hymns.searchText: igitekerezo cyiza 298 igitekerezo cyiza cya yesu mukiza, kivug'uburyo yahoranye n'abantu, n'uko yahamagarag'abana nk'intama ze, maze bigatuma nkumbura yesu, numva nifuza kw'aba yaranshyizehw'ibiganza, ngw'abe yaranzengurukij'amaboko, yemwe mba narahiriw'iyo numv'avug'ati: nimurek'abana bato bansange! nzeger'intebe ye ngo mutur'amasengesho, maze musabe kuba mu rukundo rwe, kand'uko ndushaho kumushaka mur'iyi si, nizeye ko nzamubona mw'ijuru. yagiye mw'ijuru guteguray'amazu meza, azaturwamo n'abacunguwe gusa. abana benshi bazaba bateraniyeyo, kuk'ubwami bwo mw'ijuru ar'ubwabo. abantu benshi bazimiriye mur'iyi si, ntabwo barumv'inkuru y'iwacu heza, ndifuza ko bamenya ko har'umwanya wabo, kandi yesu niw'ubahamagara. ndifuza kuzishima kur'uwo munsi mukuru, uzab'ar'umuns'urut'iyindi yose. ubw'abana bo mw'isi yose bazaterana, akabaher'umugish'icyarimwe.

hymns.searchText: nzabana n'umwami 304 nzabana n'umwam'ibihe bidashira, iryo jambo rivuga ngo: nzatur'ibudapfa, n'ubwo nkingiranywe mur'uyu mubiri, buzacya negereje gutah'iwacu heza. iwacu, iwacu, ngeze hafi yaho. mu rugo rw'umwami ndahararikira, kwizera niko kunyerek'namarembo yaho, n'ubwo njya ncogora s'ukutahashaka, iyo gakondo y'abera ni yerusalemu. iwacu, iwacu, ngeze hafi yaho. njya ngotwa n'ibyaha, nkumva ndacogoye, nka bur'aho mfata nka ya numa yo mu nkuge, ibicu byeyutse, umukororombya, w'ihumure urasira mu mutima wanjye. iwacu, iwacu, ngeze hafi yaho. nkund'izo ndirimbo zihora mw'ijuru, izo mw'isi yacu ni nk'indimi z'i babeli, harihw'icyo nkunda, nukw'abazazuka, bazongera kubana na yesu, yee, amina. iwacu, iwacu, ngeze hafi yaho.

hymns.searchText: urukundo rw'imana yacu 307 urukundo rw'imana yacu, nta muntu warurondora, rusaguts'ikirere cyose, rugera no munsi y'isi. abantu bose bacumuye, bacunguwe na yesu, umwana we wese wahabye, yaramwicunguriye. mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, rutagir'urugero, abera bazaruririmba, ibihe bidashira. ubw'ibihe bizah'ibindi, n'ubwami bw'isi bwashize, abantu bakanga gusenga, amabuy'azaririmba. urukundo rw'imana yacu, ntabwo rurondoreka, rwacunguy'abo mw'isi bose, ruzaririmbw'iteka. mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, rutagir'urugero, abera bazaruririmba, ibihe bidashira. inyanja zose zaba wino, n'ijuru ryab'impapuro, tukandikisha agati kose, umuntu wes'akandika, urukundo rw'imana yacu, rwakamy'inyanja zose, ntabwo rwabon'aho rukwirwa, rusaguts'ikirere. mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, rutagir'urugero, abera bazaruririmba, ibihe bidashira.

hymns.searchText: hariho uburuhukiro muri paradiso 310 hariho uburuhukiro muri paradiso, ahatazab'umubabar'ukundi, tuzahurirayo. tuzateranirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzateranirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. tuzate..., nirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzate…nirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. hariy'umudugudu mwiza utatswem'umucyo, aho nihw'abakiranutsi bazibanira n'umwami. tuzateranirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzateranirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. tuzate..., nirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzate…nirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. hariyo amakamba meza, ayo tuzambikwa, kristo yateguriy'abamutegereje bihanganye. tuzateranirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzateranirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. tuzate..., nirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzate…nirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. jy'ukiranuk'ibihe byose, nubwo wabizira, yesu yasezeranye kw'azaguh'ikamba ry'ubugingo tuzateranirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzateranirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje. tuzate..., nirayo, tuzahurirayo kuri rwa ruzi, tuzate…nirayo, mu musek'igitondo gitangaje.

hymns.searchText: mukristo ube maso 311 mukristo ube maso, nturuhuke na hato, akaga kari hafi, usenge! ababisha b'imana bajya bakubikira, baguciriy'ibico, usenge! kenyer'intwaro zawe ku manywa na n'ijoro, dor'umwanz'arakaze, ba maso! umv'abatsinze kera iyo ntambar'urwana, barakubwira bati: usenge! umva umwami wawe, yesu wagupfiriye, niwe wategets'ati: wirinde! bik'iryo jambo ryiza, mu mutima wemera, kandi unabikore usenga.

hymns.searchText: mbese wahereye ryari? 312 mbese wahereye ryari uvugana n'umwam'umutakambira? mbese wahereye ryar'usenga, ugez'ubw'ukesh'ijoro? mbese wamaz'igihe kingan'iki wumva yuk'utay'umuruho? se wamwit'inshuti, wamenye ryari, kw'akurind'akakwitaho? mbese wahereye ryar'upfukam' useng'uhorah'uri mw'ijuru? se wameny'ute ko washubijwe, akakurinda bugacya? ukamenya ko wiriz'uwo munsi, mbese wamwit'inshuti yawe? mbese wamenye ryari kw'akwitaho, kandi akanakurinda?

hymns.searchText: igihe cyo kugaruka k'umwami 313 igihe cyo kugaruka k'umwami kiregereje rwose, inyenyeri zicwekereye, kubw'umucyo w'igitondo gitangaje. mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbese ntabw'ubona k'umusek'utambitse! mbese k'ubanza bugiye gucya! ibimenyetso byose byahanuwe kw'izuba no ku kwezi, birahamiriz'umuntu wese ko kuza k'umwami kutwegereye. mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbese ntabw'ubona k'umusek'utambitse! mbese k'ubanza bugiye gucya! iki n'igihe rwos'itorero rikwiye guhaguruka, kandi rikwiriye kuba maso, kuko bidatinze bugiye gucya. mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbese ntabw'ubona k'umusek'utambitse! mbese k'ubanza bugiye gucya! nimusohoke mujye mu nzira ngari no mu nzira ntoya, nimubwir'ibirema n'impumyi ko kuza k'umwami kutwegereye. mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbes'aho ntiburi hafi gucya! mbese ntabw'ubona k'umusek'utambitse! mbese k'ubanza bugiye gucya!

hymns.searchText: ye byose biba byiza 314 ye byose biba byiza sinzatinya, nkeney'urukundo ruhebuje, imiyaga n'imigaru biratuza. imana yacu y'impuhwe nyinshi itwitaho. mu mibabar'idusagiriz'ibyiza, iradukunda. iraturinda, mu mibabar'idukomez'imitima, kukw'imana yacu yumva gutaka kwacu, irindira igihe cyayo kuzageza, ku mperuka. byose biba byiz'iman'inyitaho, munsi y'amababa ye sintinya. nta cyago cyankuraho amahoro ye. iyo niringiy'imana mu mutima wanjye. mu mibabar'idusagiriz'ibyiza, iradukunda. iraturinda, mu mibabar'idukomez'imitima, kukw'imana yacu yumva gutaka kwacu, irindira igihe cyayo kuzageza, ku mperuka. biba byiza yesu, yabibwiy'abe. mukumbi wanjye muto ntutinye. iman'iri ku ngoma is'irabizi. isi n'ijuru bizuzura ikuzo ryayo. mu mibabar'idusagiriz'ibyiza, iradukunda. iraturinda, mu mibabar'idukomez'imitima, kukw'imana yacu yumva gutaka kwacu, irindira igihe cyayo kuzageza, ku mperuka.

hymns.searchText: harih'umunt'umwe 315 harih'umunt'umwe wapfuye ku bwanjye, akandi ntibyari bikwiriye, yemeye kujyanw'ajya ku musaraba, kubwo kumbabarir'ibyaha. byarabambwe byose, byarabambwe byose, yemw'uko yabyikorey'ubwe! yemwe ngo arababara cyan'ajyayo! ajyanyweyo n'ibyaha byanjye. n'umugwaneza kand'arankunda cyane, yez'umutima wanjy'ibyaha, sincirw'urubanza, mfit'umudendezo, kuko yambabariy'ibyaha. byarabambwe byose, byarabambwe byose, yemw'uko yabyikorey'ubwe! yemwe ngo arababara cyan'ajyayo! ajyanyweyo n'ibyaha byanjye. nzabana n'umukiza akaramata, nzajya ngendana naw'iteka, ndirimbish'umunwa n'umutima wanjye, kuko nababariw'ibyaha. byarabambwe byose, byarabambwe byose, yemw'uko yabyikorey'ubwe! yemwe ngo arababara cyan'ajyayo! ajyanyweyo n'ibyaha byanjye.

hymns.searchText: yesu araje 316 yes'araje nimubyamamaze, aje kujyan'abo yacunguye, azanywe no kwimik'ingoma ye, yesu agiye kuza. yes'agiye kugaruka vuba, yesu agiye kuza (agiye kuza), nimubyamamaz'ahantu hose, agiye kugaruka. yes'araj'abapfuye bazuke, maz'abatoni be baterane, bahurire nawe mu kirere, yesu agiye kuza. yes'agiye kugaruka vuba, yesu agiye kuza (agiye kuza), nimubyamamaz'ahantu hose, agiye kugaruka. yes'azanywe no gukiz'abera, azanywe no gutang'amahoro, imibabaro yos'izashira, yesu agiye kuza. yes'agiye kugaruka vuba, yesu agiye kuza (agiye kuza), nimubyamamaz'ahantu hose, agiye kugaruka. yes'araje nk'uko yabivuze, ni bande batowe bamwizeye, bamutegereje bari maso, yesu agiye kuza. yes'agiye kugaruka vuba, yesu agiye kuza (agiye kuza), nimubyamamaz'ahantu hose, agiye kugaruka.
