hymns.searchText: mfite umukiza 317 mfit'umukiz'ukomey'undind'iteka? unyobor'intambwe ngo ntayob'inzira, niw'uyobora buri ntambwe y'uhabye, mbes'ufit'umukiza nk'uwo? mfit'umukiza umez'atyo (atyo)! se nawe n'umukiza wawe (wawe)? yanyinjiyemo, ntabwo ateze kumvamo, se nawe n'umukiza wawe (wawe)? n'umukiza niringir'ibihe byose, mu byago n'amakub'ampor'iruhande, no mu bishukw'arandinda bitangaje, mbes'ufit'umufasha nk'uwo? mfit'umukiza umez'atyo (atyo)! se nawe n'umukiza wawe (wawe)? yanyinjiyemo, ntabwo ateze kumvamo, se nawe n'umukiza wawe (wawe)? mfit'umwungeri mwiz'ukund'intama ze, azihamagara mu mazina yazo, azih'ubwatsi bwiza n'amazi meza, mbes'ufit'umwungeri nk'uwo? mfit'umukiza umez'atyo (atyo)! se nawe n'umukiza wawe (wawe)? yanyinjiyemo, ntabwo ateze kumvamo, se nawe n'umukiza wawe (wawe)?

hymns.searchText: ngwin'umukiz'aragushaka 318 ngwin'umukiz'aragushaka, n'inshuti nziza y'ukuri, ubu ngub'aragutegereje, arakwinginga ngwino. umukiz'ahagaze ku rugi, gira bwang'umusab'imbabazi, witindigany'arategereje, gira n'ingoga ngwino. umv'amagambo ye y'ihumure, yesu n'inshuti y'ukuri, musange n'isoko y'ubugingo, ntabw'uzabur'umwanya. umukiz'ahagaze ku rugi, gira bwang'umusab'imbabazi, witindigany'arategereje, gira n'ingoga ngwino. umvir'uwo mwuk'ukongorera, wisuzugur'uwo mwami, mwakire vuba witindiganya, hahirw'umwakiriye. umukiz'ahagaze ku rugi, gira bwang'umusab'imbabazi, witindigany'arategereje, gira n'ingoga ngwino.

hymns.searchText: isengesho ryanjye 319 isengesho ryanjye mwami nyumvira, nyobora mu nzira, mu birushya byo mur'ubu buzima, jy'umpor'iruhande. har'ibigeragezo byinshi mpura naby'aho njya hose, mfash'umpe kub'umunyakuri, kandi mb'umukiranutsi. igih'ub'ubuzima buzaba bugeze kw'iherezo, ndagusaby'uzampe kubana nawe mu bwami bw'ijuru.

hymns.searchText: mfit'inyota mwami 320 mfit'inyota mwami, ndagukennye cyane, mpembura mukiza, wowe soko nziza, soko y'ubugingo, ngwin'umurikire, unyobore (unyobore), nger'iwawe. buhungiro (buhungiro), nihishamo (nihishamo), ubwugamo (ubwugamo), bw'umugaru (bw'umugaru), murikira (murikira), noye kuyoba (ne kuyoba), kugez'ubwo (kugez'ubwo), ngez'iwacu. nd'umugenzi mwami, ngenda mu butayu, kandi mfit'isari, ndarushye mukiza, mpam'amazi mukiza, maze nshir'inyota, kugez'ubwo (kugez'ubwo), ngez'iwacu. buhungiro (buhungiro), nihishamo (nihishamo), ubwugamo (ubwugamo), bw'umugaru (bw'umugaru), murikira (murikira), noye kuyoba (ne kuyoba), kugez'ubwo (kugez'ubwo), ngez'iwacu. iwacu mw'ijuru, ngiye kugerayo, nzambikw'ikamba yesu yanteguriye, nubw'indushya , ndi hafi kugera, mu gihugu (mu gihugu), cy'ihumure. buhungiro (buhungiro), nihishamo (nihishamo), ubwugamo (ubwugamo), bw'umugaru (bw'umugaru), murikira (murikira), noye kuyoba (ne kuyoba), kugez'ubwo (kugez'ubwo), ngez'iwacu.

hymns.searchText: uwiteka n'umwungeri wanjye 322 uwiteka n'umwungeri wanjye, sinzakena na hato, andyamisha mu cyanya cy'iruhande rw'amaz'adasuma. asubiz'intege mu bugingo bwanjye mu gihe ntebye, anyobor'inzira yo gukiranuka kubw'izina rye. naho nanyura no mu gikombe cy'igicucu cy'urupfu, sinzatiny'ikibi cyose mwami kuko ndi kumwe nawe. untunganiriza ameza mu maso y'abanzi banjye, unsize amavuta mu mutwe maze aratonyanga. kugirirwa neza n'imbabazi bizanyomahw'iteka, nanjye nzaba mu nzu y'uwiteka ibihe bidashira.

hymns.searchText: mbega igitambo! 324 mbega igitambo cy'amaraso y'umukiza, wapfuy'ari njy'azira! yambambiwe ku musaraba, abitewe n'ukw'ankunda cyane, n'urukundo rutangaje mwami wanjye, kugira ngo wemere kubabara no kumfira. urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamuteye kumfira, mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura! urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamute… kumfira, mbeg'uruku…rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura. yasiz'intebe y'ubwami ya se, yemera kunyitangira ngo nkire, nari mbuz'epfo na ruguru, imbabazi ze zirangoboka, maz'urukundo rwe runter'umunezero, mperako mererwa neza mu mutima wanjye. urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamuteye kumfira, mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura! urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamute… kumfira, mbeg'uruku…rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura. nari maz'igihe kirekire, mboshywe n'umwijima w'ibyaha byanjye, maze kumeny'ineza yawe, ngukurikira mfit'ibyishimo, kuko nari mbohowe ingoyi z'ibyaha, mperako ndahaguruka, ndagukurikira. urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamuteye kumfira, mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura! urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamute… kumfira, mbeg'uruku…rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura. nta teka ncirwaho kuko ndi muri yesu, naw'akab'ari muri jye, niwe nkesha kubaho kwanjye, nkeger'intebe ye ntacyo ntinya, nkambikw'ikamba mbikesha uwancunguye, ntabwo nzahwema kumusingiz'iteka ryose. urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamuteye kumfira, mbeg'urukundo rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura! urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwamute… kumfira, mbeg'uruku…rutangaje, ngo ruratum'ancungura.

hymns.searchText: dufit'ibyiringiro 326 dufit'ibyiringiro by'ukuri, ko yesu azagaruka, twizezwa n'uk'ubwe yabivuze, twizer'isezerano rye, ubw'amoko yo mw'isi, azarangurur'ati: haleluya, yesu kristo n'umwami w'abami, twiringiye yuk'umwami wacu, ari hafi kugaruka. duhuriye muri yesu kristo, duhujwe n'urukundo rwe, abantu bifuz'urukundo rwe, rwatumy'acungur'abantu, ijuru rizakinguka kristo agaruke, abantu baririmbe, haleluya, araje! dufit'ibyiringiro mu mana, twibumbiye muri kristo.

hymns.searchText: nkunda igitabo cyera 327 nkund'igitabo cyera cy'imana, nicyo kindutir'ibindi byose, kinyigish'ibyiza byo mw'ijuru, nkameny'inzira y'agakiza. gitabo cy'ingenzi muri wowe, mpabon'ubwiza bw'umwami wanjye, ibyanditswe byawe binyigisha, iby'umunezero nzagira. ariko igihe nkiri mw'isi, umbwir'iby'urukundo rw'imana, nkarushaho gusobanukirwa, n'umunezero wo mw ijuru. ni wowe werekan'imigambi, yose ya yes'umukiza wanjye, muri wowe niho har'ubwenge, n'ubuhanga butarondorwa. ur'umucy'umurikir'ab'isi, ngo bave mu mwijima w'ibyaha, ni wow'umurikir'imitima, y'abahabye bagahabuka.

hymns.searchText: ku musaraba 328 imbere y'uhoraho ntabwo nkorwa n'isoni, kand'ijambo ryawe rinshimish'ibihe byose. ku musaraba niho naboney'umucyo, mbona gutur'umutwaro wanjye, mbiboneshwa no kwizera uherey'ubu nzahora nezerewe. yesu mana yanjye nzi yukw'ari ryo zina rye, ntazemerer'umutima wanjye kuzimira. ku musaraba niho naboney'umucyo, mbona gutur'umutwaro wanjye, mbiboneshwa no kwizera uherey'ubu nzahora nezerewe. yasezeranye yukw'intebe y'izahoraho, biragaragara kw'ibyo yavuz'ar'ukuri. ku musaraba niho naboney'umucyo, mbona gutur'umutwaro wanjye, mbiboneshwa no kwizera uherey'ubu nzahora nezerewe.

hymns.searchText: nzabon'umwami 332 nzabon'umwami wanjy' aririmbirwa n'abamarayika tuzabana naw'iteka ryose mu gihugu cy'ibyiza. tuzahorana ibihe byose, yankirije i kalvari amaherezo nzabon'umwami wanyitangiye kera. mur'icyo gihugu cyiza nta joro rizabay'ukundi. nzabana n'umwami wancunguje amaraso y'akiza. tuzahorana ibihe byose, yankirije i kalvari amaherezo nzabon'umwami wanyitangiye kera. nzabana n'umwami wanjye nkunda nzamureba mu maso, nzamuririmbira mushimira ubuntu yangiriye. tuzahorana ibihe byose, yankirije i kalvari amaherezo nzabon'umwami wanyitangiye kera.

hymns.searchText: icyampa kugendana n'imana 333 icyampa kugendana n'imana, mu nzir'ijya mw'ijuru, nibyo byamber'umucy'ungeza, ku mwana w'intama. garuka, mukunzi garuka, ntumwa nziza y'amahoro, nang'ibyaha byakubabaje, bikantanya nawe. mbega ngo ndagir'amahoro, ntazigera nibagirwa! ariko byansizemw'imvun' itakungwa n'ab'isi. icyo nagusimbuje cyose, uko cyaba kiri kose, mfasha nitandukanye nacyo, ngusenge wenyine.

hymns.searchText: nimumenyesh'abantu bose 334 nimumenyesh'abantu bose ko yes'ari hafi, is'imurikirwe n'umucyo, maze yes'agaruke. nimusingiz'uwo mwana w'intama watambwe, nimwamamaze ko yes'agiye kwima. amahanga yasubiranyemo, muyaburire, is'imurikirwe n'umucyo, maze yes'agaruke. nimusingiz'uwo mwana w'intama watambwe, nimwamamaze ko yes'agiye kwima. bana b'imana, nimuririmbe, muyih'ikuzo, hahirw'ababa maso, bukarinda butandukana. nimusingiz'uwo mwana w'intama watambwe, nimwamamaze ko yes'agiye kwima.

hymns.searchText: nejejwe n'iri turo 335 nejejwe n'iri turo ntuy'umwami yesu, igitambo kizima nicyo jyew'ubwanjye. akir'ituro ryanjye we mwana w'imana, kand'umanurire ku mucyo uv'ahera. mpaz'ubugingo bwanjye, nticuza, ntatinya, kubw'ubuntu bwawe warancunguye mwami. akir'ituro ryanjye we mwana w'imana, kand'umanurire ku mucyo uv'ahera. yesu ngwin'unyigishe wowe wancunguye, nshaka kubana naw'ibihe bidashira. akir'ituro ryanjye we mwana w'imana, kand'umanurire ku mucyo uv'ahera.

hymns.searchText: nakurikiye yesu 348 nakurikiye yesu mu kibaya akiz'abarwayi, ac'iminyururu y'ibyaha no kuruhur'imitwaro. mbega ngo biranezeza gukurikira yesu, akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe akangeza mw'ijuru. mbega ngo biranezeza, …rikira, …ra yesu, … .akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe, …kangeza; mw'ijuru. namukurikiye ku musoz'igihe yahindurwaga, imana iravuga iti: ur'umwana wanjye nkunda. mbega ngo biranezeza gukurikira yesu, akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe akangeza mw'ijuru. mbega ngo biranezeza, …rikira, …ra yesu, … .akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe, …kangeza; mw'ijuru. namukurikiy'i kalvari, agend'atukwa na benshi, akomez'inzira y'umwanzi, yikorey'umusaraba. mbega ngo biranezeza gukurikira yesu, akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe akangeza mw'ijuru. mbega ngo biranezeza, …rikira, …ra yesu, … .akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe, …kangeza; mw'ijuru. nzamukurikira nkiriho, maz'atume mpora nesha, kugez'ubwo nzager'iwacu ahahor'umunezero. mbega ngo biranezeza gukurikira yesu, akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe akangeza mw'ijuru. mbega ngo biranezeza, …rikira, …ra yesu, … .akanyoboz'ubuntu bwe, …kangeza; mw'ijuru.

hymns.searchText: nabony'umuntu unaniwe 349 nabony'umunt'unaniwe, kand'agenda yihanganye, yikorey'umusaraba, nyamara ntabwo yari yihebye, imibabar'iba myinshi! arik'uw'urahebuje! mubaz'ikimuh'intege, ati: nuko mfit'ibyiringiro. nabony'afite n'intwaro, arwany'iby'is'ashikamye, kand'arwan'amaramaje ngw'azabon'ikamba rihoraho, n'ubwo yari yarenganye, ntiyigeze yivovota, mubaz'ikimuh'intege, ati: nuko mfit'ibyiringiro. nabony'uwasiz'inshuti ze, bakundanaga cyane, atandukana n'iby'isi, ahitamw'inzir'imuruhije, n'ubw'irimw'ibibabaza, arikw'ariyumanganya, mubaz'ikimuh'intege, ati: nuko mfit'ibyiringiro. tur'abagenzi mur'iyi si, y'akaga n'agahinda, irimw'ibyago n'urwango, n'ibituro byuzuye mw'abantu, kugez'ubwo krist'azaza, akarokor'abe bose, se, n'iki cyadukomeza, atar'ibyiringiro bishyitse?
hymns.title: Nabony'Umuntu Unaniwe

hymns.searchText: mugenzi komera 350 mugenzi komera yes'ari hafi, twamutegereje kera, tugiye kwitahir'iwacu heza, turirimbe ko dutsinze, twihangane twe kumuhemukaho, kandi w'ataduhemukiye, yatwerets'urukundo ruhebuje, nirwo rwatumy'adupfira. mugenzi komera, utegerez'umudugudu w'izahabu, wateguriwe abakiranutsi, niho tuzaruhukira, ihangane ntabwo tuzagum'aha, mu buhanya no mu miruho, harubw'umwijim'uzatamuruka, igitondo gitangaze. mugenzi komera dore araje, uwo muremyi wa byose, azanye n'abamarayika benshi, azanye n'ingororano, ihangan'ugez'igih'umukiza, azakubwir'aya magambo, ngo mugaragu mwiz'ukiranuka, igire mu munezero. mugenzi ujy'uhora wihanganye, komeza kwizera kwawe, amarira yawe ahanagurwe maz'uzahabwe n 'ikamba, ihangane mwene data ni koko, isezerano rye n'impamo, uzibanirayo n'abakijijwe, na yes'umukiza wacu.
hymns.title: Mugenzi Komera

hymns.searchText: umunsi mwiza uri bugufi 351 dor'umunsi mwiza ugiye kugera, tukibera ibudapfa. aho tuzibera hahebuj'ubwiza, n'umuns'utangaje! umwijim'ugiye gutamuruka, tukabah'ubutazongera gupfa. mbega ihumure twahawe na yesu! dor'ari bugufi. imitima yacu irahumurirwa, ntabwo ijya igoheka. turifuza kubon'uwo munsi mwiza, tuzaba mu bwiza. umwijim'ugiye gutamuruka, tukabah'ubutazongera gupfa. mbega ihumure twahawe na yesu! dor'ari bugufi. za ntwari zasinzirany'ibyiringiro, tugiye kuzabonana. nta marir'azongera kuturangwaho, mu murwa w'imana. umwijim'ugiye gutamuruka, tukabah'ubutazongera gupfa. mbega ihumure twahawe na yesu! dor'ari bugufi.
hymns.title: Umunsi Mwiza Uri Bugufi

hymns.searchText: nitugera mw'ijuru 352 turirimb'urukundo rwa yesu; impuhwe ndetse n'ubuntu bye. ari kudutegurir’aho tuzaba, mw’ijuru. nitugera mw'ijuru, mbeg'umunezero tuzagira!' turirimb’indirimbo nziza z’abanesheje. n'ubw'ibicu bidukingirije, bitubuza kureba neza, turi hafi yo gusoz' urugendo rukomeye. nitugera mw'ijuru, mbeg'umunezero tuzagira!' turirimb’indirimbo nziza z’abanesheje. dukomeze dukorer’imana, tuzabihemberwa nta shiti; turi hafi guhabw’ubugingo bw’iteka ryose! nitugera mw'ijuru, mbeg'umunezero tuzagira!' turirimb’indirimbo nziza z’abanesheje. dor’ikamba rir’imbere yacu, tuzaryambikirwa mw’ijuru, n’ahantu h’igikundiro, harahebuje rwose. nitugera mw'ijuru, mbeg'umunezero tuzagira!' turirimb’indirimbo nziza z’abanesheje.

hymns.searchText: mu maboko ya yesu 353 mu maboko ya yesu, ndi mu gituza cye! mpabon'umunezero, kubw'urukundo rwe. mbega ngo ndaririmba, nk'abamarayika: aho hantu heza, ku nyanja ya yasipi! mu maboko ya yesu, ndi mu gituza cye; mpabon'umunezero, kubw'urukundo rwe. mu maboko ya yesu, anyitaho rwose; ntsind'ibigeragezo, ni ho nesh'icyaha. mu maboko ya yesu, hehe n'umubabaro! ntabwo ngishidikanya, yes'amar'ubwoba. mu maboko ya yesu, ndi mu gituza cye; mpabon'umunezero, kubw'urukundo rwe. yesu mukunzi wanjye, wowe nihishamo; ni wowe niringira, wowe wampfiriye. gitare gikomeye, ndagutegereje; nuza ku manywa cyangwa nijor'uzanjyana! mu maboko ya yesu, ndi mu gituza cye; mpabon'umunezero, kubw'urukundo rwe.

hymns.searchText: mbe! basare tugashya 354 mbe! basare tugashya tugana hakurya; nidusakirana n’umuraba, har’aho gutsik’ubwato, ku cyambu gituje cyane. ku cyambu gi-hora gitekanye iteka, i-wacu mw’ijuru hahora hatuje! ku cyambu gituje, hahor’amahoro! (hahor’amahoro.) twe kurangamir’inyungu z’igihe gito, nta mumaro zifite haba namba! dushak’aho dutsika, ku nkombe hakury’iwacu. ku cyambu gi-hora gitekanye iteka, i-wacu mw’ijuru hahora hatuje! ku cyambu gituje, hahor’amahoro! (hahor’amahoro.) n’ubw’ubukana bw’inyanja bwakara gute! urusaku rukaba rwinshi cyane! ntacyo ruzadutwara, yes’azaruducyahira. ku cyambu gi-hora gitekanye iteka, i-wacu mw’ijuru hahora hatuje! ku cyambu gituje, hahor’amahoro! hymns.searchText: turakuramya mana 355 tuje kukuramya mana yacu y'icyubahiro, twubamye nk'ukw'indabyo zimer'imbere y'izuba. wow'utang'umunezero, utubabarir'ibyaha; utumurikire mana twe guteshuk'inzira. imirimo yawe mana yigaragaza hose! ijuru n'isi bihamya icyubahiro cyawe; inyenyeri, izuba n'inyanja, ndetse n'imisozi, n'inyoni ziririmbira mu biti by'inzitane. soko y'imigisha yose, uratubabarira! ni wowe nyir'ubuzima, ni wow'utubeshaho. utwuzuze urukundo, uduhire mana yacu; uduhaz'umunezero, turagusabye mana.

hymns.searchText: ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda 357 nishimiye ko data wa twese, yandikishij'iby'urukundo rwe. mu byanditswe muri bibiliya, nta cyaruta yuko yes'ankunda. ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda; arankunda, arankunda! ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda; anyakir'uko ndi. iyo nyobye maze ngateshuka, ntabw'ajy'amvirira haba namba. angaruz'ineza n'urukundo, nkamugarukira kukw'ankunda. ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda; arankunda, arankunda! ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda; anyakir'uko ndi. ningera mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru, nzaririmb'indirimbo z'ikuzo. ariko cyane cyane nzishima, ndirimb'urukundo rw'umukiza. ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda; arankunda, arankunda! ndishimye pe! yes'arankunda; anyakir'uko ndi.
hymns.title: Ndishimye Pe! Yes'Arankunda

hymns.searchText: yesu yarampinduye rwose! 358 nahoze ndindagira mu mwijima w'ibyaha; maze yes'arambatura, none narahindutse; nd'umwana w'imana rwos'ubu, mfit'amahoro. yarampinduye rwose, anyigisha gusenga. nzasingiz'urukundo rwe! ubu yangiz'uwe rwose; nahinduts'umuntu mushya. nahoze nd'ikigenge, sinari nzi gusenga; yes'araz'arampindura, yankunze bihebuje; arapfa kubwanjye; ubu narihannye rwose. yarampinduye rwose, anyigisha gusenga. nzasingiz'urukundo rwe! ubu yangiz'uwe rwose; nahinduts'umuntu mushya. urukund'umunezero n'amahoro, ni byo byuzuy'umutima wanjye! yesu yanyuzuyemw'amp'ubugingo bushya; nzibanira na w'iteka. yarampinduye rwose, anyigisha gusenga. nzasingiz'urukundo rwe! ubu yangiz'uwe rwose; nahinduts'umuntu mushya.
hymns.title: Yesu Yarampinduye Rwose!

hymns.searchText: umucyo uva mw'ijuru 359 umucyo uva mw'ijuru, uyobor'abagenzi, uzadufasha tugere, ku nkombe yo hakurya. mwami yes'umucyo waw'umurikir'abagenzi winjire mu nyanja, maz'ubakingir'umuraba. umwijim'urabuditse, inyanj'irahorera; yes'aduhozahw'amas' azadufasha twambuke. mwami yes'umucyo waw'umurikir'abagenzi winjire mu nyanja, maz'ubakingir'umuraba. mutyo ducan'amatara, dukomez'urugendo. twe kuyobywa n'abasare, badafit'urumuri. mwami yes'umucyo waw'umurikir'abagenzi winjire mu nyanja, maz'ubakingir'umuraba.
hymns.title: Umucyo Uva Mw'Ijuru

hymns.searchText: wisubika kwihana nshuti 360 wisubika kwihana nshuti; ni nko kubwir'umwuka wera, ngo genda rwose, jye nzihan'undi munsi. mbega ng'uribuza amahirwe! wisubika kwihana nshuti; dore yes'atez'ibiganza. ihan'uyu munsi, emer'umusange; aguh'ubugingo agukize. wisubika kwihana nshuti; dor'igihe kirarangiye. rwos'igihe cy'imbabazi kirashize, fatirana bwang'usange yesu.
hymns.title: Wisubika Kwihana Nshuti

hymns.searchText: ubuntu butangaje! 361 mbeg'ubuntu butangaje cyane! umutindi nkanjye gukizwa! ntabwo nabonaga, none ndabona. nakijijw'ibyaha byanjye. n'ubuntu bwanyerets'aho nari; nari mu byaha byinshi cyane. kubw'ubuntu yesu yarandokoye; singifit'ubwoba rwose. navanywe mu kaga nari ndimo; mpagaze mu buntu bwa yesu. kubw'ubwo buntu nzager'ibudapfa; mw'ijuru kwa data heza! imyak'igihumbi ndi mw'ijuru; nzabanayo n'umwami yesu. mbeg'indirimbo nziza nzaririmba! nzaba nkeye cyane rwose.
hymns.title: Ubuntu Butangaje!

hymns.searchText: n'umutima utuje 362 n'umutim'utuje, nj'imbere yawe; umbe hafi yesu, nkumve bugufi. nta rindi jwi nshaka kumva na gato; kerets'ijwi ryawe, yesu mukiza. amagambo yaw'ambe mu mutima; yes'ump'ubugingo bw'iteka ryose.

lines: Nta rindi jwi nshaka kumva na gato;

hymns.title: N'Umutima Utuje

hymns.searchText: yesu mu bugingo bwanjye 363 mbese har'icyanezeza, nko kubana na yesu? nta cyanezeza nko kubana n'uwo munyakuri. niba har'ikinezeza, kurut'ibindi byose; yesu mu bugingo bwanjye, rwos'andutira byose yitangiye kuncungura, kubw'ubuntu bw'imana. urukundo rwe rusumb' ijuru n'inyanja zose. niba har'ikinezeza, kurut'ibindi byose; yesu mu bugingo bwanjye, rwos'andutira byose ntacyo nshobora gukena, mfit'uwo mucunguzi. ni w'ump'ibyo nkennye byose, ni w'unshoboza byose. niba har'ikinezeza, kurut'ibindi byose; yesu mu bugingo bwanjye, rwos'andutira byose ku mugez'ubengerana, nzaririmb'indirimbo; ndi kumwe n'abarokotse, turirimbir'imana. niba har'ikinezeza, kurut'ibindi byose; yesu mu bugingo bwanjye, rwos'andutira byose
hymns.title: Yesu Mu Bugingo Bwanjye

hymns.searchText: nyir'ukwiringirwa mana 364 nyir'ukwiringirwa, man'ihoraho, ntabw'ubundikirwa n'umwijima. ntuhinduka mana yac'idatsindwa; kand'uhor'uko wahoze mana. nyir'ukwiringirwa mana ikomeye, ni wow'uduh'ibyo dukeneye. ikiganza cyawe, kitugabira, ibyo dukeneye buri munsi. haba mu cyi cyangwa se mu muvumbi, inyenyeri, izuba n'ukwezi, ibyo waremye byose mana yacu, bihamya k'ur'iman'ikomeye. nyir'ukwiringirwa mana ikomeye, ni wow'uduh'ibyo dukeneye. ikiganza cyawe, kitugabira, ibyo dukeneye buri munsi. ugir'imbabazi n'impuhwe nyinshi. umunsi ku wund'uraturinda. uduh'ibyiringiro bikomeye; by'uko tuzabahw'iteka ryose. nyir'ukwiringirwa mana ikomeye, ni wow'uduh'ibyo dukeneye. ikiganza cyawe, kitugabira, ibyo dukeneye buri munsi.

lines: Haba mu cyi cyangwa se mu muvumbi,

hymns.title: Nyir'Ukwiringirwa Mana

hymns.searchText: dor'umwami yes'araje 365 dor'umwami yes'araje, nguriya araje mu bicu. ashagawe n'abamarayika, benshi batabarika. ndatwaranira rwose, kugera mw'ijuru heza. haleluya yesu nahimbazwe! reb'abera bazamurwa, baririmb'indirimbo nziza. impanda zirangurura, mbega ngo yes'aramwenyura! ndatwaranira rwose, kugera mw'ijuru heza. haleluya yesu nahimbazwe!
hymns.title: Dor'Umwami Yes'Araje

hymns.searchText: isoko itemba 366 har'isoko y'ubunt' isokw'ihor'itemba. mu mitim'inaniwe, sokw'iryoshye cyane. n'isoko nziza cyane pe! n'isokw'itumar'inyota. iyo soko, ihora itemba; uyinywaho iramukiza. ndumv'ijwi ryongorera, nk'indirimbo nziza! rituruka mw'isoko nziza idakama. ni yo soko y'ubugingo, ni y'idukiz'ubwihebe. iyo soko, ihora itemba; uyinywaho iramukiza. n'isoko y'umugisha, itang'ibyishimo. n'amaraso ya yes' akiz'abanyabyaha. n'amaraso y'umukiza, kand'aratunganye rwose. iyo soko, ihora itemba; uyinywaho iramukiza.
hymns.title: Isoko Itemba

hymns.searchText: kubw'ijambo ryawe 367 kubw'ijambo ryawe nyagasani, turagushima mwami mana. uduh'amaso abona neza, kangur'imitima yacu. waduhaye bibiliya yera, turagushimye nyagasani. dufashe twumv'ijambo ryawe, tuyoborwe na ryo muremyi. mw'ijambo ryawe harimw'umucyo, tubonamw'amasezerano. n'itabaza ry'ibirenge byacu, ritumurikir'inzira. waduhaye bibiliya yera, turagushimye nyagasani. dufashe twumv'ijambo ryawe, tuyoborwe na ryo muremyi. hahirw'abakomez'iryo jambo, bazabana na yes'iteka. bazarya ku giti cy'ubugingo; hafi y'umugezi mwiza. waduhaye bibiliya yera, turagushimye nyagasani. dufashe twumv'ijambo ryawe, tuyoborwe na ryo muremyi.
hymns.title: Kubw'Ijambo Ryawe

hymns.searchText: kwizera kwanjye 368 kwizera kwanjye kwabonye uburuhukiro; niringiye uhoraho wantangiy'incungu. nta yindi ncungw'ikenewe, yesu yarishye byose. yarapfuye, arazuka; yaranyitangiye. nta bwoba ngifite namba! yes'arampagije. yankuyehw'ibyaha byose, kubw'amaraso ye. nta yindi ncungw'ikenewe, yesu yarishye byose. yarapfuye, arazuka; yaranyitangiye. yesu yaje gukiz' imitima yazimiye. yatanz'amaraso ye, kugira ngo ndokoke. nta yindi ncungw'ikenewe, yesu yarishye byose. yarapfuye, arazuka; yaranyitangiye. har'ijambo rihindura, kandi rimp'ituza. n'ijambo ryiza ry'iman' ijambo ry'ubugingo. nta yindi ncungw'ikenewe, yesu yarishye byose. yarapfuye, arazuka; yaranyitangiye.
hymns.title: Kwizera Kwanjye

hymns.searchText: ibyaha byanjye mbihaye yesu 369 ibyaha byanjye mbihaye yes'umwana w'intama; byose ndabimwikoreje, ngo mbon'umudendezo. ibicumuro byanjye, mbihay'umwami yesu; anyejesh'amaraso ye, anyeze nse n'urubura. kand'ibyo nkennye byose, mbishyize ku birenge bye. yes'akiz'indwara zose, ndetse n'ibicumuro. intimba zanjye zose, nzishyikiriza yesu; kand'imitwaro yanjye yose, yes'arayinyakira. ndifuza kuba nka yesu, niyoroheje nka we. ndifuza kureba yes'umwana w'imana data. ndifuza kuzabana, na yes'iyo mw'ijuru; nkaririmbana n'abera, ntozwa n'abamarayika.
hymns.title: Ibyaha Byanjye Mbihaye Yesu

hymns.searchText: twegerej'igihe 370 twegerej'igihe cyo gutah'iwacu; abacu twabuze tuzongera kubonana. mwami yesu, tegur'ubugingo bwanjye; nyejesh'amaraso yaw'ankiz'ibyaha byanjye. dore duhanganye n'imirab'ikaze; arikw'iri hafi kurangira bidatinze. tugiye kwiber'ahatab'amakuba; yesu nkiz'ibyaha mbashe kuzager'iwawe. intugunda zose zigiye gushira. turi hafi guhanagurw'amarira yose. mwami yesu wamviriye amaraso. mfasha rwose, nzabe mur'uwo muns'uhiriwe. n'igihe kigufi yes'akagaruka. yaradupfiriye, kugira ngo tuzabeho. mwami yesu, tegur'ubugingo bwanjye; nyejesh'amaraso yaw'ankiz'ibyaha byanjye.
hymns.title: Twegerej'Igihe

hymns.searchText: nagiriw'ubuntu 371 nagiriw'ubuntu na yesu, n'ubuntu bw'ikirenga rwose. umutwaro w'ibyaha byanjye, wasigaye i kaluvari. kubw'ubuntu bw'imana, butangaje cyane: mbeg'ubuntu! ubuntu, bwankijij'ibyaha. mbeg'ubuntu, mbeg'ubuntu; bw'imana butangaje cyane: mbeg'ubuntu! mbeg'ubuntu! ubuntu bwankijij'ibyaha ibyaha byarazimanganye; mbese nk'uk'umurab'utuza. kubw'ubuntu butarondorwa; nakize kubw'umusaraba. kubw'ubuntu bw'imana, butangaje cyane: mbeg'ubuntu! ubuntu, bwankijij'ibyaha. mbeg'ubuntu, mbeg'ubuntu; bw'imana butangaje cyane: mbeg'ubuntu! mbeg'ubuntu! ubuntu bwankijij'ibyaha ubuntu butagereranywa, bwahawe uwizera wese. ushaka kubon'agakiza, nasange yes'aramwakira. kubw'ubuntu bw'imana, butangaje cyane: mbeg'ubuntu! ubuntu, bwankijij'ibyaha. mbeg'ubuntu, mbeg'ubuntu; bw'imana butangaje cyane: mbeg'ubuntu! mbeg'ubuntu! ubuntu bwankijij'ibyaha
hymns.title: Nagiriw'Ubuntu

hymns.searchText: kwa kwizera kw'abakurambere 372 kwa kwizera kw'abakurambere, kwa kundi kwababashishaga, kwemera kuzir'akarengane; kwicishw'inkota n'umuriro. uko kwizera natw'ubu, tugufite mu mitima. tuzakunambaho rwose, n'iyo byaba ngombwa gupfa. baraboshywe baranakubitwa, baroshywe mu mazu y'imbohe; bajugunywa mu byobo by'intare, nyamara bagumye kwizera! uko kwizera natw'ubu, tugufite mu mitima. tuzakunambaho rwose, n'iyo byaba ngombwa gupfa. n'ubwo batotejwe bikomeye, nta nzika bigeze bagira! ntibikomy'ababatotezaga, babasabirag'imigisha! uko kwizera natw'ubu, tugufite mu mitima. tuzakunambaho rwose, n'iyo byaba ngombwa gupfa.
hymns.title: Kwa Kwizera Kw'Abakurambere

hymns.searchText: tur'abagenzi 373 tur'abagenzi mw'iyi si, twerekeje mw'ijuru. yes'araduhamagara, ku nkombe ya yor’dani. yes'uw'uduhamagara, arashaka ko tumusanga, tukabana mu bwiza bwe, turirimb'iteka. bizab'umunezero kubana na yesu, mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru, turirimb'iteka. itorero rye ryo mw'ijuru, rizaririmb'aleluya! rihimbaza yes'umwami mucunguzi wacu! mbeg'ukuntu bizaba byiza, kumv'amajwi meza; asingiz'umwana w'intam' amajw'atey'ubwuzu! kand'amajwi yac'azab' urwunge n'ay'abamarayika. twese tuzaririmbira umwami w'abami. bizab'umunezero kubana na yesu, mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru, turirimb'iteka. itorero rye ryo mw'ijuru, rizaririmb'aleluya! rihimbaza yes'umwami mucunguzi wacu! abacunguwe na kristo, bazabon'ubwiza bwe, n'abapfuye bamwizeye, bazakangurwa na we. tuzasingiz'intsinzi ye, twese dukikij'intebe ye. tuzataramana n'umwam'atuganirize. bizab'umunezero kubana na yesu, mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru, turirimb'iteka. itorero rye ryo mw'ijuru, rizaririmb'aleluya! rihimbaza yes'umwami mucunguzi wacu! dor'umunsi w'uwiteka, uri hafi kugera, kand'abamwizeye twese, tuzamusanganira. tuzasingiz'urukundo, rwatumye atang'umwana we, yesu krist'akadupfir' akadukiz'urupfu. bizab'umunezero kubana na yesu, mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru, turirimb'iteka. itorero rye ryo mw'ijuru, rizaririmb'aleluya! rihimbaza yes'umwami mucunguzi wacu!
hymns.title: Tur'Abagenzi

hymns.searchText: duhimbaz'imana y'abrahamu 374 mana y'abrahamu, data wo mw'ijuru; mana y'urukundo, uhorahw'iteka. uwiteka mana, ijuru n'isi bikuramye. izina ryawe niryubahwe, muremyi wacu. mana y'abrahamu, mu biganza byawe, ugabir'is'umunezero nyakuri. ubwema n'ikuzo, n'ibyawe mana yacu nziza. uri kw'isonga, nta wahwana nawe gitare. twese dusingiz'iman' isumba byose. icyubahiro cyose, n'icyawe mana; wowe mana data, man'umwana na mwuka wera; nyir'ubushoboz'uhimbazwe, iteka ryose.
hymns.title: Duhimbaz'Imana Y'Abrahamu

hymns.searchText: mbeg'urukundo! 375 mbeg'urukundo ruhebuje byose! turasaba man'urukomeze; rub'urukundo rw'iteka n'iteka; nibab'umwe muri wowe mana. bah'ubuzima bwiza mana yacu; bibere mu bwishingizi bwawe. ubahe gushikama mu kwizera; banesh'imibabaro y'iyi si. bah'ubutwari buzira kwiheba; banezerwe bagir'amahoro; man'ubahe urukundo rusāze; bah'urukundo rutagajuka.
hymns.title: Mbeg'Urukundo!

hymns.searchText: isabato yera, munsi w'uwiteka 376 isabato yera, munsi w'uwiteka; duhabw'amahirwe, yo kumv'ijambo ry'imana. mbeg'umunsi mwiza, umunsi w'imana! ukwiye kubahwa rwose, tukaramy'imana. abera b'ijuru baterana natwe; tugafatanya guhimbaz' umuremyi wacu. ubwo tuzava mw'iyi si y'igomero; tuzakomereza kwez' isabato mw'ijuru.
hymns.title: Isabato Yera, Munsi W'Uwiteka

hymns.searchText: shuri ry'isabato nkunda 377 shuri ry'isabato nkunda, munezero wanjye; unyongeramw'imbaraga; mu rugamba ndwana. mvugisha mwami yesu, nyongera kwizera. mw'ishuri ryo kw'isabato; ntabwo nzacogora. nig'ibyigisho by'ingenzi, umunsi ku wundi. bituma nsobanukirwa, ibyiza by'ijuru. mvugisha mwami yesu, nyongera kwizera. mw'ishuri ryo kw'isabato; ntabwo nzacogora. mw'ishuri ryo kw'isabato, twiga bibiliya; tugahabw'amabang' atuma twizera cyane. mvugisha mwami yesu, nyongera kwizera. mw'ishuri ryo kw'isabato; ntabwo nzacogora.
hymns.title: Shuri ry'Isabato Nkunda

hymns.searchText: mwami ha umugisha uru rugo 378 aba bashyingiwe, bah'umugisha wawe; wow'ubagiz'umwe, by'itek'uyu munsi. barabagiranishwe n'ubwiza bwawe. bagwiriz'urukundo n'umunezero. bari ku birenge, byawe mwam'ubahire; uhir'amasezerano bagiranye. mu nzira y'ubuzima bwab'ubane na bo; bahore babumbatiwe naw'iteka. amahoro yawe, atah'urugo rwabo; kand'ijambo ryawe, ribamurikire. yes'abane na bo, mu migendere yabo. yes'ahore yonger'urukundo rwabo. baba mu mahoro, haba se mu makuba; yes'ubagumane, mu maboko yawe. be guhungabanywa n'imiraba y'iyi si; ukuboko kwawe kubahe kunesha.

lines: Mu nzira y'ubuzima bwab'ubane na bo;
Yes'abane na bo, Mu migendere yabo.
Baba mu mahoro, Haba se mu makuba;

hymns.title: Mwami Ha Umugisha Uru Rugo

hymns.searchText: mbeg'umunsi mwiza! 379 mbeg'umunsi mwiza! n'umunsi wera de! munsi wo kuruhukwa; twongerwa mw'imbaraga. kand'umwuka wera, aterana natwe; agatesh'inkomyi yatubuz'umudendezo. mbeg'ikiruhuko! gituma turamya, imana yo mw'ijuru, maze tugasābana. mbeg'umunsi mwiza, umunsi wejejwe! imitim'irakanguka; tukanesh'urupfu.
hymns.title: Mbeg'Umunsi Mwiza!

hymns.searchText: umunsi w'isabat'uragarutse 380 umunsi w'isabat'uragarutse; munsi wera wahiriwe n'imana yacu. munsi mwiza turuhuk'imirimo; munsi w'ituze, munsi w'amahoro. twite kur'uyu munsi w'uwiteka; twige kandi tumenye gukor'iby'ashaka. azajya yumv'amasengesho yacu; n'indirimbo zacu zizamunyura. uwiteka mana, duteg'amatwi; wumv'ijwi ry'abana bawe bagutakira. udukomerez'amasezerano; ubuntu bwawe busage muri twe. data wo mw'ijur'ur'umurengezi; ni wowe twubatsehw'ibyiringiro byacu. ur'inshuti itadutererana; icyubahiro kib'icyawe mana!
hymns.title: Umunsi W'Isabat'Uragarutse

hymns.searchText: mwami nyir'isabato 381 mwami nyir'isabato yera de! nkez'umunsi wawe w'ikiruhuko. muns'umpora ku mutima, n'umuns'ungarura mw'intege; mpabwamw'imigisha ngakomera. munsi wuj'amahoro n'ituze, umunsi wose numva nezerewe! intekerezo mbi zose, zirahunga zikanjya kure; nkibwir'ibyiza byera by'ijuru. mbeg'ukunt'ar'iby'igikundiro, iyo ngeze mu munsi wahiriwe! nkumv'indirimbo z'ihozo, ntwarwa gusa n'ibyo mw'ijuru! munsi mwiza mbonamw'imigisha. ntaramana nawe mwami yesu, mur'uyu munsi mwiza wahiriwe! jyew'umugaragu wawe, gukomez'isabato yawe, bizampesha imigisha myinshi.
hymns.title: Mwami Nyir'Isabato

hymns.searchText: umubano uba mwiza 382 umubano uba mwiza, mu rugo yes'arimo; urukundo ruranesha, hab'ituze rihamye. ikinyabupfura ni cyo kiranga urwo rugo, umugabo n'umugore, iyo bubah'imana. urugo rwunguts'umwana, hab'ibyishimo byinshi. nahabw'uburere bwiza, ab'umwana w'ijuru; umwan'unezez'imana, kand'uzabana na yo; abane n'umwami yesu, kand'ayoborwe na we. urugo rwa hano mw'isi, n'urw'igihe kigufi, n'ubund'ibyo mw'isi byose, ntabwo biramba rwose. ibyiza birut'ibindi, kandi bizahoraho, tuzahurizwa mw'ijuru; tuzabana by'iteka. ibyo duhabwa n'imana mu rugendo turimo; tubyakiran'ibyishimo, tubyifatemo neza. twirinde gutsindwa n'ibigeragezo by'umwanzi; dusarur'iby'urukundo, rw'imana yac'iduha.
hymns.title: Umubano Uba Mwiza

hymns.searchText: mu gihe ntugarijwe 383 mu gihe ntugarijwe n'akaga gakomeye; yes'umbwiz'ijwi ryiz'uti: humura ndahari. iy'umurab'ukaramye, ntabwo mpungabana. krist'ankomez'ambwir'ati: humura ndahari. umwijim'iy'ubuditse, nkabur'iyo ngana; numv'ijwi rimpabura ngo: humura ndahari.
hymns.title: Mu Gihe Ntugarijwe

hymns.searchText: inyungu n'ibyubahiro… 384 inyungu n'ibyubahiro byo mw'iyi si, jye ndabizinukwa. iyo ndeby'umusaraba yes'umwami yabambweho; nsang'iby'is'ar'impfabusa. yesu yarababajwe cyane, intimba imen'umutima; kubw'ubuntu yangiriye, n'urukundo ruhanitse, rwamuteye kuncungura. nari narazimiye rwose, narabuze ibyiringiro; ancunguz'amaraso ye, nanjye mpabw'icyubahiro; maz'amahor'aransāba. urukundo rwawe rurera, ruhoraho ibihe byose. nzahora ndwogez'iteka, kandi nzahora ndurata; sinzareka kuruvuga!
hymns.title: Inyungu N'Ibyubahiro…

hymns.searchText: munsi mwiza w'umunezero 385 munsi mwiza w'umunezero! ur'umunsi wera de! ur'umuns'urut'indi yose; munsi wo kuruhukwa. abakomeye n'aboroheje, bunamir'uwiteka; baririmba: wera! wera! wera! uhimbazw'iteka. muns'urinzwe cyane n'imana; nta cyawuhungabanya. tugomororerw'amasoko yo muri paradizo. soko y'amariba mez'afutse, y'amaz'amar'inyota. duhagarara kuri pisiga, tureb'i kanani. n'umunsi tuzirikana cyan'urukundo rw'imana; turushaho gutekereza ibyiza byo mw'ijuru. duhabw'imigisha myinshi cyane, mur'uyu munsi mwiza; twumva rwose twakwigumira, mur'uyu munsi wera!

lines: Munsi mwiza w'umunezero! Ur'umunsi wera de!
Duhabw'imigisha myinshi cyane, Mur'uyu munsi mwiza;
Twumva rwose twakwigumira, Mur'uyu munsi wera!

hymns.title: Munsi Mwiza W'Umunezero

hymns.searchText: ibyaremwe byose… 386 ibyaremwe byose nibiter'amajwi hejuru; byishimir'umuremyi, bimuririmbire. koko yaraturemye; kandi n'umurinzi wacu, n'umuyobozi wacu, kugez'imperuka. adukingir'ibihe byose, atugend'imber'iteka. mu mwijim'atuber'inkingi y'umuriro; atamurur'ibihu; akadukiz'umwijima; tukagendera mu mucyo wera w'imana. yahanits'inyenyeri; ategek'izuba kuva. ni we wahanz'imisozi, n'inyanja zose; imigezi n'inzuzi n'amasoko birasuma! byose kw'itegeko ry'umuremy'udukunda. guhera mu bushorishori, no mu kuzimu mu nyanja; byose bihamy'imana, yukw'ar'umuremyi. natwe biradukwiye, guhanik'amajwi yacu; tugasingiz'iyo mana; tuti: hozana!

lines: Guhera mu bushorishori, No mu kuzimu mu nyanja;

hymns.title: Ibyaremwe Byose…

hymns.searchText: iyo ngukoreye yesu 387 iyo ngukoreye yesu, biranezeza; iri turo ntuye, mwami rikunezeze. nguhay'ubugingo bwanjye, bwakire yesu kubw'ubuntu bwawe mwami, undind'ibibi. warancunguye mukiza, mb'uwawe rwose. none rer'umbashishe, gukor'iby'ushaka. nguhay'ubugingo bwanjye, bwakire yesu kubw'ubuntu bwawe mwami, undind'ibibi. ungir'umumarayika wihuta cyane; njyan'ijambo ryawe hose, mvug'ubutumwa. nguhay'ubugingo bwanjye, bwakire yesu kubw'ubuntu bwawe mwami, undind'ibibi. rwose kuzaba mw'ijuru, ni byo nifuza; nta byago nta n'amakuba bizantezura. nguhay'ubugingo bwanjye, bwakire yesu kubw'ubuntu bwawe mwami, undind'ibibi.
hymns.title: Iyo Ngukoreye Yesu

hymns.searchText: gihome kidukingira 388 mana yac'urakomeye; gihome kidukingira; udukingir'imiraba, y'ingorane n'amakuba. uturind'umwanzi uhor'aduhiga; afit'imbaraga, ntabwo twamwifasha; ntitwamwibashisha na gato. dushatse kwirwanirira, twatsindwa rwose ruhemu. keretse dufite yesu, we mukiranutsi wera. yaneshej'umwanzi; kandi yiteguye kuturwanirira; turi kumwe na we; nta kabuza tuzanesha. iyi si yuzuy'ibibi, bishobora kuturimbura. ntidukwiye guhabuka; twisung'umucyo w'imana. ntiduterw'ubwoba n'umwanzi w'umucyo. ni se w'umwijima; kand'azarimburwa; azajugunywa mu muriro! nta wabasha guhindura ubushake bwa rurema; ibyo yategetse byose, ntibikomwa mu nkokora. n'ubwo byab'urupfu, cyangw'ikindi cyose, ijambo ry'imana nta cyarivanaho, kugez'iteka n'iteka.
hymns.title: Gihome Kidukingira

hymns.searchText: gihome kidukingira 389 mukristo byuka, yes'aragushaka. ambar'intwaro zose z'urugamba; hangana n'umwanz'udafit'ubwoba; rwana; shikama; ntutiny'urugamba. tyo shikama, ukomere ub'intwari; utsind'umubisha. rwanira yesu, ushyizeh'umwete; kand'ube maso kugez'iherezo; ujy'aho yes'akuyobora hose. rwana; shikama; ntutiny'urugamba. tyo shikama, ukomere ub'intwari; utsind'umubisha. ntushidikanye yesu n'umugaba. azakurinda; azagukomeza, kand'akuyoboresh'urukundo rwe. rwana; shikama; ntutiny'urugamba. tyo shikama, ukomere ub'intwari; utsind'umubisha.
hymns.title: Gihome Kidukingira

hymns.searchText: mbes'aho tuzahurira ku cyambu? (b) 390 mbes'aho tuzahurira, ku cyambu cya rwa ruzi, ahahor'umucy'iteka, ntihab'umubabaro? se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka? tuzahurira ku cyamb' urugendo rurangiye? mbes'aho tuzahurirayo, maze twiruhutse? se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka? mbes'aho twese tuzahurira mu mudugudu, wubatswe n'uhoraho, urimbishijwe yasipi? se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka? abacunguwe bose, bazaririmb'indirimbo; kand'ibiremwa byose, bizasingiz'uhoraho. se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka? mbes'aho tuzabonana n' abo twakundanaga? maze twumv'amajwi yabo, tubareba mu maso? se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka? mbese tuzabonana na krist' umukiza wacu, aje kujyan'intore ze, mu bwami buhoraho? se koko tuzahurira hakurya y'uruzi? tuzabonanirayo tuhanezererw'iteka?
hymns.title: Mbes'Aho Tuzahurira Ku Cyambu? (B)

hymns.searchText: data umv'isengesho ryacu 391 dat'umv'isengesho ryacu; uduhire, uduh'umugisha. amen.
hymns.title: Data Umv'Isengesho Ryacu

hymns.searchText: ducan'amatara yacu 392 muze dushikame, ducany'amatara yacu; umukw'agiye guhamagar'umugeni we. twitegure kuririmba tuti: hozana! tuzasabwa n'ibyishimo turirimb'aleluya; turirimba aleluya! abamarayika hamwe n'abatoranijwe; bazateranira hamwe, basingize yesu. twitegure kuririmba tuti: hozana! tuzasabwa n'ibyishimo turirimb'aleluya; turirimba aleluya! yesu n'umuneshi wacu, yaratwitangiye. afit'umucy'utangaje, urabagirana. twitegure kuririmba tuti: hozana! tuzasabwa n'ibyishimo turirimb'aleluya; turirimba aleluya! yes'azahamagar'abo yacunguye bose; ati: muz'abihanganye, mu rugo rwa data. twitegure kuririmba tuti: hozana! tuzasabwa n'ibyishimo turirimb'aleluya; turirimba aleluya!

lines: Ati: Muz'abihanganye, Mu rugo rwa Data.

hymns.title: Ducan'Amatara Yacu

hymns.searchText: bana, nimwitonde 393 bana nimwitonde, kandi mwishime; muse n'abo mw'ijuru, munezerwe. mur'abavandimwe, nimukundane; mwubah'ababyeyi, kandi mwumvire. mwirind'umujinya; ntimukabeshye; ibyo muvuga, bishimishe yesu.
hymns.title: Bana, Nimwitonde

hymns.searchText: gupfa ni ibitotsi 394 gupfa n'ibitotsi gusa, kandi by'akanya gato. n'ubw'urupfu rubabaza, rugater'agahinda; ijoro rizatamuruka, maz'umucy'utangaze; abasinziriye mu bituro, bazakangurwa. gupfa n'ibitotsi gusa, kandi by'akanya gato. yesu yaneshej'urupfu; yavuye mu gituro. n'akanya gato gasigaye, tukigira mw'ijuru; aho yes'azatujyana; tuzaban'ibudapfa.
hymns.title: Gupfa Ni Ibitotsi

hymns.searchText: hagarara kigabo nka daniel 395 komez'amategeko yera y'imana; shikama mu kuri kw'imana nka daniel. hagarara kigabo nka daniel; hamy'imana n’ubwo wab'usigay'ur'umwe. benshi barananiwe, bacits'intege; ntibashoboye gushikama nka daniel. hagarara kigabo nka daniel; hamy'imana n’ubwo wab'usigay'ur'umwe. benshi baharanira iby'isi gusa; ntibazi gufat'icyemezo nka daniel. hagarara kigabo nka daniel; hamy'imana n’ubwo wab'usigay'ur'umwe. twirinde cyane rwose, kandi tuneshe; twung'ubumwe na daniel, tumere nka we. hagarara kigabo nka daniel; hamy'imana n’ubwo wab'usigay'ur'umwe.

lines: Shikama mu kuri kw'Imana nka Daniel.

hymns.searchText: ngwino mwuka wera we! 396 ngwino mwuka wera we! maz'uture muri twe. tuber'umuyobozi; tugan'iwacu.
hymns.title: Ngwino Mwuka Wera We!

hymns.searchText: har'igihe ntegereje 397 har'igi-he ntegereje, nza-nezerwamo; icyo gi-he kiri hafi, nza-habw'ikamba. amasengesho yanjye, imana ira-yumva; nzakome-za mpirimbane, nza-habw'ikamba. ikamba ritegereje a-bazanesha. nzashika-ma, nzakomeza nyo-boke yesu; sinshaka kuza-bura mu bwami bwo mw'i-juru; mu biro-ri byateguriwe abaneshi. ndatanya, ndater'intambwe, si-ndeb'inyuma. nyobowe na nyagasani si-nzatezuka; ibirangaza by'isi, simbyitayeho namba! n’ubw'ibi-ndwany'ari byinshi, mfi-t'a-mahoro. mana y'u-buntu n'impuhwe, u-murikire. mfatish'u-kuboko kwawe, ma-z'unkomeze. nd'umunyantege nkeya, ariko nitu-bana, sinshidi-kanya na gato, ma-na nzanesha.

lines: Sinshaka kuza-bura mu bwami bwo mw'i-juru;

hymns.title: Har'Igihe Ntegereje

hymns.searchText: uwiteka ari mu rusengero 398 uwitek'ari mu rusengero; ari mu rusengero rwe rwera. isi yose nituze; duturiz'imbere y'imana; tyo dutuze, dutuze, dutuze. amen.
hymns.title: Uwiteka Ari Mu Rusengero

hymns.searchText: yesu nikoreye umusaraba 399 yesu ndagukurikiye, ndetse byose ndaje mwami. nikorey'umusaraba, ndagukurikiye mukiza. dor'ibyar'indamu zanjye, sinkibyitayeho namba; mpisemo kugira yesu, akaba mu bugingo bwanjye. ab'isi barantoteza, kuko badafite yesu. batay'umukiza wanjye, barashaka kungerageza n'ubwo bampana bakandeka, yesu ampor'iruhande. yes'ampa kwihanganira, ingorane z'iyi si zose. isi yahaw'agakiza, yesu yarayicunguye. yesu yaneshej'icyaha; nta bwoba ngifite na gato. umwuka wer'ari muri twe; mbeg'umunezero mwinshi! nawe yaragupfiriye, ng'uzabane na we mw'ijuru! twar'intwaro zo kwizera; senga cyan'ubudatuza; ugiye gutah'ijuru, hazab'umunezero mwinshi! ibyo dukorera mw'isi, biri hafi kurangira. n'ibyiringiro bishyitse, tuzabona data mw'ijuru.
hymns.title: Yesu Nikoreye Umusaraba

hymns.searchText: mwami nje ngusanga 400 mwami nje ngusanga, nje bugufi bwawe. umpire mwami, wowe soko y'ubugingo bw'iteka; umpire mwami; wowe soko y'ubugingo bw'iteka. mp'umutim'utuje, mwami ndakwinginze. ngwin'umvugishe, unganirize, mwami mwiza wera; ngwin'umvugishe, unganirize, mwami mwiza wera. umpe gusa nawe, mpa kamere yawe; ndashaka rwose kumera nkawe, mpa kumera nkawe; ndashaka rwose kumera nkawe, mpa kumera nkawe. mp'ubutwari mwami, unshoboze mwami; umpe gukor'umurimo wawe, uko bikwiriye; umpe gukor'umurimo wawe, uko bikwiriye. ubw'uzab'uje kujyan'intore zawe; nanjy'uzanjyane mwami w'abami, ubw'uzagaruka; nanjy'uzanjyane mwami w'abami, ubw'uzagaruka.

hymns.searchText: uko duteraniye hamwe 401 uko tur'aha, duteraniye hamwe, mwami nyagasan'uduh'umugisha. uduhana kugira ngo twihan'ibyaha; n’ubwo tur'abanyabyaha, ntujy'utureka. ni wow'uturinda, nyagasani mana; wow'udushyira ku murimo wawe. ni wowe uduha kunesha ku rugamba, maz'imana yac'igahabw'icyubahiro. twererez'izina ryawe mana yera. urind'umukumbi waw'amakuba, utuber'umurengezi mu bihe byose. duh'umudendezo, tuguhimbaze mana.

lines: Ni wowe uduha kunesha ku rugamba,

hymns.searchText: mfat'ikiganza 402 mu gihe ndi hafi kubur'ibyiringiro; mu gihe ntentebutse; yesu ndakwinginze, wumve gutaka kwanjye; mfat'ikiganza, maz'ungez'iwacu. mwami mwiza cyane, umfate unkomeze. ndarushye, ndihebye, nta ntege. mu mwijim'ukaze, umfate unkomeze; mfat'ikiganza, maz'ungez'iwacu. mu gihe mbundikiwe n'umwijima mwinshi, w'ibyago n'amakuba, umpe kwambuk'inyanja y'ibigeragezo. mfat'ikiganza, maz'ungez'iwacu. mwami mwiza cyane, umfate unkomeze. ndarushye, ndihebye, nta ntege. mu mwijim'ukaze, umfate unkomeze; mfat'ikiganza, maz'ungez'iwacu.

hymns.searchText: mwami wanjye nyakira 403 mwami wanjy'akir'umubiri wanjye; uwuhindur'urusengero rwawe rwera. nywugukoreshereze kujya nguhimbaza, mpore nguhesh'ikuzo. mwami wanjy'akira impano zanjye; zikoresh'uk'ushaka, ziguhesh'ikuzo. ngiz'italanto zanjye, zikuramye mwami, mpore nguhesh'ikuzo. mwami wanjye nguhay'igihe cyanjye; umwanya wose mfite, ndawukweguriye; ngo kimber'igihe cyo gukor'iby'ushaka, mpore nguhesh'ikuzo. mwami wanjy'akir'ubutunzi bwanjye; wabumpereye kugira ngo mbukoreshe. unyonger'imigisha, mubyo nkora byose, mpore nguhesh'ikuzo.
hymns.title: Mwami Wanjye Nyakira

hymns.searchText: mucunguzi mwiza 404 ndareb'umucunguzi wanjye, azamukan'intimba nyinshi! ku musozi wa kaluvari, bamwikorej'umusaraba! ndareb'umucunguzi wanjye, ababaye; agan'i kaluvari. yatew'intimba n'ibyaha byanjye; yarambabarijwe ngo nkire. data mwiza, bababarire! ni ko yasabiy'abagome. amaraso y'arameneka, azir'ibyaha byanjye nawe. ndareb'umucunguzi wanjye, ababaye; agan'i kaluvari. yatew'intimba n'ibyaha byanjye; yarambabarijwe ngo nkire. yes'umucunguz'arankunda; kubw'ibyo nanjye ndamukunda. nzahora muhimbaz'iteka! yarancunguye, nahimbazwe! ndareb'umucunguzi wanjye, ababaye; agan'i kaluvari. yatew'intimba n'ibyaha byanjye; yarambabarijwe ngo nkire.
hymns.title: Mucunguzi Mwiza

hymns.searchText: mpa umugisha waw'ubu 405 mbe data wo mw'ijuru, ngwin'umpire rwos'ubu; umbabarir'ibyaha, unkiz'ibicumuro. data wo mw'ijuru, mp'umugisha waw'ubu nkeney'ubuntu bwawe, nyongerer'imbaraga. ndi kwig'ijambo ryawe, ngwino rwos'umpir'ubu. data wo mw'ijuru, mp'umugisha waw'ubu yesu nkiz'umvaneho imbogamizi zose. ni wowe ndangamiye, nkorah'unyez'ibyaha. data wo mw'ijuru, mp'umugisha waw'ubu nicishije bugufi, mpfukamy'imbere yawe. yesu ngwin'unkiz'ubu, wumve gutaka kwanjye. data wo mw'ijuru, mp'umugisha waw'ubu

hymns.searchText: kuba mu maboko yawe 406 kuba mu maboko yawe, n'iby'igikundiro; man'iyo nkumva bugufi, numva nkomeye cyane. umwikorez'amaganya, umuh'imitwaro yawe. muh'ibikurushya byose, kukw'anezezwa no kukurinda. wemera ko nguh'ibimbabaza byanjye byose, nkakwikorez'amaganya yanjye yos'ukw'angana. umwikorez'amaganya, umuh'imitwaro yawe. muh'ibikurushya byose, kukw'anezezwa no kukurinda. ndakwiringira nyagasani, nguhanz'amaso; ucuby'imiraba, wumv' masengesho dusenga. umwikorez'amaganya, umuh'imitwaro yawe. muh'ibikurushya byose, kukw'anezezwa no kukurinda. iby'ejo ntibimpangayikishije na hato. ko ngufite mana yanjye, naterw'ubwoba n'iki? umwikorez'amaganya, umuh'imitwaro yawe. muh'ibikurushya byose, kukw'anezezwa no kukurinda.

hymns.searchText: mwibur'ibyiringiro 407 mwibur'ibyiringiro, ngo mukuk'imitima. mureke guhogora, abapfiriye muri yesu bazazuka. humuriza bose, bibuts'ayo magambo; ko yesu yapfuye, arikw'akazuka. tuzabana na we, kuko yaducunguye; urupfu ntiruzongera kubaho. igihe kiri bugufi, tyo nimube maso. yes'agiye kwimika ingom'idahanguka, tuzaba mw'iteka. humuriza bose, bibuts'ayo magambo; ko yesu yapfuye, arikw'akazuka. tuzabana na we, kuko yaducunguye; urupfu ntiruzongera kubaho. tyo twe gukuk'imitima, yesu ntazatinda, azaduhanagura amarira ku maso, nta kurir'ukundi. humuriza bose, bibuts'ayo magambo; ko yesu yapfuye, arikw'akazuka. tuzabana na we, kuko yaducunguye; urupfu ntiruzongera kubaho.
hymns.title: Mwibur'Ibyiringiro

hymns.searchText: dushim'umwam'imana 408 duhimbaz'umwam'imana, ushobora byose; umutima wanjy'urahimbaz'imana data. tumuramye, tumuh'icyubahiro, kukw'ar'umwami w'abami. duhimbaz'umwam'utegek'ibyaremwe byose; atubundikishij'amabab'araturinda. mbeg'uburyo ibyo yaremye byose, byumvir'amategeko ye! duhimbaz'umwami, nyir'ibyiza bihebuje! imbabazi ze n'impuhwe bihorahw'iteka. tuzirikan'ibyiz'adukorera, n'inshut'itagereranwa.
hymns.title: Dushim'Umwam'Imana

hymns.searchText: nimuze kwa yes'arabakunda 409 nimuze kwa yes'arabakunda, nimucik'ingoyi z'umwanzi; yesu yiteguye kubakira, atez'ibiganza. mbeg'umuns'uneje-je cyane! kwibera mu mabo-ko ye! mu nzu ya data ni heza cyane, har'umunezero. yemwe banyabyaha nimwitabe, yes'abafitiy'urukundo. mwe kwigomeka nimumusange, mwisubir'inyuma. mbeg'umuns'uneje-je cyane! kwibera mu mabo-ko ye! mu nzu ya data ni heza cyane, har'umunezero. dor'igihe kirihuta bwangu, nimureke kwirindiriza. yes'arahari nimumusange, rwos'arabakira. mbeg'umuns'uneje-je cyane! kwibera mu mabo-ko ye! mu nzu ya data ni heza cyane, har'umunezero.
