hymns.searchText: nkeneye umukiza 411 nkeney'umukiza yesu, nshaka kumwigiraho; nkager'ikirenge mu cye, nca mu nzir'ifunganye. arankunda, arankunda, yes'arankunda cyane! yarapfuy'ari jy'azira; ni yo mpamvu mukunda. nzajy'ahw'azantuma hose, nzahora niteguye. sindi muto byatuma ntabasha kujy'ahw'antuma. arankunda, arankunda, yes'arankunda cyane! yarapfuy'ari jy'azira; ni yo mpamvu mukunda. dor'ahagaze ku rugi, kand'arampamagara. ngo musange anyakire, ankiz'ibyaha byanjye. arankunda, arankunda, yes'arankunda cyane! yarapfuy'ari jy'azira; ni yo mpamvu mukunda.
hymns.title: Nkeneye Umukiza

hymns.searchText: abarembejwe n'ibyaha 412 abarembejwe n'ibyaha, musang'umukiza, arabaruhura, nimumwiringira rwose. mwiringire yesu, nimumwiringire rwose. mwiringire yesu, mumwiringire mukire. yabaviriy'amaraso, ahesh'umugisha; mwiyuhagire mo, arabeza nk'urubura. mwiringire yesu, nimumwiringire rwose. mwiringire yesu, mumwiringire mukire. yesu ni we kuri, ni we nzira y'amahoro, nimumwizer'azabah' ubugingo bw'iteka. mwiringire yesu, nimumwiringire rwose. mwiringire yesu, mumwiringire mukire. nimusang'abera, maze musingize yesu, ni bwo muzatura, mu gihugu cy'amahoro. mwiringire yesu, nimumwiringire rwose. mwiringire yesu, mumwiringire mukire.
hymns.title: Abarembejwe N'Ibyaha

hymns.searchText: ngwino hafi y'umusaraba 413 tyo ngwino hafi y'umusaraba, wa munyabyaha we; ikiganza cya yesu cyiteguye kugukiza. wowe wahumanijwe n'ibyaha, ngwino yes'akweze; wihane yes'akugire mushya mu kanya gato! ngwino yes'agutur'umutwaro, maz'akuruhure; hafi y'umusaraba ni h'uzabon'amahoro. uhor'ufata hirya no hino, wabuz'ishyikizo; ngwino hafi y'umusaraba ubon'agakiza.
hymns.title: Ngwino Hafi Y'Umusaraba

hymns.searchText: wari aho babamby'umwami wanjye? 414 war'aho babamby'umwami yesu? war'aho babamby'umwami wanjye? war'uhari? binter'umubabaro mwinshi. mbese koko war'aho babamby'umwami wanjye? war'uhari abambwa ku giti? war'uhari abambwa ku giti? war'uhari? binter'umubabaro mwinshi. mbese koko war'aho babamby'umwami wanjye? wari yo bamucumit'icumu? wari yo bamucumit'icumu? war'uhari? binter'umubabaro mwinshi. mbese koko war'aho babamby'umwami wanjye? wariy'igih'izuba ryijima? wariy'igih'izuba ryijima? war'uhari? binter'umubabaro mwinshi. mbese koko war'aho babamby'umwami wanjye? war'uhar'igihe bamuhamba? war'uhar'igihe bamuhamba? war'uhari? binter'umubabaro mwinshi. mbese koko war'aho babamby'umwami wanjye?
hymns.title: Wari Aho Babamby'Umwami Wanjye?

hymns.searchText: nimuzan'icyacumi 415 nimwumv'amagambo y'ibyanditswe kera, avug'ati: muzan'icyacumi. nimwih'imana mwezwe, ngo mubon'uko muhabw'umugisha mwinshi. nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse. iman'iti: mungerageze. izabasukahw'imigisha, maze mubur'aho muzayikwiza. nimushak'imbaraga y'umwuka wera, nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse. kandi nimukizane nk'uko byanditswe, ibasukehw'imigisha. nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse. iman'iti: mungerageze. izabasukahw'imigisha, maze mubur'aho muzayikwiza. se har'icyabatandukanya n'imana? nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse; mubone kubana n'imana iteka, isohoz'isezerano. nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse. iman'iti: mungerageze. izabasukahw'imigisha, maze mubur'aho muzayikwiza. nimwegurire yes'imitima yanyu; nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse; nimwizer'isezerano ry'uhoraho, bizabah'umunezero. nimuzan'icyacumi gishyitse. iman'iti: mungerageze. izabasukahw'imigisha, maze mubur'aho muzayikwiza.
hymns.title: Nimuzan'Icyacumi

hymns.searchText: hirya no hino har'umukumbi 416 hirya no hino har'umukumbi, ugoswe n'amakub'akomeye, n'ubutayu bucuz'umwijima, dor'inzira ntabw'igaragara wumv'amajwi mensh'aratabaza, bakeney'umutabazi; har'ijwi ryiza rihumuriza, ribabwira riti: mukomere. uwo mukumb'ukeney'umucyo, ku mategeko cumi y'imana, yukw'ar'ayera kand'aboneye; bakwiriye kuyakurikiza mw'uru rugendo rujya mw'ijuru, bakeneye yesu kristo, kung'ubumw'urukundo kwizera, bakicisha buguf'imbere ye. har'ahantu hahebuj'ubwiza, mu rurembo rurabagirana; amarembo yarw'aruguruye, n'ahantu heza h'igikundiro; hazirana n'icyaha n'urupfu; nta mubabar'uzabayo. aho ni ho tuzateranira, ntabwo tuzongera gupf'ukundi. dore yes'agiye kugaruka hamwe n'ibic'azur'abapfuye. abacunguwe bazazamurwa, baririmbana umunezero. ngwino mwami, ngwin'udutabare; twigir'iwacu mw'ijuru, turagutegereje mukiza, utujyane kwibera mw'ijuru.
hymns.title: Hirya No Hino Har'Umukumbi

hymns.searchText: tur'abasirikari mu ngabo za yesu 417 tur'abasirikari mu ngabo za yesu; ku rugamba tuyobowe na yesu; tugamije gutsinda satani n'ingabo ze, kandi ntiduteze gusubir'inyuma. dushyire hamwe, twitabir'urugamba. yesu ni w'utuyoboy'atur'imbere, n’ubw'urugamba rwakomera rute, tuzarutsinda kubw'umwami yesu. abanzi b'ubutumwa barahagurutse; bagambiriye kutugamburuza. bafit'ishyari ryinshi, n'umujiny'utavugwa, dukomez'ibirindiro tuzanesha. dushyire hamwe, twitabir'urugamba. yesu ni w'utuyoboy'atur'imbere, n’ubw'urugamba rwakomera rute, tuzarutsinda kubw'umwami yesu. tugendere munsi y'ibendera rya yesu; dufit'intwaro zirabagirana; zacuriwe mu ruganda rutoz'urukundo, duharanir'ikamba ritangirika. dushyire hamwe, twitabir'urugamba. yesu ni w'utuyoboy'atur'imbere, n’ubw'urugamba rwakomera rute, tuzarutsinda kubw'umwami yesu. turaharanira kuzataha mw'ijuru; mu bwami bw'umukiza wacu yesu. mubivuge hose mwamamaz'ubutumwa bwe, abantu babumenye bakizw'ibyaha. dushyire hamwe, twitabir'urugamba. yesu ni w'utuyoboy'atur'imbere, n’ubw'urugamba rwakomera rute, tuzarutsinda kubw'umwami yesu.
hymns.title: Tur'Abasirikari Mu Ngabo Za Yesu

hymns.searchText: n'iki cyatuma tumwirengagiza? 418 n'iki cyatuma twirengagiz'umukiza, se har'icyadutera kumwibagirwa? kand'aturinda ku manywa na nijoro, aturagira nk'umwunger'udakenesha. tuzagendera mu mucyo w'umwami wacu iteka, tuzitangira kumukorera, turamwumvira ngw'aduhe k'umwuka we, tubone kumuhesh'icyubahiro cyinshi. n'iki cyatuma twirengagiz'umukiza, tukibagirwa uwatubabarijwe, ubu yicaye ku ntebe ye ya cyami, n'umuhuza wacu w'ibihe bidashira. tuzagendera mu mucyo w'umwami wacu iteka, tuzitangira kumukorera, turamwumvira ngw'aduhe k'umwuka we, tubone kumuhesh'icyubahiro cyinshi. n'iki cyatuma twirengagiz'umukiza, kand'ahor'abera maso kuturinda. n'inshuti nziza irut'izindi zose, nta muntu n'umwe yigera ahemukira. tuzagendera mu mucyo w'umwami wacu iteka, tuzitangira kumukorera, turamwumvira ngw'aduhe k'umwuka we, tubone kumuhesh'icyubahiro cyinshi.

lines: Ubu yicaye ku ntebe ye ya cyami,

hymns.title: N'Iki Cyatuma Tumwirengagiza?

hymns.searchText: inanga z'izahabu ziracurangwa 419 inanga z'izahabu ziracurangwa, amaremb'arakinguk'arinjira. umwami w'imbabazi n'urukundo, yaratabarutse atsinz'urupfu. yesu yasohoj'umurimo we, non'ari mw'ijuru, tumuhimbaze. yavukiye mw'isi ngw'aturokore, arapf'arazuka, ajya mw'ijuru. vuz'impundu koko yaranesheje, nasingizwe n'abo mw'iyi si n'ijuru. yesu yasohoj'umurimo we, non'ari mw'ijuru, tumuhimbaze. twes'abana b'ahor'adusabira, muze tweger'intebe ye y'ubwami. yaduteguriye amazu meza, ngo tuzabaneyo mu munezero. yesu yasohoj'umurimo we, non'ari mw'ijuru, tumuhimbaze.
hymns.title: Inanga Z'Izahabu Ziracurangwa

hymns.searchText: yesu ngwino ubane n'itorero ryawe 420 yesu ngwin'ubane n'itorero ryawe ryose. rifashe, ribashe gutsind'ibigeragezo. ribashe gutunganya nez'inshingano zaryo; riburir'abo mw'isi, bitegur'urubanza. ryite ku batabona, n'abakene bo mw'isi; rihabur'abahabye, ribabwir'ibya yesu. ryuzur'umwuka wera, maze rinesh'icyaha, rihuze mw'isi yose, yesu turakwinginze.
hymns.title: Yesu Ngwino Ubane N'Itorero Ryawe

hymns.searchText: duhimbaze yesu 421 duhimbaze yesu mucunguzi wacu, turirimb'urukundo rwe rwinshi. afit'icyubahiro giheranije; izina rye ryera risingizwe! n'umwungeri mwiza wita ku ntama ze, arind'abana b'ibihe byose. tumuhimbaze tumuh'ikuzo ryinshi, tumutur'indirimbo y'ishimwe. duhimbaze yesu mucunguzi wacu, yatew'intimb'arapfa ku bwacu! ni we byiringiro by'agakiza kacu, ni yubahwe yaratubambiwe. yarababajwe apfa mu cyimbo cyacu, kubw'urukundo rwe rutangaje! tumuhimbaze tumuh'ikuzo ryinshi, tumutur'indirimbo y'ishimwe. duhimbaze yesu mucunguzi wacu, ijuru ryasābwe n'ibyishimo! n'intwari n'umuneshi yambay'ikamba. n'umwami wac'utuvuganira, umwami yesu ugiye kugaruka, azaza mu cyubahiro cyinshi! tumuhimbaze tumuh'ikuzo ryinshi, tumutur'indirimbo y'ishimwe.

lines: N'Umwungeri mwiza wita ku ntama ze,

hymns.title: Duhimbaze Yesu

hymns.searchText: ukw'ibihe bigenda bihita 422 ukw'ibihe bigenda bihita, mpangana n'ibigeragezo; ariko kubwo kwisung'imana, nshobozwa kubitsinda byose. kubwo kwiringir'imana data, sinshobora kwiheba rwose; irankunda birenz'urugero; imp'amahoro n'ibyishimo! uwitek'umwami wanjye mwiza, ntasiba kungirir'impuhwe. yita ku mitwaro yanjye yose, amber'umujyanama mwiza. ni w'urind'imibereho yanjye, kand'afit'imbaraga nyinshi; kumugira n'ubutunzi bwinshi, ni we mahirwe yanjye yose. mfasha data nkomeze nkwizere, n'ubwo nanyura mu makuba, niringir'isezerano ryawe, niringir'ihumure ryawe. unkiz'umuraba w'amakuba, mbashisha guhangana neshe; kw'iherez'uzangeze mw'ijuru, mu gihugu cy'isezerano.
hymns.title: Ukw'Ibihe Bigenda Bihita

hymns.searchText: mfit'umukiza n'inshut'inkunda 423 mfit'umukiza kand'adukunda twese, iyaba namwe mwari mumumenye. aramvuganira kwa data wo mw'ijuru, icyampa namw'akababer'inshuti. yes'aragukunda, umugir'inshuti. kand'abe kw'isonga; azajy'agufasha. yesu yampay'amahoro mu mutima, iyab'ibyo mwari mubizi neza. kubw'amaraso yaviriy'i gologota, nawe numwakira urayahabwa. yes'aragukunda, umugir'inshuti. kand'abe kw'isonga; azajy'agufasha. har'ibyiringiro duhabwa n'imana, iyab'ibyo mwari mubizi neza. ijwi riduhamagara rihumuriza, ritang'amahoro yo mu mutima. yes'aragukunda, umugir'inshuti. kand'abe kw'isonga; azajy'agufasha. mumeny'ubury'umwami yes'abakunda, umutwar'aguha nturemereye. umubwire n'abandi na bo bamumenye, maz'ubabwir'ibyo yagukoreye. yes'aragukunda, umugir'inshuti. kand'abe kw'isonga; azajy'agufasha.
hymns.title: Mfit'Umukiza N'Inshut'Inkunda

hymns.searchText: urukundo rwawe mana 424 urukundo rwawe mana, ni rwo ruduhamagara. ni muri rwo twaremewe, ni na rwo rutubeshaho. n'ubwo twagucumuyeho, tugaruts'imbere yawe. tuje kugutur'intimba z'imitima imenetse; tugoswe n'ingoyi nyinshi, zitubuz'umudendezo; utuvane mu bwigunge, uduhaz'ibyiringiro. mana data muri yesu watugiz'abana bawe; ntacyo twakoze na kimwe, cyaduhesh'ayo mahirwe; n'ubuntu bwawe nyagasani, twese tugupfukamire! imitima yacu mana, icishwe bugufi cyane; dusingize mu ndirimbo, imana yakunz'ab'isi; yatugize inshuti zayo, natwe tuyikunde cyane. ni y'iduh'umudendezo, muri yes'umwana wayo; kubw'amaraso yavuye, twagizwe bashya muri we; kubw'ubugingo bwe yatanze, twagizw'abana b'imana!
hymns.title: Urukundo Rwawe Mana

hymns.searchText: ni mutyo turirimbe… 425 nimutyo turirimbe ineza ya yesu, ibyishimo bisābe imitima yacu. twabony'agakiza, kavuye mw'ijuru; twahaw'umukiza, twahaw'umukiza. n'umunezero mwinshi, twarababariwe; imana yadukuyehw'iteka ryo gupfa. yesu yikorey'imitwaro y'ibyaha; yaradupfiriye, yaradupfiriye, ku ntebe y'ubwami kwa data wo mw'ijuru, dufit'umuvugizi utuvuganira; uturwanirira kandi n'umuneshi; yaradutsindiye, n'umuneshi wacu. yambik'abo yacunguye bos'ubwiza bwe, akabah'imico ye iboneye rwose. kubw'ubuntu bw'atuyoboz'umwuka we, n’ukuri kwe kwera, n’ukuri kwe kwera. yes'ari hafi kugaruka mu bwiza bwe; azaza kutujyana tw'abo yacunguye; twimane na we mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru; tuzamwirebera, tuzamwirebera.

lines: Ku ntebe y'ubwami kwa Data wo mw'ijuru,
N’ukuri kwe kwera, N’ukuri kwe kwera.
Yes'ari hafi kugaruka mu bwiza bwe;
Twimane na we mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru;

hymns.title: Ni Mutyo Turirimbe…

hymns.searchText: har'urukundo rutangaje 426 har'urukundo rutangaje, runzamura mu bitekerezo, nkamera amababa, nkumva nigereye mw'ijuru, nkibona ndi hamwe n'umukiza, ndi gusangira na we. ndi ku musozi muremure, maze ndeb'iburasirazuba, mbon'igihugu cyiza, n'igihugu gitey'ubwuzu. n'igihugu cy'amata n'ubuki, n'imbuto z'agahozo. ibyo kurya by'icyo gihugu, twabiteguriwe n'uwiteka. ni byiza bitavugwa! iman'izatumwenyurira, tuzaba turi kumwe na yesu, mu bwami bwo mw'ijuru. nshaka kwambuka yorodani, ngatandukana n'imibabaro, n'amakuba by'iyi si, y'ibyago no gushidikanya; n'ubutayu n'isi y'igomero, mw'iyi si si hw'iwacu.
hymns.title: Har'Urukundo Rutangaje

hymns.searchText: icyampa igihe kikihuta bwangu 427 icyamp'igihe kikihuta bwangu, nkigira iwacu! nkibera mu mahoro nta kuganya, ndahakumbuye. tuzakomeza dukorer' umwami wacu yesu, kugez'ubw'azatugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza du - rer' u - mwami wacu, wacu, kugez'ubw'a - tugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza dukorer' u - mwami wacu ye - yesu, kugez'ubw'azatugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza du - rer' umwami wacu ye - yesu, kugez'ubw'atu - geza mw'ijuru. mur'iyi si nta mutekan'ubamo, n'is'irimw'akaga; n'isi yuzuyemo imibabaro, s'iyo guturwa. tuzakomeza dukorer' umwami wacu yesu, kugez'ubw'azatugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza du - rer' u - mwami wacu, wacu, kugez'ubw'a - tugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza dukorer' u - mwami wacu ye - yesu, kugez'ubw'azatugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza du - rer' umwami wacu ye - yesu, kugez'ubw'atu - geza mw'ijuru. nzibera mu ruhande rw'umukiza, sinzamurekura; azambashisha kunesha urupfu, ntashye mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza dukorer' umwami wacu yesu, kugez'ubw'azatugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza du - rer' u - mwami wacu, wacu, kugez'ubw'a - tugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza dukorer' u - mwami wacu ye - yesu, kugez'ubw'azatugeza mw'ijuru. tuzakomeza du - rer' umwami wacu ye - yesu, kugez'ubw'atu - geza mw'ijuru.
hymns.title: Icyampa Igihe Kikihuta Bwangu

hymns.searchText: haguruka, haguruka 428 umwam'araguhamagara haguruka. akuyobora mu mucyo, mu nzira yo kwizera; mu rugendo rwo mw'iyi si, wigir'ubwoba rwose; ngaho haguruka. komera shikama b'intwari ku rugamba; n'ubwo satan'atontoma, yarangije gutsindwa; yesu yaramunesheje, komez'ibendera rye; komera shikama. komeza komeza, rwanan'ibyiringiro; ririmb'indirimb'igutera gushikama cyane. ntugashidikanye rwose, gir'umutim'utuje; komez'ukomere!
hymns.title: Haguruka, Haguruka

hymns.searchText: intekerezo zanjye zibera mw'ijuru 429 dor'intekerezo zanjye zibera mw'ijuru, ibyiringiro byanjye ni ho bituriza; mu mucyo w'uwiteka, yes'azaduhuriza; mw'ijuru, ibudapfa ni ho tuzibera. mw'ijuru nta mibabaro, tuzaba dutuje; tuzahanagurw'amarira tugezeyo. nta rupfu ruzabayo, nta kiduhungabanya; tuzabana by'iteka, turi mu mahoro. mbeg'ukuntu tuzishima, twongeye guhura, n'abo twari twaratandukanijwe kera! mw'iteraniro ryiza, maze duhoberane, twibere mu byishimo bitazahinduka. mbeg'inanga z'izahabu zizacurangwayo! ubw'abacunguwe bazaba bateranye. yes'azatuzamura, atugeze mw'ijuru, dusingiz'urukundo, twakunzwe n'imana.
hymns.title: Intekerezo Zanjye Zibera Mw'Ijuru

hymns.searchText: nabara nte uburyo yesu yapfuye? 430 nabara nte uburyo yesu yapfuye? uw'abamarayika baramya! n'umwunger'ushak'uwari wazimiye, ngw'amucyur'agaruke mu rugo. se ntiyabyawe n'umukobwa mariya, mu muvure i betelehemu! kandi se ntiyakuriy'i nazareti! ng'uk'uko yaje hano mw'isi y'ibyaha! mvuge nt'uko yababajw'akituriza! agakiz'iyi si y'amarira; n'umutim'umenetse ku musaraba, yesu yambitsw'ikamba ry'amahwa! ni w'ukiza ab'imitim'imenetse, kand'akiz'ubwob'umunyabyaha! adukiz'imitwaro yose y'ibyaha, n'ub'ari hano rwos'ari kumwe natwe. nabara nte uko yireherejeho amahanga yose yo mw'iyi si! yahaw'ubutware mw'isi no mw'ijuru, nta na hamwe yes'atar'umwami. ari hafi kugaruka mu bwiza bwe, kand'amaso yos'azamubona; azab'aje kujyan'abe bamwizeye; babane mu bwiza burabagirana! nabara nte ukw'isi yos'imuramya! ukw'acyah'umurab'ugahunga! niw'ushyir'umunezero mu mitima, kubw'urukundo rwe rutangaje! mwa bari mw'isi mwe, ni mumuhimbaze, amajw'ibihumb'amusingize! ijuru ni rihamy'icyubahiro cye; yukw'ar'umwami n'umucunguzi w'isi.

lines: Ari hafi kugaruka mu bwiza bwe,
Mwa bari mw'isi mwe, ni mumuhimbaze,

hymns.title: Nabara Nte Uburyo Yesu Yapfuye?

hymns.searchText: twese hamwe 431 twese hamwe muze dushyire hamwe; dusang'umwam'imana yacu. iyo mana irakomeye, muze tuyih'icyubahiro. iyo tur'imbere y'imana yacu, nta bugoryi buturangwaho. twibera mu buturo bwera, kubwo kwizera turakirwa. turi hamwe twambaz'imana yacu, tukabon'ubwiza bwa jambo. kubw'umwuka wera w'imana, duhabw'imbarag'ikomeye. dat'utwumve, data mwiz'udukunda! nyamuna uduteg'amatwi; wumve gusenga kwacu data, mw'izina rya yes'uduhire.
hymns.title: Twese Hamwe

hymns.searchText: duhore twishimye 432 mureke duhore twishimye, imitima yac'inezerwe. mbese n'iki cyatubabaza, kand'iman'idukunda? dukwiriye guhora twishimye, mu mibereho yacu yose. kandi mu nshingano zacu zose, tunezerwe twishime. dor'ukuboko k'uwiteka, kuturind'imyambi y'ibyaha; kubw'ubuntu araturinda, kand'atuma tunesha. dukwiriye guhora twishimye, mu mibereho yacu yose. kandi mu nshingano zacu zose, tunezerwe twishime. kand'iyo turets'inshingano, iman'iratuguyaguya; n'ubwo tuba twitey'akaga, itureban'impuhwe. dukwiriye guhora twishimye, mu mibereho yacu yose. kandi mu nshingano zacu zose, tunezerwe twishime. dukurikiz'inama nziza, tub'abantu beza b'intwari; mu rukundo kandi twishimye, dukorere mu kuri. dukwiriye guhora twishimye, mu mibereho yacu yose. kandi mu nshingano zacu zose, tunezerwe twishime.
hymns.title: Duhore Twishimye

hymns.searchText: nyenyeri yo mu ruturuturu 433 nyenyeri yo mu ruturuturu unyobore; igih'inzir'icuz'umwijima unyobore. umfash'ukubok'ukanyobora, mbese nabur'ibyiringiro nte? jye ntabwo nagushidikanyaho unyobore; umpumure maze mbon'inzira unyobora. natinze rwose kukuyoboza, ubu ndaje noneho nyobora. mu bihanamanga mu bitare unyobore; mu bishanga ndetse no mu bihu unyobore. ndashaka kumv'ijwi ryawe yesu; we muyobozi mwiz'utayobya. mu gihe ntentebutse mbabaye unyobore; ndi mu cyunamo nabuz'abanjye unyobore. nzi k'undeba nez'uri mw'ijuru; ntey'intambwe ngusang'unyobore. kubw'urukundo rwawe, mukiza unyobore; ndakwiyeguriye mwami mwiza unyobore. yesu wabambwe ku musaraba, muri byose komez'unyobore.

lines: Mu bishanga ndetse no mu bihu unyobore.

hymns.title: Nyenyeri Yo Mu Ruturuturu

hymns.searchText: bakristo twite ku batishoboye 434 bakristo, bakristo twite ku batishoboye; nib'umuken'agez'iwaw'aje kugusaba, burya har'und'uhagaz'iruhande rw'utabona! kumwakir'iwawe bizaguhesh'umugisha. ijish'ureb'umukene yes'ab'arireba. iy'umwugururiy'iremb'akinjir'iwawe, yesu yinjirana na w'akazamur'ibiganza, maz'akaguh'umugisha mu by'utunze byose. yes'azaguhir'iteka mu buzima bwawe, kand'azanaguh'ikamba ry'abakiranutsi. vub'ah'amarembo y'ijur'agiye gufunguka; yes'azagororer'abamukoreye neza.
hymns.title: Bakristo Twite Ku Batishoboye

hymns.searchText: agira neza 435 kanguka mutima wanjy'ishime! maz'usingiz'umucunguzi wawe; akwiriy'indirimbo kubw'ineza ye, n'ubunt'agira bw'igitangaza. agira neza kubw'urukundo rwe rwinshi, muze tumuririmbire. yantabaye nar'uwo gupfa, maz'arankiz'ambeshahw'amp'ubugingo. yankuye mw'isayo y'ibyaha, maz'arankiza kubw'urukundo rwe rwinshi. agira neza kubw'urukundo rwe rwinshi, muze tumuririmbire. n'ubw'imbaraga z'ikuzimu zampagurukira, ntabwo zanshobora. n'ubw'abanzi bandwanya bakanyibasira, ntabwo bashobora kunesha. agira neza kubw'urukundo rwe rwinshi, muze tumuririmbire. n'ubw'imirabyo n'inkuba byahinda, ntabwo nzagir'ubwoba na gato. yes'ampora bugufi akarind'ubugingo, sinzagir'ubwoba namba. agira neza kubw'urukundo rwe rwinshi, muze tumuririmbire.
hymns.title: Agira Neza

hymns.searchText: yewe nzimizi we, garuka 436 yewe nzimizi we, garuka; umubyey'aragushaka. n'umubyeyi ugukunda, kand'aragutegereje. ngwino! ngwino! yewe nzimizi we, garuka; so aguteze amatwi. yita cyane ku bafite imitima imenetse. ngwino! ngwino! yewe nzimizi we, garuka; umukiz'aragushaka. az'intege nkeya zawe, jya ku birenge bya yesu. ngwino! ngwino! yewe nzimizi we, garuka; uhanagurw'amarira. ni so uguhamagara; kand'aragukunda cyane. ngwino! ngwino!
hymns.title: Yewe Nzimizi We, Garuka

hymns.searchText: ntabwo nzakureka 437 ntabwo nzakureka, ntabwo nzakuvaho. ntabwo nzagusiga wenyine. nzakurinda kandi nzajya ngukomeza, nzajya nkwitaho ngushoboze. witiny'ahubwo kurikiza amabwiriza n'inama byanjye. igih'umugaru uguteragana, koresh'isengesh'ubimbwire. nzakubumbatiza amaboko yanjye, nzakurinda kandi nkwiteho. n'igih'uzajy'ugeragezwa, nzajya nkubonesherez'inzira. ijuru rizakinguruka habone, uhishurirw'ubwiza bwanjye. uzabon'amahor'atemba nk'uruzi, byose bizaba byiza gusa. nzajya mbana nawe iteka, kandi nzajya ndind'intambwe zawe. mu gih'ubugingo bwawe busakiranye n'umwijim'ukaze cyane, nzajya ntamurur'umwijim'ukugose, nzakuyoboz'umucyo waka. nzagukund'urukundo, nzajya nkumurikira ah'ujya hose.
hymns.title: Ntabwo Nzakureka

hymns.searchText: hano mur'iyi si sihw'iwacu 438 hano mur'iyi si si hw'iwacu; ahubwo mw'ijuru ni hw'iwacu. mw'isi y'umubabaro n'intimba zidashira, kwa data mw'ijuru ni hw'iwacu. mw'ijuru n'iwacu nta kabuza; n'igihe gitoya ngatahayo. ibi bihe ducamo biri hafi gushira, ngiye kuger'iwacu mw'ijuru. mw'ijuru kwa yesu ni ho nzaba; mw'ijuru nzahaboner'ikuzo. tuzabana n'abera, n'inshuti twakundaga; nzaruhukirayo ni hw'iwacu.

lines: Ibi bihe ducamo biri hafi gushira,
Mw'ijuru kwa Yesu ni ho nzaba;

hymns.title: Hano Mur'Iyi Si Sihw'Iwacu

hymns.searchText: ubugingo bwanjye buratakamba 439 ubugingo bwanjye buratakamba, buragukeneye mwami yesu we! umutwaro wawe uroroheje! mwungeri mwiza umbe mu mutima. mwami yes'unyobor'intambwe zanjye; kand'umber'igihome kinkingira, mu mwijim'ukaze mfat'ikiganza, umurikire mu nzir'ijy'iwawe. soko y'ubuging'uturuk'ahera, mutsima w'ubuging'uva mw'ijuru. ni ho mbon'amahoro mu mutima, kugez'ubw'umusek'uzatambika.
hymns.title: Ubugingo Bwanjye Buratakamba

hymns.searchText: ubugingo bwanjye buratakamba 440 ubugingo bwanjye buratakamba, buragukeneye mwami yesu we! umutwaro wawe uroroheje! mwungeri mwiza umbe mu mutima. mwami yes'unyobor'intambwe zanjye; kand'umber'igihome kinkingira, mu mwijim'ukaze mfat'ikiganza, umurikire mu nzir'ijy'iwawe. soko y'ubuging'uturuk'ahera, mutsima w'ubuging'uva mw'ijuru. ni ho mbon'amahoro mu mutima, kugez'ubw'umusek'uzatambika.
hymns.title: Ubugingo Bwanjye Buratakamba

hymns.searchText: namaramaje gutaha 441 namaramaje gutaha mu gihugu cy'ibyiza, ibyo mpora mvug'iteka, n'urukundo rwa yesu. yesu n'umukunzi wanjye, twarabisezeranye. arankunda ndamukunda, nk'intama n'umwungeri. nari narapfuye rwose, nta mana nta cyizere! nazuts'ubwo nabwirwaga ko yesu yampfiriye! yesu n'umukunzi wanjye, twarabisezeranye. arankunda ndamukunda, nk'intama n'umwungeri. umutima winangira yesu yawunkuyemo; yampay'umutima mushya, yesu ni w'unyobora. yesu n'umukunzi wanjye, twarabisezeranye. arankunda ndamukunda, nk'intama n'umwungeri. kuv'ubwo nemeye yesu, nagiye ngeragezwa, ariko umwami yesu, ni w'umpesha kunesha. yesu n'umukunzi wanjye, twarabisezeranye. arankunda ndamukunda, nk'intama n'umwungeri. mwami yes'udahemuka, nyuzuzamw'urukundo runtere kugir'umwete, wo kugukurikira. yesu n'umukunzi wanjye, twarabisezeranye. arankunda ndamukunda, nk'intama n'umwungeri.
hymns.title: Namaramaje Gutaha

hymns.searchText: ugururira yesu 442 ugururira yesu araguhamagara, ahagaze ku rugi umukingurire. mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire. mwuguru… mwugururire, mwuguru… mwugururire; yaje kugucungura, mwuguru… mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire, mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, mwugururire …rire. kugira ngw'agukize yatanz'ubugingo bwe; yatsinz'urupfu, none mwemer'umwakire. mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire. mwuguru… mwugururire, mwuguru… mwugururire; yaje kugucungura, mwuguru… mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire, mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, mwugururire …rire. mwumv'aracyakomanga, mwiyegurire rwose. kingur'umutima waw'umwiyegurire. mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire. mwuguru… mwugururire, mwuguru… mwugururire; yaje kugucungura, mwuguru… mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire, mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, mwugururire …rire. tyo reka kuzarira wikwitesh'amahirwe. wikwitesh'agakiza ashaka kuguha. mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire. mwuguru… mwugururire, mwuguru… mwugururire; yaje kugucungura, mwuguru… mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, tyo mwugururire, mwugururire. mwugururire, mwugururire; mwugururire, mwugururire. yaje kugucungura, mwugururire …rire.
hymns.title: Ugururira Yesu

hymns.searchText: nshuti zanjye munsabire 443 ndi mu ntambar'ikomeye, intambara yo kwizera; nimunsabire ku mana, rwose nd'uwo gusabirwa. nshuti zanjye munsabire, kugira ngo mbashe kunesha. ni munsabire ku mana, rwose nd'uwo gusabirwa. ndi mu ntambar'ikomeye, intambara yo kwizera; nshuti zanjye bavandimwe, muntwerer'amasengesho. nshuti zanjye munsabire, kugira ngo mbashe kunesha. ni munsabire ku mana, rwose nd'uwo gusabirwa. buri gihe mba mpanganye n'ibigeragezo byinshi; ndifuza kubashishwa kunyura mu nzir'ifunganye. nshuti zanjye munsabire, kugira ngo mbashe kunesha. ni munsabire ku mana, rwose nd'uwo gusabirwa.
hymns.title: Nshuti Zanjye Munsabire

hymns.searchText: har'icyo nsobanukiwe 444 har'icyo nsobanukiwe, yes'amp'ikiruhuko. mwami nguy'umutima wanjye, uwitegekere. iby'isi mbisiz'inyuma, niberey'uwa yesu; ahebuj'ibintu byose, ni w'ump'umunezero. arabagirana cyane, akwiy'icyubahiro; agir'urukundo rwinshi, n'imbabazi n'impuhwe. yesu yarankunze cyane, bitum'aza kumpfira; kubw'urukundo rw'imana, se kuki ntamukunda? yesu ndakwiyeguriye, nkomeza nkunambeho; ubuzima bwanjye bwose, buhishwe muri wowe.
hymns.title: Har'Icyo Nsobanukiwe

hymns.searchText: bigiye gusobanuka 445 turi hafi kujy'aheza, mu gihugu cyiza cyane. ntituzongera kurira, bigiye gusobanuka! twiringir'imana gusa, ntitugir'ubwoba rwose. n'ubwo duhura n'ibiruhije, bigiye gusobanuka! ibyiza twari twahombye, tuzongera kubihabwa. mw'ijuru tuzanezerwa, bigiye gusobanuka! twiringir'imana gusa, ntitugir'ubwoba rwose. n'ubwo duhura n'ibiruhije, bigiye gusobanuka! tuzamenya nez'impamvu, twahuraga n'amakuba, indirimbo zigatuza, bigiye gusobanuka! twiringir'imana gusa, ntitugir'ubwoba rwose. n'ubwo duhura n'ibiruhije, bigiye gusobanuka! ibijya bidushobera, tukibaz'impamvu yabyo, tukabur'ibyiringiro, bigiye gusobanuka! twiringir'imana gusa, ntitugir'ubwoba rwose. n'ubwo duhura n'ibiruhije, bigiye gusobanuka! imana yac'iz'inzira, ni y'ifit'urufunguzo, izadukiz'amarira, bigiye gusobanuka! twiringir'imana gusa, ntitugir'ubwoba rwose. n'ubwo duhura n'ibiruhije, bigiye gusobanuka!
hymns.title: Bigiye Gusobanuka

hymns.searchText: mwami w’amahanga yose 446 mwami w'amahanga yose, uduhe gukunda bose; uturinde kurobanura, no kuvangurana mu moko. kurah'urusika mwami, rwabasha gutandukanya, abana bawe wacunguye; utugir'umwe dukundane. mwami ngusaby'imbabazi, nataniye mu bwanganyi; mfasha menye ibyaha byanjye, ne kukubamb'ubwa kabiri. mbashisha kuvuganira, abanyantege nke bose, barenganwa ntibitabweho; mpa gushikama mbavugire. unyuzuz'umwuka wera, mbashe gukor'ibikwiye, aho mba hos'igihe cyose, nkorah'unkoresh'ibikwiye.
hymns.title: Mwami W’Amahanga Yose

hymns.searchText: nimuze dushim'uwiteka 447 nimuze dushim'uwiteka, kubw'ibambe rye ryinshi! kukw'ineza y'ihoraho, n'umurava w'uhoraho! kandi ni w'utegeka byose; akwiz'umucyo hose! kukw'ineza y'ihoraho, n'umurava w'uhoraho! ni w'utung'ibyaremwe byose, ni w'ubigaburira. kukw'ineza y'ihoraho, n'umurava w'uhoraho! nuko rero tumuhimbaze; uwiteka ni mwiza! kukw'ineza y'ihoraho, n'umurava w'uhoraho!
hymns.title: Nimuze Dushim'Uwiteka

hymns.searchText: ninde utegek'izuba 448 nind'utegek'izuba kuva, rikamurikira abantu? mbese ninde utegek'ijoro? n'uwiteka imana yacu. n'uwiteka imana yacu. mbese ninde wahanz'ijuru, maz'agahanik'ikirere? nind'ubashish'ibyatsi gutoha? n'uwiteka imana yacu. n'uwiteka imana yacu. nind'ujy'uduhoz'amarira, atuber'umuhumuriza? nind'ufit'ijambo rikomeye? n'uwiteka imana yacu. n'uwiteka imana yacu.
hymns.title: Ninde Utegek'Izuba

hymns.searchText: dusingize yesu nyir'ukunesha 449 dusingize yesu nyir'ukunesha! yaratwitangiye tumuhimbaze. twubur'amaso turebe hejuru, tuzirikan'urukundo rwa yesu. kand'urukundo rwe rurahanitse, ubwami bw'imana buri muri twe. kand'isi yac'igez'ahakomeye, dor'amahoro rwos'ayishizemo. is'ikeney'umucy'uva mw'ijuru, tuyerek'umukiza emanweli. bwoko bw'imana nitwitange rwose, tuvug'ubutumwa twitange rwose. tujy'ahantu hose tubabwirize, hirya hino hakeney'ubutumwa. benshi ntacyo bazi cyo gucungurwa, bakwiriye kubwirw'iby'agakiza; bakameny'ibyo gucungurwa kwabo. nimutyo dutwaze tubagereho. abavugabutumwa bakeneye, amasengesho n'urukundo rwinshi. tubazirikane tubasabire, tubashyigikire, tubakomeze. yes'agiye kuza mu cyubahiro, twe kugir'ubwoba tub'abaneshi.
hymns.title: Dusingize Yesu Nyir'Ukunesha

hymns.searchText: kera ntabwo nagutekerezaga 450 kera ntabwo nagutekerezaga, none nameny'urukundo rwawe. kand'umucyo wawe warandasiye, nanjye nguhay'umutima wanjye. mwami numvis'ijambo ryawe ryera, maze numva rindemy'umutima; ubwo nari ntafit'ibyiringiro, ijambo ryawe riranyobora. ubwo nari maze gucik'intege, iby'isi bimaze kuncogoza, warankomeje ngumya kukwizera; mwam'iby'ushaka byose bibeho. mwami numvis'ijambo ryawe ryera, maze numva rindemy'umutima; ubwo nari ntafit'ibyiringiro, ijambo ryawe riranyobora. nimara kuger'iwacu mw'ijuru, nzahora ndi mu rukundo rwawe. umutima wanjye ntuzacogora, ntabwo nzongera kuruh'ukundi. mwami numvis'ijambo ryawe ryera, maze numva rindemy'umutima; ubwo nari ntafit'ibyiringiro, ijambo ryawe riranyobora.
hymns.title: Kera Ntabwo Nagutekerezaga

hymns.searchText: kwibera hafi ya yesu 451 kwibera hafi ya yesu, kwibera mu bwiza bwe; kwibera mu murimo we, ni bwo numva ntekanye. kwibera hafi ya yesu, ni byo numva nifuza; buri gihe mbane na we, mpore ndi kumwe na we. kwibera hafi ya yesu, nta cyabasha kuntanya, n'urukundo n'ubuntu bye, mpore hafi ya yesu. kwibera hafi ya yesu, ni byo numva nifuza; buri gihe mbane na we, mpore ndi kumwe na we. kwibera hafi ya yesu, mbasha gukiranuka; mbwir'aband'iby'ineza ye, nkurikiz'iby'ashaka. kwibera hafi ya yesu, ni byo numva nifuza; buri gihe mbane na we, mpore ndi kumwe na we.
hymns.title: Kwibera Hafi Ya Yesu

hymns.searchText: mbeg'umuns'utey'ubwuzu 452 umunsi w'ihozo dore uri bugufi; kurira, kuganya, gusuhuz'umutima, bizatamururwaho, twibere mu mahoro. mbeg'umuns'uzab'utey'ubwuzu! mu bwami bw'ijuru, nta marir'azabayo; igihu kizadutamuruka mu maso. tuzaba mu mahoro atagir'impinduka. mbeg'umuns'uzab'utey'ubwuzu
hymns.title: Mbeg'Umuns'Utey'Ubwuzu

hymns.searchText: senga 453 senga mu gitondo kare, ujy'usenga no ku manywa. senga na nimugoroba, iman'ihora yumva. haba mu gitondo kare, haba ndetse no ku manywa, haba na nimugoroba, iman'ihora yumva. igih'icy'ari cyo cyose, yesu yakugenderera; ahor'agutez'amatwi ntucogore gusenga.
hymns.title: Senga

hymns.searchText: iyo ngenda mba ndi kumwe n'imana 454 iyo ngenda mba ndi kumwe n'imana, kandi tugenda twiganirira. turasabana rwose, tukishima, n'iyo haba mu mugaru mwinshi. turasabana rwose, tukishima, ibihe byose turagendana. inyibutsa amateka ya kera, umugambi wabaye mw'ijuru, wo kuncungura ngo mbon'ubugingo. wabayeho jyewe ntarabaho, njya kuremwa ntabwo byar'impanuka, habay'umugambi wo kundema. mw'ijuru nzatemberana n'imana, dufatanye na yo mu biganza. iyi si turimo izakurwaho, nzabana n'iman'iteka ryose. iyi si dutuyemw'izakurwaho, hazaz'indi tuzabamw'iteka.

lines: Iyo ngenda mba ndi kumwe n'Imana,

hymns.title: Iyo Ngenda Mba Ndi Kumwe N'Imana

hymns.searchText: ndumv’ijwi rinyongorera 455 har'ijwi rya marayika, rimbwira ryongorera. iryo jwi rirankomeza, rinter'ibyiringiro. n'ubw'ijoro ryegereje, n'umurab'ar'icyago; bigiye gutamuruka, maz'umucy'utangaze. ijwi numva, rinter'ibyiringiro; rinter'ibyishimo, mu – mu mutima. ijwi numva, …jwi numva ry'ihozo, rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; rinter'ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu mutima. ijwi numva – mva ry'ihozo, rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; rinter'ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu muti… mu mutima. no mu gihe cy'akabwibwi, umucy'urengarenga; inyenyer'ifit'umucyo, izamurika cyane. ijoro niribudika, ntugir'ubwoba rwose; hasigay'igihe gito, umucy'ugatangaza. ijwi numva, rinter'ibyiringiro; rinter'ibyishimo, mu – mu mutima. ijwi numva, …jwi numva ry'ihozo, rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; rinter'ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu mutima. ijwi numva – mva ry'ihozo, rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; rinter'ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu muti… mu mutima. ibyo byiringiro bitsika mu mutima wanjye; bitamurur'umwijima, umucy'ugatangaza! iy'umwami yimye mu mutima waw'ushavuye, ibyiringiro bishyitse biguma mu mutima. ijwi numva, rinter'ibyiringiro; rinter'ibyishimo, mu – mu mutima. ijwi numva, …jwi numva ry'ihozo, rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; rinter'ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu mutima. ijwi numva – mva ry'ihozo, rintera ibyiri – byiringiro; rinter'ibyi – byishimo pe! …shimo mu muti… mu mutima.
hymns.title: Ndumv’Ijwi Rinyongorera

hymns.searchText: yes’arankunda 456 iy'inzir'icuz'umwijima, yes'aranyeger'akambwira; ati: “komera mwana wanjye, ndagukunda.” arankunda bihebuje pe! urukundo rutadohoka. ampaz'umunezero mwinshi, arankunda! mu minsi mib'arandengera, akandwanaho mu makuba. andokora mu byago byose, arankunda! ibyo mw'isi birarangira, bikayonga bigashiraho. arik'urukundo rwa yesu, ruhoraho. yaryamishijwe mu muvure, yabambwe no ku musaraba. ni jye yagiriraga rwose, arankunda. kand'azagaruka mu bicu, aje kunjyana iwe mw'ijuru. tuzasingiz'urukundo rwe, mu ndirimbo.
hymns.title: Yes’Arankunda

hymns.searchText: nd'umugenzi mur'iyi si 457 nd'umugenzi mur'iyi si, nerekeye mw'ijuru; mu gihugu gihoramw' umucy'utazima! n'ubwo ngoswe n'abagome; n'ubw'is'inyibasiye; nta cyambuza gukomeza, yes'arankunda! data wa twes'arankunda, kandi niw'unyobora. ankomereza kwizera, n'ukuboko kwe. mu mugaru, mu bishuko, mu gahinda mu byago; ijwi ry'umukiza wanjye rirankomeza. gukorer'umwami nk'uwo, ntibigir'uko bisa! nifuza kumumenya, nkanamwigiraho. n'ibyishimo bitavugwa; umucunguzi wanjye, azanyambutsa rwa ruzi, ngere hakurya! ku cyambu gituje cyane, ni ho ngiye kwambuka. nta marir'azagerayo, krist'arahari! kand'imibabaro yose, tugirira mw'iyi si; yes'araje bidatinze, adutabare.
hymns.title: Nd'Umugenzi Mur'Iyi Si

hymns.searchText: wafashe kamere yanjye 458 n'ubw'ur'iman'ikomey'ite! wafashe kamere yanjye! mwami wumv'isengesho ryanjye, umwana wawe ngusaba. uz'intege nke zanjye yesu! uzi amakub'angose, undinde kubw'ineza yawe; mwunger'utajy'uzimiza. kand'inshyimbo n'inkoni byawe, bihora bimpumuriza. ntacyo nzatinya mwami mwiz'ubwo ndi mu maboko yawe. unyobora ku mazi meza, y'ubugingo buhoraho. urambohora ukankiza, mu maboko y'umubisha!
hymns.title: Wafashe Kamere Yanjye

hymns.searchText: ndi umukristo ucumbitse mur'iyi si 459 nd'umukristo ncumbitse mw'iyi si, ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! n'ubwo nsakirana n'ingorane, ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! kuki narira cyangwa nkinuba? krist'ari hamwe nanjy'ibihe byose. ndi hafi yo kwigira mw'ijuru; ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! n'ubw'amarir'ari menshi mw'isi, ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! ndater'intambwe ngan'i kanani, ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! n'ubw'iyi s'ibeshy'abayituye, n'ubw'ishaka kumbabariz'umutima; amaso yanjye nyahanze yesu; ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! ndi hafi yo kugera ku ntego, ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! nzahabw'igihugu cy'agakiza, ku bwanjye byose ni byiza! iyi s'iri hafi yo gushira, mugenzi we! komera wihangane. mu man'uzahabw'ikiruhuko; ku bwanjye byose ni byiza!

lines: Ndi hafi yo kugera ku ntego,

hymns.title: Ndi Umukristo Ucumbitse Mur'Iyi Si

hymns.searchText: wow'uruhijwe n'iby'isi … 460 wow'uruhijwe n'iby'is'urushy'umutima, ntuzi ko yesu yakuruhur'umutima? ko nkeneye yesu kristo, namubona nte? hang'amaso ku musarab'i kaluvari. mbes'ikamba ry'uwo mwami rimeze rite? dore yambitsw'ikamba ry'amahwa ku bwawe. mukurikiye mw'iyi si bigenda bite? n'ukwemera ukamunambaho by'iteka. mbes'ukurikiy'uwo mwam'azahabw'iki? n'amahoro adashira n'umunezero. mwami mwiza nkyumv'ijwi ryawe ndakwitabye. ungir'uwawe, nshyira mu bawe by'iteka.

lines: Ko nkeneye Yesu Kristo, namubona nte?

hymns.title: Wow'Uruhijwe N'Iby'Isi …

hymns.searchText: nyongerera kwizera 461 mwami yesu nyongerera kwizera. akira kwizera kwanjye yesu we! nyamururahw'ibimboshye byose mwami; ungeze ku rugero ruhanitse. yesu ni wow'umar'umubabaro; ni wow'unezez'umutima wanjye! mu rugamba ndwana, urwany'abankwena; ungeze ku rugero ruhanitse. uzi nez'icyifuzo cyanjye mwami; nyongerera kwizera mwami mwiza! mu mwijima w'icuraburindi mfasha; mpore mbon'umucyo wawe yesu we! kristo yes'arambwir'ati: twarana! ntucik'intege komez'uhatane! ari hafi kuza kunjyana mw'ijuru; azanjyan'iwe mw'ijuru ahw'aba!
hymns.title: Nyongerera Kwizera

hymns.searchText: impano y'ijuru 462 ngwino soko y'ubugingo, ngwino mpano y'ijuru; uduhire mwuka wera, duhishurire kristo. mwuka wer'ur'urumuri, ntacy'ubasha guhishwa; ntacy'usobwa, mwuka wera utuboneshereze. utuyobore kwa data, tumusange twishimye; mu masengesho dusenga, tuber'umuyobozi. hindura byose bishyashya, duhabwe gusa nawe! uzatugeze mw'ijuru, mu bwami buhoraho.
hymns.title: Impano Y'Ijuru

hymns.searchText: wikwishimira kunyura inzira mbi 463 wikwishimira kunyura inzira mbi; kandi yes'ari hw'aguhamagara. wishaka kujya mu mwijima; none itaba yesu, aragukunda. kuki waremererwa n'umutwaro, ukadandabiranwa n'ubusinzi? yes'arakiza, humura pe! umva ubutumwa bwe, maz'umusange. wabaye nk'uburabyo bwumagaye; wagendanye n'abanzi b'ubutumwa; ariko yesu ugukunda, muh'umutima wawe, arawakira.
hymns.title: Wikwishimira Kunyura Inzira Mbi

hymns.searchText: icyampa ngahora hafi y'imana 464 icyampa ngahora hafi y'imana ibihe byose; ngahora nibera mw'ijambo ryayo umunsi ku wundi. mbe mwami, nshaka kwibanira nawe ibihe byose; ni bwo ntazigera mbur' amahoro umunsi ku wundi. mwami ngwin'ugeng'umutima wanjye wugire mushya; umpe kutazatandukana nawe iteka n'iteka.
hymns.title: Icyampa Ngahora Hafi Y'Imana

hymns.searchText: reb'umutim'ubabaye 465 reb'umutim'ubabaye cyan'i kaluvari, reba yes'ari ku musaraba; yabambwe ku bwawe, nta wundi yaziraga; numureba urakira rwose! reba, reba; wizer'imbabazi zituruk'i kalvari; tyo reba, reba ku musaraba. ujya wibaz'impamvu yesu yakubiswe, kand'akambikwa n'ikamba ry'amahwa? n'impamvu yabambw'ari nta cyaha yakoze? tyo byibaze, ubitekereze. reba, reba; yaragucunguye apfa mu cyimbo cyawe. tyo reba, reba ku musaraba. amarira n'amaraso byawe ntibyashobora, kwez'ibyaha byawe na gato. keretse wizeye yesu wakubambwiwe, numwizera urakira rwose! reba, reba yes'araguhanagur'amarira yose, tyo mwizer'urakira rwose.

lines: Yabambwe ku bwawe, Nta wundi yaziraga;

hymns.title: Reb'Umutim'Ubabaye

hymns.searchText: umusaruro uratubutse 466 dor'umusarur'uratubutse, hakenewe abasaruzi. manur'umwuka wawe mana, twongerer'abasaruzi. ahw'abakozi bawe bari, man'ubah'imigisha yawe. ubambik'imbarag'ikomeye, ubambike ukuri kwawe. bah'umurava ku nshingano, kandi bagir'urukundo. aho bakwiriye hose, man’ubah'imigisha yawe. ijisho ryawe ribahoreho, mu bihugu bakoreramo; imitim'icishwe bugufi, izanwe ku musaraba. uhire abakozi bawe, man'ubah'imigisha yawe. data tebutsa wa munsi mwiza, wo kugaruka kw'umukiza. amavi yos'azapfukama, indimi zigusingize! yes'azahora yererezwa, azahoran'icyubahiro.
hymns.title: Umusaruro Uratubutse

hymns.searchText: turi ab'umwami yesu 467 ntabwo tur'abacu, tur'ab'umwami yesu. yesu ni w'utugenga, twaramwiyeguriye; n'aho rwab'urupfu, tuzamunambaho rwose; umusaraba we, ni wo tuzirata! icyubahiro cye, kitugaragaremo; dupfe ku cyaha cyose, duharanir'ijuru. baragwa b'ijuru, twer'imbuto z'abihannye; mureke twibere mu man'ihoraho. tw'ab'umwami yesu, ntitugacik'intege; n'iyo twaba mu kaga cyangwa mu munezero; turi kumwe na we nta kabuza tuzanesha! azabana natwe ntazaturekura!
hymns.title: Turi Ab'Umwami Yesu

hymns.searchText: tang'ubuto bwawe 468 tang'ubuto bwawe, ukorer'imana; umutima wawe wos'uwegurir'imana. uwitek'ashaka umutima wawe, numuh'umutima waw'araguh'amahoro. mu by'ukora byose, iman'ib'imbere; na y'izajy'ikwikorerer'imitwaro yawe.
hymns.title: Tang'Ubuto Bwawe

hymns.searchText: turakuramya 469 turakuramya mwami udukunda; dusonzey'ukwera kwawe. mwami nyir'imigisha, mwami mwiza, dukeneye kuzuzw'urukundo; tumurikirwe n'ubwiza bwawe. mwigisha mwiza utagereranywa; uduhire, mwam'utweze. duh'umutima mushya, twiyoroshye. dukeneye kuzuzw'urukundo; tumurikirwe n'ubwiza bwawe. dusagiz'urukundo rwawe mwami; urukundo rudashira. ruzan'abanyabyaha kuri yesu. dukeneye kuzuzw'urukundo; tumurikirwe n'ubwiza bwawe. mwam'abazajya batubona bose, batangare batubonye; dufit'ubumwe nyabwo, dufatanya. dukeneye kuzuzw'urukundo; tumurikirwe n'ubwiza bwawe. wumve mwami amasengesho yacu, utwuzuz'umwuka wawe; twigish'ijambo ryawe, turimenye. dukeneye kuzuzw'urukundo; tumurikirwe n'ubwiza bwawe.
hymns.title: Turakuramya

hymns.searchText: nta ntwaro dawidi yajyanye 470 nta ntwaro dawidi yajyanye, guter'umufilistiya! atar'umuhumetso we, wahangamuy'igihangange; cyasuzugurag'imana, iman'ikomeye y'abisirayeli. aratanya gusakirana n'uwo mufilisitiya, wasuzugurag'imana, ari na kw'ayishongoraho. yitakumag'atamenye ko dawidi yatoranijwe n'imana. dawidi nta gususumira, asatira goliyati. areker'ibuye rimwe, rihitan'icyo gihangange! imana yihesh'ikuzo, binyuze mu mwana mutoya dawidi. umwami yes'aragushaka, ngo witabir'urugamba; n'ubwo wab'umwana muto, tinyuka winjir'urugamba! uzaber'is'igihamya, k'uri mu ruhande rw'iman'idatsindwa. nitugotwa n'abanzi benshi, turi hafi kugwabira; tujye ku mavi dusenge, yesu ntazadutererana. yumv'amasengesho yacu, azatugir'abaneshi ku rugamba.
hymns.title: Nta Ntwaro Dawidi Yajyanye

hymns.searchText: yes'uradukunda! 471 yes'uradukunda nka data wa twese, kand'urukundo rwawe, ruradukomeza, iy'imitim'itentebutse. amaraso yawe urayatwejesha; kubw'urukundo rwawe, wemeye kwitanga; ni twe wagiriraga mwami. ugiye kugenda wasiz'uvuz'uti: “muzajye mukundana nk'uko nabakunze.” nta wakunda nkawe mwami we! duhe gukundana, nk’uko wadukunze; uduhe gufatanya, bitum'is'imenya, y'uko tur'abana ba yesu. mbe, mwami mwiza we! n'iby'igikundiro, y'uko tugukorera, dusengera hamwe, twita no ku nshingano zacu. twite ku murimo; tuzi neza y'uko uduhora bugufi, ukatubashisha gutungany'inshingano zacu.
hymns.title: Yes'Uradukunda!

hymns.searchText: nje kugushima 472 nje kugushima mwami mana, nkuzaniy'ishimwe ryanjye; n'ubw'umwijima wabudika, wow'uramboneshereza. wangiz'umwana wawe mana, unyitaho buri munsi; ni wowe soko y'imigisha, ngushimiy'imigish'umpa. ngushimira k'uhor'undinda, n'ukuboko kwawe mana. iy'umutim'ucits'intege, unsubizamw'imbaraga; iyo nabuze kivurira, undwanah'ukanduhura; dor'ukuboko kw'uwiteka, ntikwananiwe gukiza. ngushimiy'impuhw'ungirira, unkurahw'ibicumuro. iy'utambabarir'ibyaha, nari guhungira he se? data ntabwo nzagutenguha, warankijije ndakira. mu maraso y'umwami yesu, ni ho mboner'agakiza. nzi neza rwos'uwo nizeye, ni we umboneshereza; ni we gitare kinkingira, ni we byiringiro byanjye; kabone n'ubwo nacogozwa, ntazabura kunyitaho. yampay'ubugingo bw'iteka, nzajya mushimir'iteka.
hymns.title: Nje Kugushima

hymns.searchText: indirimbo n'amasengesho byacu 473 indirimbo n'amasengesho byacu bizamuke; iman'ibyakire, yo yatugiz'abavandimwe. kuko dufite dat'umwe, n'umwami wacu yesu; mu kwizera,tuyoborwa n'umwuk'umwe wa kristo. ibyiringiro bihire ni byo bidukomeza; ku rugamba tuyoborwa n'urukundo rwa yesu. urwo rukundo ruganze, rudusabemo twese; ruduhuze, kandi rutume duhora twishimye!
hymns.title: Indirimbo N'Amasengesho Byacu

hymns.searchText: urukundo rwa kristo 474 urukundo rwa kristo ruduhata; dore yitangiy'umukumbi we. tumukurikire ntama w'imana, twese dufatanye ubudahwema. tyo bavandimwe kubw'umucunguzi, mutyo dufatane mu biganza; tugendane kugeza kw'iherezo; tubonesherejwe na yesu kristo. data, turebe twebw'abana bawe, twiyeguriye umwana wawe, ngwin'udufashe utwuzuz'umwuka, duh'urukundo, twongerer'umwete. turitanze mukiza utwakire; tugir'umwe tube muri wowe. uture mu mitima yacu mwami; mwuka wer'atwez'atugire bashya.
hymns.title: Urukundo rwa Kristo

hymns.searchText: twererez'umusaraba mwiza 475 muze bakristo, dukurikire, umugaba wac'umwana w'imana. twererez'umusaraba mwiza. tuvug'urukundo rw'umwami yesu tuyobowe n'umusaraba we, nta shiti rwose tuzab'abaneshi. twererez'umusaraba mwiza. tuvug'urukundo rw'umwami yesu umusaraba n'ikimenyetso, gifitwe n'abavuts'ubwa kabiri. twererez'umusaraba mwiza. tuvug'urukundo rw'umwami yesu turirimbe cyane indirimbo, dusingize uwatuneshereje. twererez'umusaraba mwiza. tuvug'urukundo rw'umwami yesu
hymns.title: Twererez'Umusaraba Mwiza

hymns.searchText: dor'umwami yes'araje 476 dor'umwami yes'araje; nguy'araje mu bicu! kand'azanye n'abamarayika batabarika. halleluya, halleluya; yes'aje kwim'ingoma ye. kand'ijisho ryose rizabon'icyubahiro cye! kand'abamubambye n'abamutey'imisumari; bazabon'icyubahiro cye, maze banyinyirirwe! ubw'impand'izavug'ijuru n'isi bizahunga! abanze kwakira yesu bazabur'iyo bajya! kuk'urubanza rukomeye rurabategereje. mureke twese turamy'iman'ishobora byose. ngwino mwami, dusonzey'ingoma yaw'itangaje! ngwino mwami, ngwino bwangu wimike ubwami bwawe.

lines: Ngwino Mwami, Ngwino bwangu wimike ubwami bwawe.

hymns.title: Dor'Umwami Yes'Araje

hymns.searchText: umunsi ku wundi 477 umunsi ku wundi turi mu rugendo; tuguman'urukundo n'ibyiringiro. mw'ijoro riganje, mu mwijima mwinshi, dukomez'urugendo rujya mw'ijuru, umunsi ku munsi turukomeze. umunsi ku wundi dukomez'imbere; ibihe birahita ntibigaruka. dukomere kw'ijambo ry'imana yacu, rituyobore rinatumurikire; dukomez'urugendo buri munsi. umunsi ku munsi kugeza kw'isonga; twihangane ntituzasubir'inyuma. baturajuru n'ubwo turi mw'iyi si; yemwe basirikare b'umwami yesu, dukomez'urugendo buri munsi. umunsi ku wundi tugamij'ijuru; kugeza kuri wa munsi tuzataha, ni bwo tuzaragw'ubugingo bw'iteka. tuzahabw'imigisha tutazanyagwa; dukomez'urugendo buri munsi.

lines: Umunsi ku wundi turi mu rugendo;

hymns.title: Umunsi Ku Wundi

hymns.searchText: mu gihe itorero 478 mu gih'itorero ririho risenga, risabir'abatoranijwe gukor'inshingano, ubeze mwam'imana, ubah'imbaraga, bayoborwe n'umwuka wawe! abatoranijwe n'umwami w'abami, kwatura no guhamya mw'izina ry'umwami yesu; mwakir'inshingano mwerejwe uyu munsi; mub'indahemuka ku murimo wa yesu, yes'azabahira, azabashoboza. iman'ibambike imbaraga yayo, mwuzur'umwuka wera, ibambike imbaraga nshya; uyu munsi mwatangiy'inshingano zanyu, ijuru riranezerewe cyane rwose, ariko satani ntabwo abyishimiye. muzirikane ko is'itabakunze, izahuriza hamw'imbaraga zo kubarwanya; ntimugir'ubwoba yes'azajy'abarinda, ni we mutwe w'itorer'ubwe yihangiye; muhore ku mavi nibwo muzanesha. mwitegur'imvune muzahura na zo, ni mugir'urukundo kandi mugire kwizera, murabukw'ikamba mugiye kuzahabwa, ni mushir'ubwoba, mutsind'urugamba, mw'izina rya yesu muzanesha rwose. amen

lines: Kwatura no guhamya mw'izina ry'Umwami Yesu;
Mw'izina rya Yesu muzanesha rwose. Amen

hymns.title: Mu Gihe Itorero

hymns.searchText: umwami w'i siyoni 479 umwami w'i siyoni ni w'utegek'isi; isi yose yishim'amav'amupfukamire! imbere y'intebe y'ubuntu, imitim'iranezerwa, ikaruhuka, mutyo mwese tumuramye. umwami w'i siyoni ni w'utegek'isi; nta wahwanya n'uwo mwami gukomera rwose! impera z'isi, ikuzimu hamwe n'inyanja zose, biri mu biganza by'uwo mwami ukomeye! umwami w'i siyoni ni w'utegek'isi; ni we mugenga w'ibihe, tumutaramire! tyo nimuze mu ngoro ye, muririmbe mwese; muze mu marembo ye mwishimye, mumupfukamire.

lines: Nta wahwanya n'uwo Mwami gukomera rwose!
Impera z'isi, ikuzimu hamwe n'inyanja zose,
Biri mu biganza by'uwo Mwami ukomeye!
Tyo nimuze mu ngoro ye, Muririmbe mwese;
Muze mu marembo ye mwishimye, mumupfukamire.

hymns.title: Umwami W'I Siyoni

hymns.searchText: tweze mwami yesu 480 tweze mwami yesu, tweze mwami yesu; tweze mwami yesu, kugez'ubw'uzatujyana. tub'abiringirwa, mw'izina rya yesu; tub'abiringirwa, kugez'ubw'uzatujyana. ducishwe bugufi, mw'izina rya yesu; ducishwe bugufi, kugez'ubw'uzatujyana. twuzuz'urukundo, mw'izina rya yesu; twuzuz'urukundo, kugez'ubw'uzagaruka; tumere nkawe mwami, kugez'ubw'uzatujyana.
hymns.title: Tweze Mwami Yesu

hymns.searchText: singizwa data 481 data ugira neza, mana yacu; munyebambe nyinshi, natw'uratumenya! wowe usingizwa n'abera bo mw'ijuru; singizwa yehova! tuguhimbaze murengezi wacu, uhor'utwitaho, twebw'ubwoko bwawe! abat'abakuze, inkumi n'abasore; yesu we, singizwa! mwuka wera we! turaguhimbaza! imana data hamwe n'imana mwana, barakuduhaye ng'utuber'umufasha! mugiz'iman'imwe!
hymns.title: Singizwa Data

hymns.searchText: mwam'ushobora byose 482 mwam'ushobora byose, duhe kukuririmbira; duhimbaza, dat'usumba byose; nyir'icyubahiro, mutegeka wac'ibihe byose. mw'ijambo ryawe mwami, kandi ni ryo nkota yawe. mu gusenga, hir'ubwoko bwawe; hir'ijambo ryawe, umwuka wer'atumanukire. mwuka wera w'imana, ur'umuhamy'ukomeye. mw'uyu mwanya, ngwin'ubane natwe; turagukeneye, ngwino wuzur'imitima yacu. ur'umwe mu butatu, uhor'usingizwa mana. nyakubahwa! gahor'usingizwa! ishimwe n'iryawe! tuzahora tukuramy'iteka!
hymns.title: Mwam'Ushobora Byose

hymns.searchText: nd'umukozi mutoya 483 nd'umukozi mutoya, mwami ntiwankoresha? n'ubwo nta ntege mfite, ndagukunda cyane pe! mfit'akaganza gato, yesu ugakoreshe. nd'umukozi mutoya; mwami ntiwankoresha? nigire buri munsi, mu rukund'udukunda; ngender'imbere yawe, nkuririmbire mwami; mfat'ikiganza mwami, uhor'umpa gutsinda. nd'umukozi mutoya; mwami ntiwankoresha? unyigishe gukunda, mpa kwera no gutuza; umpe ku mwuka wawe, umbemo buri gihe; mwigisha unyigishe, kugukorera neza. nd'umukozi mutoya; mwami ntiwankoresha?
hymns.title: Nd'Umukozi Mutoya

hymns.searchText: basirikare ba yesu … 484 basirikare ba yesu, tyo nimushikame, tyo duhaguruke, turwane tunezerewe; dukurikiy'umwami yesu. ngabo mwe, ngabo mwe! nta mususu namba! tugire kwizera, yes'atur'imbere. dore tugiye kuririmb' indirimbo yo gucungurwa. niduhura n'ingorane, tukumva turushye, cyane tunaniwe; twihangane duhangane, ntitugwabire ku rugamba. ngabo mwe, ngabo mwe! nta mususu namba! tugire kwizera, yes'atur'imbere. dore tugiye kuririmb' indirimbo yo gucungurwa. niba dukiz'imitima, byasaba kunyura mu marira menshi, dor'ukuboko k'umukiza, kuzaduhesha kunesha. ngabo mwe, ngabo mwe! nta mususu namba! tugire kwizera, yes'atur'imbere. dore tugiye kuririmb' indirimbo yo gucungurwa.
hymns.title: Basirikare Ba Yesu …

hymns.searchText: kwizera gutum'inkike … 485 kwizera gutum'inkike ziriduka tubireba; kwizera gutuma tunesh' urugamba rukomeye. kwizera kutwugururir' ubutunzi bukomeye; kwizera gutum'abanyantege nke bab'abatunzi. dufit'ingab'ikomeye idukingir'amakuba; turi mu bwihisho bw' imana nta cyaduhungabanya.
hymns.title: Kwizera Gutum'Inkike …

hymns.searchText: bivuge ku musozi 486 abungeri baragiy' amatungo yabo, mw'ijuru haz' umucyo urabagirana. bivuge ku musozi, bivuge hejuru ku tununga; bivuge ku musozi, yuko yesu yavutse. bakibon'ibyongibyo, bamarwa n'ubwoba; marayik'ababwira ko yesu yavutse. bivuge ku musozi, bivuge hejuru ku tununga; bivuge ku musozi, yuko yesu yavutse. babony'umwana yes' aryamye mu muvure, bamutur'amaturo, bashim'ivuka rye! bivuge ku musozi, bivuge hejuru ku tununga; bivuge ku musozi, yuko yesu yavutse.
hymns.title: Bivuge Ku Musozi

hymns.searchText: yes'adusaba kub'urumuri 487 yes'adusaba kub'urumuri; umucyo ubonesha mu mwijima. tugomba kub'umucyo w'isi, mu midugudu y'iwacu. yes'adusaba kujyan'umucyo; hirya hino hose mu mpande z'isi; barababaye cyane rwose; tubagezeho umucyo. bury'iyo tumurikiy'abandi, yesu ntacy'ahishwa ab'abireba; aho yibereye mw'ijuru, burya nta na kimw'asobwa. yesu n'intwari, aradukunda; tub'umucyo iyo tumurebyeho. tumurik'umucyo we waka, hirya no hino mw'iyi si.

lines: Hirya hino hose mu mpande z'isi;

hymns.title: Yes'Adusaba Kub'Urumuri

hymns.searchText: mwami yesu nshimishwa … 488 mwami yesu nshimishwa no kub'iruhande rwawe; ngateg'amatw'iby'umbwira, ndi ku birenge byawe. mpugura menye kugukorera, mukiza wanjye; mp'umwuka waw'umbashishe, kubwiriz'ubutumwa. mwami yesu ndagusabye, nyuzuz'umwuka wera; kand'ibyaha byanjye byos' ubitwikish'umuriro. mpugura menye kugukorera, mukiza wanjye; mp'umwuka waw'umbashishe, kubwiriz'ubutumwa. mu cyanya cyawe gitoshye, ab'ari h'unyobora; nd'uwawe nd'imbata yawe, narakwiyeguriye. mpugura menye kugukorera, mukiza wanjye; mp'umwuka waw'umbashishe, kubwiriz'ubutumwa.
hymns.title: Mwami Yesu Nshimishwa …

hymns.searchText: kiruhuko cyiza 489 kiruhuko cyiza gihire, twagabiwe n'umuremyi wacu; sabato we, mpano y'akataraboneka! munsi wuj'amahoro! kiruhuko cyiza gihire, duhishurirw'ubwiza bw'imana; n'iby'uwiteka yadukoreye, sabato, muns'uhebuj'ubwiza! kiruhuko cyiza gihire, kingurukanir'intekerezo; zikagera hakurya mw'ijuru, iwabo w'umwami w'amahoro. sabato munsi wahiriwe, munsi wera, muns'urut'iyindi; mu rugendo rugana mw'ijuru, twumva turuhutse mu mitima.
hymns.title: Kiruhuko Cyiza

hymns.searchText: nd'umwana w'umwami 490 dat'afit'amazu menshi cyane; kand'akungahaye no ku masambu. afit'ubukungu bwinshi cyane, zahabu na feza n'umutungo we. nd'umwana w'umwami! yes'umukiza, nd'umwana w'imana, nd'igikomangoma! yes'umwana w'iman'umukiza, ni we mucunguzi w'abanyabyaha. ub'ari mw'ijur'adusabira, aradutegurir'aho tuzaba. nd'umwana w'umwami! yes'umukiza, nd'umwana w'imana, nd'igikomangoma! nar'igicibwa narazimiye, nar'umunyabyaha narazimiye; none nagizw'umwana w'imana, nzambikw'ikanzu yera de, n'ikamba! nd'umwana w'umwami! yes'umukiza, nd'umwana w'imana, nd'igikomangoma! mbese ni kuki nagir'ubwoba; ngw'aha nta cumbi mfite mur'iyi si! mfit'ubutunzi nateguriwe, ntacyo bintwaye nd'igikomangoma! nd'umwana w'umwami! yes'umukiza, nd'umwana w'imana, nd'igikomangoma!

lines: Ngw'aha nta cumbi mfite mur'iyi si!

hymns.title: Nd'Umwana W'Umwami

hymns.searchText: tuzabon'imana mw'ijuru 491 nzabon'imana mw'ijuru, yicaye ku ntebe y'ubwami. ku birenge bya yesu mukiza, ni ho nzarambik'ikamba! mw'ijuru, mw'ijuru, tuzibanira na yesu (mw'ijuru); mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), mw'ijuru kwa yesu, tuzahoran'ibyishimo! amajwi yac'azab'urwunge, n'amajwi y'abamarayika; tuzahora dusingiz'imana, mu munezer'udashira! mw'ijuru, mw'ijuru, tuzibanira na yesu (mw'ijuru); mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), mw'ijuru kwa yesu, tuzahoran'ibyishimo! tuzataramana n'inshuti, twari twaratandukanijwe; ntituzongera gutandukana, tuzahoran'ibyishimo. mw'ijuru, mw'ijuru, tuzibanira na yesu (mw'ijuru); mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), mw'ijuru kwa yesu, tuzahoran'ibyishimo! tuzabon'abera bakikij' intebe y'ubwami y'imana; tuzaban'ubuziraherezo, mu munezer'uhoraho. mw'ijuru, mw'ijuru, tuzibanira na yesu (mw'ijuru); mw'ijuru (mw'ijuru), mw'ijuru kwa yesu, tuzahoran'ibyishimo!
hymns.title: Tuzabon'Imana Mw'Ijuru

hymns.searchText: twinjire mw'ishuri 492 tyo twinjire mw'ishuri, mu munsi wera, twig'ijambo ry'imana dushyizeh'umwete. kuva tukiri batoya twibwir'iby'ijuru, kuk'umwan'uz'ubwenge ahora yishimye. dufungur'igitabo cyera dusenge, turamye yes'umwam'umucunguzi wacu. yes'utanga amahoro iyo tumwizeye, kand'azajy'atwigisha amategeko ye. yes'ubwe yagiz'ati: murek'abana, baze banyisangire, kuko nkund'abana. turirimb'icyubahiro cye giheranije; yuj'urukundo rwinshi rw'uwo mwami mwiza.

lines: Tyo twinjire mw'ishuri, Mu munsi wera,

hymns.title: Twinjire Mw'Ishuri

hymns.searchText: uwiteka mana, data mukiza 493 uwiteka mana, data mukiza, mpfukamy'imbere yawe ngushima. nubwo nd'umunyabyaha bikabije, urankunda data wera. urukundo rwawe rwarancunguye, rumvana mu bubata bw'icyaha. simfit'ubwoba, mfit'ibyiringiro, wangiriy'ubunt'ump'agakiza. nzahora ndirimbir'iman'ishimwe, rizamuke rigere mw'ijuru; indirimbo nziza y'umunezero, iger'ahera cyane mw'ijuru. muze muvome kw'isōko y'ubuntu, imitima yany'ishir'inyota. ibyaha byanyu mubibabarirwe, n'uwitek'imana y'amahoro; muzahabwa ubugingo bw'iteka, n'iman'itabera y'amahoro! nimureke duhimbaz'uwiteka, maze duhanik'amajwi yacu! dutere hejuru tumusingize, twogez'izina rye rikomeye. twamamaz'impuhwe n'imbabazi ze, n'iman'ikomey'ihabw'ikuzo.
hymns.title: Uwiteka Mana, Data Mukiza

hymns.searchText: igihe yesu azahamagara intore ze 494 igihe yes'azahamagar'intore ze, akazijyan'iwe, aho yaziteguriye; tuzahurira mw'ijuru kwa data; mw'ijuru heza, ni ho tuzahurira. tuzahurira – hurirayo, mw'ijuru ku mana data. n'ahantu h'icyubahiro, aho ni ho tuzahurira. tuzahura n'inshuti twari twaratanye, tuzahurira mw'iteraniro rikomeye. tuzahurira mw'ijuru kwa data; mw'ijuru heza, ni ho tuzahurira. tuzahurira – hurirayo, mw'ijuru ku mana data. n'ahantu h'icyubahiro, aho ni ho tuzahurira. abahanuzi n'abami tuzababona, n'abahow'imana batigeze bayivaho. tuzahurira mw'ijuru kwa data; mw'ijuru heza, ni ho tuzahurira. tuzahurira – hurirayo, mw'ijuru ku mana data. n'ahantu h'icyubahiro, aho ni ho tuzahurira. tuzabon'ubwiza bubengerana cyane; bw'uwitanze kugira ng'umwizera adapfa. tuzahurira mw'ijuru kwa data; mw'ijuru heza, ni ho tuzahurira. tuzahurira – hurirayo, mw'ijuru ku mana data. n'ahantu h'icyubahiro, aho ni ho tuzahurira.
hymns.title: Igihe Yesu Azahamagara Intore Ze

hymns.searchText: ntabwo nzaguhāna 495 ntabwo nzaguhāna sinzakureka, sinzagutererana na hato; nzahora nkurinda, nzajya nkurengera, nzubahirish'izina ryanjye, nd'uwiteka ntugir'ubwoba, umvira gus'iby'iman'ivuga. umurab'usheze nugotwa n'ibyago, utabaz'imana usenge, izakubumbatiz'amaboko yayo, kand'izakurind'ikwiteho, mu bishuko nugeragezwa, iman'izajy'ikwerek'inzira. nuhabw'imigisha iva mw'ijuru, menya yukw'iman'ikuba hafi, niwumva wishimye ufit'amahoro, iyo byose bigenda neza, uwiteka ntazakureka, azajy'arinda intambwe zawe. igih'ubugingo bugoswe n'ijoro, nugotwa n'ibicu komera. uwitek'azajya akumurikira, azakuyobora mu mucyo! humur'urukundo rw'imana, ntabwo ruzigera rukuvaho.
hymns.title: Ntabwo Nzaguhāna

hymns.searchText: ndakwihaye 496 ndakwihaye ndakwiyeguriy'ubu, nkwishyize mu maboko unkoreshe! mber'ingabo undinde abashaka gutuma ndeka kwizera kwanjye. yesu yarankijije kubw'ubuntu; yes'umwami yameney'amaraso; ndi hafi ye, na w'ampora bugufi; ijwi rye rirankomeza cyane. ndakwihaye umbabarir'ibyaha, bimveho ntibizongere kwibukwa; muri yesu byose bibe bishyashya, uranyeze mwami nere rwose. yesu yarankijije kubw'ubuntu; yes'umwami yameney'amaraso; ndi hafi ye, na w'ampora bugufi; ijwi rye rirankomeza cyane. nguhay'impagarike n'ubugingo, sinkiri uwanjye ngira umwe nawe! unyuzuz'umuriro wawe waka, maze nkugarurir'inzimizi. yesu yarankijije kubw'ubuntu; yes'umwami yameney'amaraso; ndi hafi ye, na w'ampora bugufi; ijwi rye rirankomeza cyane. mwam'utagereranywa ndakwihaye, mbese nakwanga nte kugukorera? nubwo twasakirana n'ibirushya, ntuzajy'ubura kuturengera. yesu yarankijije kubw'ubuntu; yes'umwami yameney'amaraso; ndi hafi ye, na w'ampora bugufi; ijwi rye rirankomeza cyane.

hymns.searchText: nzogera murangurure 497 nzogera murangurure, mutangaz'ubutumwa! mu byaro mu mijyi hose, humvikan'indirimbo. dor'imana yakunz'isi, yatanz'umwana wayo, aza mw'isi kudupfira, is'ishim'iyo mana. nimurangurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimurangurure, nimuvug'iby'agakiza! nimura-ngurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimura-ngurure, muvuge i - gakiza! nzogera nimutangaze ivuka ry'umukiza; kubw'ineza yagiriye umunyabyaha wese. mubivug'ahantu hose, n'inkuru y'imbabazi. ijuru n'isi nibyamamaz'iyo neza nyinshi. nimurangurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimurangurure, nimuvug'iby'agakiza! nimura-ngurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimura-ngurure, muvuge i - gakiza! mureb'umukiza yesu, mureb'asuzugurwa, kand'ar'umwana w'imana, tukabon'agakiza. yaducunguj'amaraso ye y'igiciro cyinshi; turangurure tuvuge iby'uko gucungurwa. nimurangurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimurangurure, nimuvug'iby'agakiza! nimura-ngurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimura-ngurure, muvuge i - gakiza! nimugende mujye hose, mugere mw'isi yose; mwingingir'abigometse, bagarukir'imana. dore bari mu makuba, bakeney'agakiza; bemer'umukiza yesu, abah'umudendezo! nimurangurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimurangurure, nimuvug'iby'agakiza! nimura-ngurure, muvug'iby'amahoro! nimura-ngurure, muvuge i - gakiza!
hymns.title: Nzogera Murangurure

hymns.searchText: muze dusingiz'umwami wacu 498 muze dusingiz'umwami wacu, wadukunze bitarondoreka! kumumenya bituma dutuza, dore ni we mwungeri wacu! dusingiz'umucunguzi, yes'umwami, nyir'ukunesha! yaduhaye ibyishimo, n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru dusingiz'umucunguzi, mucunguz'umwami wacu, yes'umwami, yes'umwami, nyir'u(ku)nesha, ukunesha! yaduhaye – yaduhaye ibyishimo – ibyishimo, n'imigisha – n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru – yo mw'ijuru. mu byaha ndetse no mu bujiji, tutizera nta byiringiro; yameny'ibyacu aratwegera, maz'adukiz'imibabaro. dusingiz'umucunguzi, yes'umwami, nyir'ukunesha! yaduhaye ibyishimo, n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru dusingiz'umucunguzi, mucunguz'umwami wacu, yes'umwami, yes'umwami, nyir'u(ku)nesha, ukunesha! yaduhaye – yaduhaye ibyishimo – ibyishimo, n'imigisha – n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru – yo mw'ijuru. yamurikiy'imitima yacu, tumenya nez'ukuri kwera! maz'uwo mwam'ab'umuvandimwe; yatuberey'umucunguzi. dusingiz'umucunguzi, yes'umwami, nyir'ukunesha! yaduhaye ibyishimo, n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru dusingiz'umucunguzi, mucunguz'umwami wacu, yes'umwami, yes'umwami, nyir'u(ku)nesha, ukunesha! yaduhaye – yaduhaye ibyishimo – ibyishimo, n'imigisha – n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru – yo mw'ijuru. ubu ntitugitwarwa n'ubwoba, kuko yaduciriy'akanzu; duhore dutez'ijwi ry'amatwi, ntabwo tuzigera tuyoba. dusingiz'umucunguzi, yes'umwami, nyir'ukunesha! yaduhaye ibyishimo, n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru dusingiz'umucunguzi, mucunguz'umwami wacu, yes'umwami, yes'umwami, nyir'u(ku)nesha, ukunesha! yaduhaye – yaduhaye ibyishimo – ibyishimo, n'imigisha – n'imigisha yo mw'ijuru – yo mw'ijuru.

lines: Mu byaha ndetse no mu bujiji,

hymns.title: Muze Dusingiz'Umwami Wacu

hymns.searchText: duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi! 499 duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi wacu, twamamaze twes'urukundo rwe! afit'icyubahiro giheranije, izina rye ryera niryubahwe! nk'uk'umwungeri arind'umukumbi we, ni ko yesu arind'abana be! duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi wacu, twamamaze twes'urukundo rwe! duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi wacu, watubabarijw'akadupfira! ni we gitare cy'ibyiringiro byacu, by'agakiza gahorahw'iteka. yikorey'imibabaro yacu yose, kubw'urukundo rwe rwinshi cyane. duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi wacu, watubabarijw'akadupfira! duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi mwiza, mw'ijur'indirimbo zihanikwe! yaranesheje rwose yambay'ikamba, n'umutware nyir'icyubahiro! dor'agiye kugaruka bidatinze, abengerana mu cyubahiro. duhimbaze yes'umucunguzi mwiza, mw'ijur'indirimbo zihanikwe!
hymns.title: Duhimbaze Yes'Umucunguzi!
